name: 25" 3/8-050 Light Rollomatic Chainsaw Bar

The reduced weight helps decrease operator fatigue, especially on longer bars. A replaceable sprocket nose assembly is also incorporated in the nose of the bar that carries the saw chain from the top to the bottom of the bar. This not only reduces wear, but also enables the bar nose to be made considerably narrower. All STIHL ROLLOMATIC® bars designed with a narrow nose help reduce kickback tendencies. It helps to prevent the accumulation of grass, dirt, and other debris that causes rust and corrosion on lawn mowing equipment. name: 27-Ton Horizontal and Vertical Gas Log Splitter
description: The Black Diamond 27-Ton Horizontal/Vertical Full Beam Hydraulic Log Splitter takes the hard, out of hard work. A powerful FNA 208cc single-cylinder OHV engine features, cast-iron sleeve, 1.0 Gal. fuel tank, 0.6 Qt. oil capacity (recommended 10W-30) and low-oil shutoff sensor. This horizontal log splitter quickly and easily converts to a vertical splitting position. This is ideal for splitting larger heavier lumber. This splitter’s large hydraulic cylinder generates 27 Tons of splitting force. Easily splitting 26-inch logs, weighing up to 100 lbs. The hydraulic oil system has a 4.8 Gal. capacity and operates at 14 GPM 2-stage gear pump. This large capacity system reliably adjusts flow and pressure to increase productivity generating an 11.5-second cycle time. The auto-return valve allows operators to reload the splitter, while the 9’’ steel wedge resets. The log catcher across from the operator keeps split wood within easy reach to increase productivity. The 2 in. ball hitch coupler and extended tongue is compatible with most trucks, ATV/UTV or towable vehicles with a 2-in ball receiver hitch. The large 16’’ DOT-approved wheels allow the splitter to be towed up to 45 mph.

name: 28-ton Professional Grade Log Splitter
description: Black Diamond's towable 28-ton log splitter with its 196cc Honda GX200 engine easily powers through the toughest logs. The fast 11-second cycle time and auto-return valve reduce your work time, while the handy log catchers and easy adjustment from horizontal to vertical save your back.

name: 38-ton Professional Grade Log Splitter
description: Black Diamond's towable 38-ton log splitter with its 270cc Honda GX270 engine easily powers through the toughest logs. The fast 17-second cycle time and auto-return valve reduce your work time, while the handy log catchers and easy adjustment from horizontal to vertical save your back.

name: 5-Ton Electric Log Splitter
description: Splitting wood has never been easier with the Earthquake® 5-Ton Electric Log Splitter. With 5 tons of splitting force, you can conquer a variety of wood splitting tasks from cutting kindling for your campfire to fueling your wood stove. Gas free, fume free and simple to operate- this unit is driven by a 1500-Watt electric motor that requires only a standard 120V outlet for all the power you need to accomplish your task. This Electric Log Splitter can be moved from job to job by simply lifting up on the front legs and rolling the unit to the next location or storage.

description: Make wood splitting faster, cleaner, and more convenient with the Earthquake 5-Ton Electric Log Splitter with Stand. Powered by a robust 1500-watt, 15-amp electric motor, this splitter delivers reliable performance through its 5-ton rated hydraulic system, easily handling logs up to 10 inches in diameter and 20 inches in length. Designed for efficiency and ease of use, it features sturdy transport wheels for smooth mobility and includes a stand and integrated tray to keep logs at a comfortable working height while helping maintain a tidy workspace. Ideal for homeowners who want dependable power without the noise and maintenance of gas, this electric log splitter makes preparing firewood simple and efficient.

name: 6TE Electric Log Splitter
description: Split wood indoors or out with clean, electric power. Easy-to-use splitter features a 1,090 watt, 120V AC motor that splits wood 20 inches in length and 10 inches in diameter. Uses any 110v household outlet.

name: K32 Chipper Shredder
description: The Earthquake K32 Chipper Shredder is powered by an easy-starting and powerful engine, strong enough to chip branches up to 3” in diameter. The rugged steel hopper stands at only 34” high, so yard waste can be dropped in with minimal effort while larger branches can be fed into the limb chute.

name: 160cc Badger Front Tine Tiller
description: Built with the passionate gardener in mind, the Earthquake Badger front tine rototiller features a two-position, heavy-duty, cast iron tail and wheel assembly. With the wheels in the forward position, transport is a breeze. In the extended position, the center of gravity is lowered for incredible control and deep-tilling performance in the row. Powered by a 160cc 4-cycle Viper, the Badger provides plenty of power to accomplish your tilling tasks. Easily adjust the tilling width with no tools required by simply adding or removing tines. The tilling width can be adjusted from 11 inches, up to 21 inches wide. With its compact frame and balanced weight distribution, the Badger allows for fluid navigation in tight growing spaces and stable pivoting capability at the end of garden rows. The airless wheels, robust forged tines, and all steel construction are all hallmarks of a tiller built to last. All Earthquake products are built to perform and backed by a U.S. based customer support team.

name: 99cc Viper 21" Versa Tiller Cultivator

The Versa front tine tiller from Earthquake is two garden tools in one. As a cultivator, the Versa can weed, mulch, and aerate soil. As a tiller, the high-performance 99cc Viper engine and design delivers the right amount of power to turn all kinds of soil. Prepare wide open spaces of land in the Spring, maintain rows in the Summer, and do major cleanup in the Fall. Sure to be your new workhorse.

name: Roofers Shovel with Long Wooden Handle

name: Round Point Shovel with Fiberglass Handle

name: Steel Scoop with Wood Handle
description: The Black Diamond® Steel Grain Scoop features a sturdy, hardwood handle suitable for rigorous work. The steel blade and collar supplies extra strength and is perfect for handling loose material, such as coal, stone, snow, grain, fertilizer and more! The scoop, which can be easily cleaned and sterilized, is made of high-quality material that provides increased durability. Whether you’re landscaping or simply transferring material, this Steel Grain Scoop is both versatile and built to last.

name: 10” Folding Saw
description: Fiskars POWER TOOTH® Softgrip® Folding Saw features a razor-sharp, triple-ground blade that makes aggressive cuts to help you power through thick branches faster. The saw blade locks in two different open positions, so whether you're making overhand cuts or undercuts, you still have maximum cutting power and control. Softgrip® touchpoints provide a comfortable, secure grip no matter which way you're cutting, and Fiskars pruning saw even folds and locks for space-saving storage and safe transportation.®

name: 12' Tree Pruner
description: Keep a wide variety of trees in check quickly and easily with this Corona Tools 12-foot tree pruner. The telescoping fiberglass pole is adjustable to allow you to work on trees of different sizes, and it features an internal stop to prevent separation during the adjustment process. It features a cutlery steel blade with a 1-inch diameter cutting capacity, as well as a traditional 13-inch saw blade for larger branches.

name: 13" Curved Blade Saw
description: Its 11.75" nickel-finished blade and rubberized polymer grip can handle branches up to 4" in diameter

name: 18" Razor Tooth Pruning Saw
description: 18" Pruning saw with RazorTOOTH Saw technology removes up to 2x more material per pull stroke than saws with conventional blades.

name: 18" Wood Handle Machete
description: Tackle tough vegetation and outdoor tasks with ease using the 18" Wood Handle Machete. Designed for durability and strength, this machete features a high-carbon steel blade that effortlessly cuts through thick brush, dense foliage, and stubborn branches. The sharp, wide blade ensures clean, efficient cuts, making it ideal for clearing trails, gardening, or preparing firewood.

name: 2" Lopper with 32" Handle
description: It’s time to call in the big guns. The STIHL PL 40 lopper is our largest model, made for higher tree branches that defy lesser tools. Its aircraft aluminum handle measures a full 32”, perfect for reaching taller branches and getting better leverage on all your pruning tasks. Its specially designed cutting head has a cutting capacity of 2”. If this lopper can’t cut it, it probably needs a saw.Note: The cutting blades can be sharpened using a file or honing stone.

name: 28" Lopper
description: The STIHL Homeowner Lopper PL 5 can cut branches up to 2 inches in diameter just like hand tools the pros use, but on a homeowner's budget. Specially designed for lasting quality, the lopper's blade and hook are forged from a steel alloy designed for tensile strength and toughness. Added strength comes from lightweight tubular steel handles and double cushion bumpers which make pruning easier and extend the life of the loppers by reducing the amount of force on the handles. A contoured grip makes for comfortable use.

name: 3/4" ComfortGel Bypass Pruner
description: Branch & Stem pruner with Comfort-Cel grips for superior comfort and less hand fatigue. Cuts up to 3/4". Non-stick blade. Shock-GAURD bumper system. Accommodates both right and left handed users.

name: 32" Ratchet Lopper for Dry Wood
description: Designed to significantly reduce the effort required to cut through tough tree branches up to 2 in. thick, Fiskars® Ratchet Lopper features an easy-to-use ratchet design. Simply insert the thick, dry tree branch between the blade and anvil and squeeze – the ratchet design compounds the force of a few small squeezes to power through the branch without straining your hands and arms. The fully hardened, precision-ground steel blade has a low-friction coating that helps the blade glide through wood, prevents gumming with sap and debris, and adds rust resistance. Tough steel construction with riveted handles provides a lasting value.

name: 5" Leather Scabbard
description: The universal design of Corona's Leather Scabbard will fit most hand pruners. Made of top-grain leather, this scabbard includes a belt clip and loops.

name: 7" Max Folding Razor Tooth Pruning Saw
description: Corona Tools' 7" Max Folding Razor Tooth Pruning Saw features a blade that has gone through four manufacturing processes for maximum durability and hardness, friction reduction, and makes cutting extremely fast and efficient. This blade has triple-ground impulse-hardened teeth for 2.5x more material removed per stroke.

name: 9" Hand Pruner
description: If you have large hands, the PP 80 hand pruner from STIHL is like a well-tailored suit for your fingers. It features the same high-quality steel, non-slip handle and quick-release blade lock as our PP 70 hand pruner, but features a 1" longer handle for comfort and improved grip and a cutting capacity of up to .80. No more hand strain from awkward holds. And like the PP 70, its chrome-plated blades can be re-sharpened, even replaced, improving the lifespan of your hand pruners.

name: ComfortGEL Bypass Lopper
description: Corona's Bypass Lopper with ComfortGEL grips is the lightweight pruning tool built for comfortable cutting. The smaller grip sizes and tactile handles deliver comfort to gardeners who seek an easier, more therapeutic experience. This lopper comfortably gets the job done.

name: ComfortGEL DualLINK Extendable Bypass Lopper
description: Corona's Extendable DualLINK Bypass Lopper with ComfortGEL grips takes everything you love about Corona loppers and adds in longer reach. Boosted power and reduced effort unite through DualLINK, a power-compounding- link feature that appeals to both engaged gardeners and landscapers searching for ease-of-cut.

name: ComfortGEL Extendable Bypass Lopper
description: The high-performance dual arc blade coating reduces cutting effort by 25% when compared to titanium-coated or non-coated blades. Precision made MAXForged tools use a forging process that compacts steel molecules into Corona strongest, most durable garden cutting tools.

name: ComfortGEL Hedge Shear
description: Corona's Hedge Shear with ComfortGEL grips is the lightweight pruning tool with 9-inch blades. The smaller grip sizes and tactile handles deliver comfort to gardeners who seek an easier, more therapeutic experience. This hedge shear comfortably gets the job done.

name: ComfortGEL Pruner
description: Anvil design for pruning dry and woody growth. Specially coated non-stick blade provides maximum cutting performance. Reduced hand fatigue with shock guard Bumper system. Accommodates both right and left handed users. Maximize comfort and control with soft, ergonomically-shaped grips

name: Compound Action Lopper
description: Tackle dry and woody growth with this Corona compound action lopper. Its 4-bar compound linkage triples cutting power, making your projects that much easier. The lightweight fiberglass handles (the total weight of the lopper is a mere 3.2 pounds) and extra-long 8-inch foam grips minimize fatigue, meaning you can work on your project all day without your equipment getting in the way.

name: Forged Pruner
description: Fiskars Forged Pruner features forged steel construction for excellent durability and an ergonomic design with an angled cutting head that helps reduce wrist fatigue. A fully hardened, precision-ground forged steel blade stays sharp, and the handle includes non-slip grips.

name: Forged Steel Lopper 30”
description: This rugged lopper gets the job done season after season, thanks to a solid build and a replaceable blade. Solid, forged steel handles offer superior strength, and are enhanced with textured Softgrip® for a comfortable, cushioned grip. A fully hardened, precision-ground stainless steel blade stays sharp and features a special low-friction coating for smooth cuts, reduced gumming and rust resistance. Plus, the blade can be sharpened for even more lasting value.

name: Interchangeable Garden Kneeler and Chair
description: Make gardening easier and more comfortable with Backyard Expressions’ Interchangeable Garden Kneeler and Chair! Featuring a sturdy metal frame with a sleek matte black finish, this versatile tool reduces glare and heat transfer while providing lasting durability. The high-density foam pads offer cushioned comfort whether you’re kneeling or sitting, and the innovative design allows the legs to fold flat for easy storage. Combining practicality, comfort, and style, this garden kneeler and chair is the perfect companion for all your planting, weeding, and outdoor projects.

name: Longer Handled Pruner
description: Snip through your day with smooth precision. The STIHL PP 40 hand pruner features a longer, wider blade, ideal for thicker twigs and stems. Its chrome-plated blade resists sap and can be re-sharpened when dull, extending the pruner's lifespan. The steel handles ideally suited for large hands are PVC coated for better grip and comfort, making this hand pruner the perfect choice for a long day of precision cutting.

name: Multipurpose Garden Shears
description: Cut open a wide range of heavy-duty garden materials including fertilizer bags, landscape fabric, screens and more with the multi-use Fiskars® Multipurpose Garden Shears. From cutting bed lining to adding mulch, prepping and maintaining a strong foundation is key to a healthy garden and can involve a variety of arduous tasks - all of which rely on retaining blade sharpness. This versatile tool features ergonomically sculpted handles and fully hardened, precision-ground, steel blades that cut all the way to the tip and stay sharp through heavy use. Other features include a power notch to cut light rope, wire and twine cutters, a pointed awl tip for piercing small holes in cardboard and leather, and a bottle opener. The shears can also be taken apart, leaving you with a titanium-enhanced knife for cutting large objects. A sheath for safe transport and storage comes with a built-in tape cutter and ceramic scissors sharpener.

name: Pole Pruner Set
description: “I came. I sawed. I conquered.” Defeat your daily landscaping tasks with the strength and versatility of the PP 900. This heavy-duty manual pole pruner set is part of the STIHL Precision Series™ and includes two durable fiberglass poles with a working reach of 12’ above the ground (up to 18’ with purchase of optional extension pole). The set includes a lopper head with a high-carbon steel blade – great for cutting branches up to 1.25” in diameter – and a saw blade. All parts are easily replaceable, so you can keep conquering with this set indefinitely. Optional accessories also available, such as the PS 75 or PS 80 blade for larger

name: PowerGear Hedge Shears 23”
description: The first time you try Fiskars PowerGear® Hedge Shears, you’ll be amazed — but it’s not magic, it’s gears. The patented gear technology multiplies your leverage to give you up to three times more power on every cut. This means you can power through thick branches that traditional hedge shears would struggle to cut. It also means that Fiskars hedge shears can be smaller and lighter than other shears, reducing strain on your hands, wrists and muscles when you’re reaching to cut a branch or have a lot of hedge shaping to do. Like many of the PowerGear® tools, Fiskars hedge shears have won the Ease-of-Use Commendation from the Arthritis Foundation®. But the shears aren’t just for people with arthritis — they are for anyone who appreciates tools that make work easier.

name: PowerGear2 Lopper 32”
description: Fiskars® Power-Lever® Lopper, 28 in. features compound lever technology that gives you more cutting power than traditional designs. Power through branches up to 1¾ in. thick with a fully hardened, precision-ground steel blade and a low-friction blade coating that resists rust and makes every cut even easier. All-steel construction offers lasting toughness, and non-slip grips provide control.

name: PowerGear2 Pruner
description: The first time you try Fiskars PowerGear2™ Pruner, you’ll be amazed — but it’s not magic, it’s gears. The patented gear technology multiplies your leverage to give you up to 3X more power on every cut. So you can power through tough stems and branches that you wouldn’t be able to cut with traditional pruners. For easy, comfortable pruning, Fiskars pruner also includes a contoured handle with a unique rolling design that fits the shape and natural motion of your hand. The updated design includes modified gears and an innovative cam mechanism to optimize your cutting power in the middle of the cut where the branch is thickest and you need it most. The result is that every cut is even easier than the original PowerGear® cutting tools.

name: PowerLever Xtndbl PoleSaw Pruner
description: Fiskars® Power-Lever® Extendable Pole Saw and Pruner, 7-14 ft. features technology designed to compound your cutting force plus two unique cutting options and 14-foot extension. Reach high branches and cut back unwanted growth up to 11/8 in. diameter with the sharp, durable steel pruner that features low-friction coating. For thicker branches, use the sturdy 15-in. WoodZig™ saw with aggressive teeth for faster cutting with less binding. The oval-shaped, lightweight yet strong pole reduces flex, allowing you to control the direction of the cut and fits the natural shape of your hand. A unique double-locking system ensures the pole stays extended for superior control.

name: Pro Pruner
description: Featuring PowerArc(TM) technology, the Fiskars® Pro Pruner boasts intelligently curved blades for 20% easier cuts through stems and light branches. A cast-aluminum handle ensures ultimate durability, while thicker, high carbon steel blades stay sharp longer for reliable, long-lasting performance.

name: Shear Ease Grass Shears
description: Shear Ease® Grass Shears include a patented mechanism that prevents the blades from jamming or sticking when you're trimming back grass around garden beds, along fence lines or around other obstacles and borders in your yard. The fully hardened, precision-ground blades also rotate a full 360 degrees to give you clean, precise cuts, even at awkward angles. The lightweight loop-handle design offers easy use and excellent control.

name: Super Pruner/Lopper
description: The first time you try Fiskars PowerGear® Super Pruner/Lopper, you'll be amazed -- but it's not magic, it's gears. Fiskars patented gear technology multiplies your leverage to give you up to three times more power on every cut. This means you can power through thick branches that you wouldn't be able to cut with traditional pruners and loppers. It also means that the Super Pruner can be smaller and lighter than other loppers, reducing strain on your hands, wrists and muscles when you're reaching to cut a branch or have a lot of branches to cut. Like many of Fiskars PowerGear® tools, the Super Pruner has won the Ease-of-Use Commendation from the Arthritis Foundation®. But it's not just for people with arthritis -- it's for anyone who appreciates tools that make work easier.®

name: Traditional Bypass Pruner
description: Designed for durability and easy cutting on stems and light branches up to 5/8" diameter. This reliable pruner is ideal for a variety of general pruning tasks. A fully hardened, precision-ground steel blade stays sharp longer, and a rust-resistant, low-friction coating makes cutting easier. A self-cleaning sap groove keeps the blades from sticking, and the handle includes non-slip grips. All-steel construction provides long-lasting durability.

name: Tree Pruning Stick
description: Fiskars Pruning Stik® Tree Pruner makes it easy to cut high or low with a level of control traditional pruners with exterior ropes can’t match. A long, lightweight pole lets you cut high branches without the hassles and dangers of using a ladder, make low cuts without sore knees from kneeling or back strain from bending and easily reach into dense, prickly shrubs or tight spots. The rope-free design means you can use both hands to maximize your power and accuracy, and an easy-to-grip sliding handle makes the pruning action smooth and simple. An actuating ball at the end of the pole lets you reach even farther and still prune with precision, and the cutting head rotates up to 230º to let you cut at tough angles. The fully hardened, precision-ground blade stays sharp, and a low-friction, rust-resistant coating makes every cut easier.

name: X-Series Ratchet Pruner
description: The ergonomic Fiskars® X-series™ Ratchet Pruner (P971) features a ratchet design that compounds force with a series of easy squeezes, providing maximum cutting power with very little effort. Its fully hardened, precision-ground steel blade stays sharp longer, while a low-friction blade coating resists rust and allows for smoother, easier cuts. A thoughtfully designed, durable, cast-aluminum handle fits the natural shape of your hand, reducing fatigue, while SoftGrip® details on the top handle offer a secure, comfortable grip. A sliding lock protects the blade during transport and storage and is conveniently placed for quick and easy activation.

name: XtendControl 14’ Interchangeable Tree Pruner
description: Better balance, more comfort — Fiskars® XtendControl™ 14 ft. Interchangeable Tree Pruner shifts the weight of the pruner closer to your hands to increase control and reduce the fatigue of fighting a top-heavy tool. Featuring 4 interchangeable components, the pruner offers up to 7 unique configurations for full-pruning function in one compact, easy-to-store package. The X2 hook bill saw blade has an aggressive triple-grind profile for fast action plus a shaped handle with finger notch for stand-alone use. A fixed pruning head easily cuts branches up to ø 1.25 in. and is attached to an automatic cord reel to keep the cutting cord taut and right at your fingertips. Two interchangeable extension poles are made of strong, durable and easy-to-maneuver aluminum with snap-fit connectors and secondary safety locks that keep components securely in place. When used independently, the shorter pole extends from 3-6 ft. while the longer pole extends from 4-8 ft. When combined the poles reach a maximum extension of 14 ft., and both poles include a metal locking insert that prevents the poles from overextending. Confidence in every cut — with Fiskars®.

name: 14" Hoe and Cultivator Tool
description: Simplify your gardening tasks with the 14" Hoe and Cultivator Tool, a must-have for every gardener. Featuring a dual-purpose design, this tool combines the power of a hoe and cultivator in one versatile implement, making it perfect for digging, weeding, and soil aeration.

name: 2 Prong Weed Hoe with Wooden Handle
description: The True Temper 2-Prong Hoe is designed for close cultivation around existing plants. The flat “hoe” side is used for chopping, weeding, and clearing light garden growth. The pointed “prong” side is used for cultivating the soil.

name: 24" Folding Garden Kneeler
description: The Backyard Expressions Garden Kneeler is the perfect addition to your gardening supplies. Featuring high density foam pads, this kneeler will keep you comfortable while gardening. Easily adjust the height of your kneeler to convert it into a seat.

name: 3-Tine Cultivator
description: Make gardening a breeze with the 3-Tine Cultivator, designed to help you easily loosen, aerate, and till soil for healthier plants and better garden yields. Featuring three sturdy, high-quality steel tines, this tool is perfect for breaking up compacted soil, removing weeds, and preparing garden beds for planting.

name: 4 Tine Cultivator with Wooden Handle
description: The True Temper 4-tine cultivator is better for tilling and aerating in hard rocky soil. The sharp pointed tines dig deep into the soil. It is of good value to homeowners landscaping and gardening requirements.

name: 4 Tine Forged Cultivator
description: 4 Tine Forged Cultivator, 5" Head, Wood Handle with a 6" Grip.

name: 4 Tine Potato/Refuse Hook Rake with Wooden Handle
description: Strength and durability make Razor-Back tools the choice of professionals. This potato hook is more versatile than its name implies. Its tines are sturdy and ideal for digging or harvesting potatoes and similar types of vegetables. It can also be used to transfer manure and loose material or even for general garden clean-up.

name: 5" 4 Tine Cultivator with Wooden Handle
description: The Razor-Back cultivator features 4 sharp, curved tines and a 54” North American hardwood handle for durability. This tool is perfect for cultivating, weeding, and aerating soil. The one-piece forged head and steel ferrule provides added strength and durability.

name: 6" Forged Nursery/Beet Hoe With Wood Handle
description: This 6-inch x 3.5-inch forged blade nursery/beet hoe is ideal for chopping, weeding and making furrows for planting. Sheared ears enable the hoe to be used close to beet leaves. Despite its name, this tool is versatile enough to use for general landscaping and garden maintenance.

name: 7" Mason/Plaster Hoe, Forged, with Wood Handle
description: The Razor-Back mortar mixer is ideal for mixing concrete or similar materials in a wheelbarrow or mortar pan. It features a long 54-inch handle mounted to a forged plain steel blade with a ferrule socket.

name: Comfort GEL Cultivator
description: The Comfort GEL Cultivator has a robust stainless steel head with largest-diameter tines. The finger guard protects your hand during digging. Ideal for aerating around young plant/weeding between rows and the handle has ComfortGEL Grip technology to help with hand fugitive.

name: Comfort GEL Hoe/Cultivator
description: The Comfort GEL Hoe/Cultivator has a robust stainless steel dual working heads; 2 tools in 1. The sharp hoe helps to break clumpy soil while the cultivator helps with weeding between rows. The handle has ComfortGEL Grip technology to help with hand fugitive.

name: Comfort GEL Weeder
description: The Comfort GEL Weeder has a robust stainless-steel head that ends in 2 prong to help with piercing the soil and extracting weed at root. Serrated edge for cutting weeds and roots. The finger guard helps protects your hand during use. The handle has ComfortGEL Grip technology to help with hand fugitive.

name: Dandelion Weeder
description: The True Temper dandelion weeder is great for removing dandelions and other weeds from lawns and landscape beds. The V-notched blade is sharp to cut the roots deep below the surface. A leather lanyard makes storage easy.

name: Deluxe Stand-up 4-Claw Weeder
description: Fiskars® Deluxe Stand-up Weeder makes it easy to permanently remove invasive plants – without kneeling, bending or using harsh, costly, chemical herbicides. To use, place the head over a weed and step down on the reinforced foot platform. This releases four serrated, stainless steel claws that grab weeds by the root. Then, simply rock back the tool for clean removal. An offset handle reduces wrist strain, while a viewing window in the pedal allows for accurate claw placement. For quick and easy cleanup, pull back on the orange ejection handle to release and clear the head between use.

name: Double Action Weeder Hoe
description: The True Temper Action Hoe is great for weeding and cultivating around live growing plants. It works by using a back and forth push-pull motion to cut weed roots deep under the surface. This tool cuts weeding in half the time.

name: Double Edged Weed Cutter
description: The True Temper deluxe weed cutter offers a cost-effective way of clearing tall grass and other vegetation in overgrown areas.Its double-edge action provides increased efficiency by cutting on both the forward and return strokes.This is an ideal tool to clear ditches, forests, and fields.

name: Garden Hoe with Fiberglass Handle
description: The True Temper garden hoe is ideal for chopping, weeding, and clearing garden growth. The blade is thicker at the center for strength and sharper at the edges for cleaner cutting. The blade is forged from one piece of solid piece of steel for years of service.

name: Garden Hoe with Fiberglass Handle
description: The Black Diamond® Garden Hoe features a reinforced, fiberglass handle designed with durability in mind. The hoe utilizes a tempered steel blade for increased strength, especially when slicing through tough material such as dirt clods or weed roots. The Black Diamond® Garden Hoe is an indispensable tool to keep your garden free of weeds without the need to manually pull them by hand. Whether you’re grooming soil, chopping or weeding, this hoe is made for the job and built to last!.

name: Garden Soil Hand Tiller
description: ComfortGEL lawn & garden tools were made for exceptional comfort & control. This range of tools were engineered & developed to provide you with hand-held solutions to cultivate, weed, till and maintain your property. It is used for turning and aerating the soil and developing seed rows in gardens. A substitute for rototillers in small developed gardens or raised gardens. Durable, heat treated with high carbon steel teeth compared to cast aluminum. Self sharpening, large 9'' wide x 6" long steel teeth. Quick release plunger to remove dirt and mud clots from the tool between dives in the ground. All metal plates withstand high bearing pressure.

name: Hand Weeder
description: Say goodbye to stubborn weeds with the Hand Weeder, the essential tool for maintaining a tidy, healthy garden. Designed for precision and comfort, this tool features a sharp, curved stainless steel blade that easily slips under weed roots, allowing for quick and effective removal with minimal effort.

name: Hori Hori Garden Knife
description: Hori Hori Garden Knife with Comfort Gel grip has a serrated blade for cutting through roots while planting in your garden. Precision ground beveled sharp edge for easy plant removal and full tang construction for added durability. The anti-blister Comfort Gel grip has long lasting comfort and reduced fatigue.

name: Hori Hori Garden Tool

The Large Nut Gatherer is designed to be easy to use and save time. Simply roll over the large items you would like to pick up in the tempered steel wire cage and repeat until full. To remove to items, simply open the cage with its quick release cage spreader. The Weasel large nut gatherer is made with durable carbon steel making it rust and water resistant for multiple uses. The Large Nut Gatherer weighs less than 4 pounds, comes fully assembled, and is 47.5 inches long.

By choosing an Agri-Fab cart you can be sure it's the best you can buy. All Agri-Fab carts are made to last and made to efficiently and easily carry the load.

description: This Farm & Ranch 13" general purpose pneumatic tire offers reliable performance on small equipment like hand carts, pressure washers, leaf blowers, air compressors, generators, and garden carts. It has a 300-pound load capacity and inflates easily.

description: The Farm & Ranch FR2200 13” Pneumatic Tire features heavy-duty ball bearings, a grease fitting and 5/8” axle bores to make an ideal replacement wheel for wheelbarrows, utility carts, lawn and garden carts, hand trucks, air compressors or anything else which is used on tough terrains. name: 13" Wheelbarrow Tire

It features a solid polyurethane design that eliminates the chance of a flat, making it a great substitute for pneumatic tires that should minimize your downtime. It includes heavy-duty ball bearings, a grease fitting, and an adapter kit to accommodate 5/8” and 3/4” axles.

name: 16" Wheelbarrow Tire
description: This 16” Farm and Ranch tire is a great replacement for wheelbarrows, utility carts, hand trucks, air compressors, and more. name: 18 cu. ft. Poly Utility Cart
description: This Agri-Fab 18 cu. ft Poly Utility Cart will easily help you transport firewood, sand, gravel, mulch, and much more. This cart is also equipped with large 16” x 6.5” pneumatic Turf tread tires which give you easy maneuverability over the roughest terrain. The 45-0553 cart has a 52-degree dump angle and 110-degree swivel feature which makes it easy for you to dump the product you have at the precise location.

name: 2 Wheel 4 Cubic Feet Yard Cart
description: The Gorilla Carts 4 cu. ft. Poly Yard Cart is designed and engineered to provide a much easier and more comfortable hauling solution than an old-fashioned wheelbarrow. Featuring a low center of gravity for amazing stability and maneuverability, this cart is the perfect tool whether you're a casual gardener or a lawn professional. name: 7 Cu Ft Heavy Duty Poly Yard Dump Cart

name: 7 cu. ft. Evolution Poly Yard Cart
7.5 cu. ft. Big Wheel Cart

name: 8 cu ft Poly Wheelbarrow

name: Folding Activity Wagon
description: Introducing the Gorilla Carts Collapsible Folding Outdoor Utility Wagon, featuring an innovative design that makes it quick and simple to set up and fold down for easy storage. name: Half Pattern Sprinkler on 12" Stake
description: This Orbit® Half Pattern Sprinkler provides an even and low-volume spray over a smaller half circle area, making it an ideal irrigation solution for flowerbeds, garden rows and small shrubs. The easy-control flow knob adjusts spray coverage from 5' to 10'. The pre-assembled on-stake construction ensures a fast set-up, and will easily connect to any standard 1/4" drip tubing.

name: Half Pattern Sprinkler with Flow Control
description: Ideal for watering flower beds, vegetable rows, and other delicate areas, this Orbit® half pattern sprinkler has a flow control knob to adjust for spray volume and distance. This sprinkler head easily attaches to 1/4" risers or threads into standard 10"-32 adapters.

name: Inline Dripper/Emitter 10-Pack
description: Ideal for spot watering on extended drip lines, this Orbit® inline dripper/emitter allows you to adjust the flow from a slight dribble to a radius of 3'. Connects easily to 1/4" irrigation tubing.

name: Metal Soaker Irrigator
description: Your flowerbeds and new growth have different watering needs than most of your lawn, and the Orbit® Metal Soaker Irrigator provides a tailored solution for these delicate areas. Its gentle soaking method prevents erosion, and its heavy-duty metal construction ensures you years of reliable irrigation use. Also appropriate for trees and shrubs.

name: Micro-Bubbler on 6" Stake
description: The Orbit® Micro-Bubbler on a 6" stake is a low-volume sprinkler ideal for watering potted plants and shrubs. The flow-control knob adjusts the spray distance over 1' to 6', and the full-circumference spray easily reaches to all surrounding vegetation.

name: Mini Rotating Sprinkler
description: A targeted sprinkler for your low-volume and gentle watering needs, the Orbit® Mini Rotating low volume sprinkler head is great for watering flower beds and other delicate areas of your lawn. The control knob adjusts water flow and spray distance from 4' to 10', making this a versatile and low-impact irrigation solution.

name: Mist Pattern
description: Safely water delicate plants with this Orbit® mist pattern, designed to attach to 1/4" irrigation tubing or 1/4" risers and sprinkler stakes. The flow control knob lets you adjust the flow rate with the touch of a finger.

name: Multi-Stream Dripper
description: Water your potted plants and flower beds with this Orbit® multi-stream dripper, equipped witha flow control knob to adjust spray volume and distance. This dripper emitter easily threads onto a 1/4" riser or sprinkler stake.

name: Multi-Stream Emitter on 6" Stake
description: Designed for easy watering of flowerbeds, potted plants and shrubs, the Orbit® Multi-Stream Emitter on a 6" stake is equipped with a flow control knob to control spray distance over 2' to 6' in radius. The heavy-duty stake slips easily into the soil.

name: Poly Adaptor
description: The Riser Adapter converts sprinkler heads from 1/2" to 3/4" inlet for use with 3/4" risers and pipe.

name: Quarter Pattern Sprinkler on 12" Stake
description: This Orbit® Quarter Pattern Sprinkler provides an even and low-volume spray over a small quarter circle area, making it an ideal irrigation solution for flowerbeds, garden rows and small shrubs. The easy-control flow knob adjusts spray coverage from 5' to 10'. The pre-assembled on-stake construction ensures a fast set-up, and will easily connect to any standard 1/4" drip tubing.

name: Quarter Pattern Sprinkler with Flow Control
description: Attach this Orbit® quarter pattern sprinkler to any 1/4" tubing or riser or standard 10"-32 threaded adapter. Ideal for watering flower beds, vegetable rows, and other delicate areas, this sprinkler has a control knob that lets you adjust for flow volume and spray distance.

name: Strip Pattern Sprinkler on 12" Stake
description: Essential for any home irrigation system, the Orbit® Strip Pattern Sprinkler is a time- and water-efficient watering solution for flowerbeds and small shrubs. The easy-control flow knob adjusts spray distance from 2' to 10'. The pre-assembled on-stake construction ensures a fast set-up, and will easily connect to any standard 1/4" drip tubing.

name: Strip Pattern Sprinkler with Flow Control
description: Attach this Orbit® strip pattern sprinkler to any 1/4" riser or sprinkler stake for low-volume and efficient watering of flower beds, vegetable rows, and other delicate areas of your yard. The flow control knob lets you adjust for water flow and spray distance.

name: 1 Outlet Hose Faucet Timer
description: The Orbit® 1 Outlet Hose Faucet Timer gives you complete control over the timing of your automatic sprinkling system. The single dial allows you to cycle through several functions: set clock, set watering time, how often, how long, and run program. The manual button allows for system interruption when needed.

name: 1/2" Brass Impact Sprinkler Head (290-D)
description: Ideal for homeowners with large lawns, this Orbit® 1/2" Brass Impact Sprinkler Head (290-D) is one of the most popular impact heads from Orbit®, known for its durability, efficacy, and easy maintenance. Offering adjustable coverage from 20' to 40' radius, the heavy-duty brass impulse head resists rust and sediment build-up, minimizing maintenance hassle. Universal construction and designed to work with or replace most 1/2" impact heads, this sprinkler can be attached to a fixed or a portable tripod to offer you customized versatility in your lawn care.

name: 1/2" Metal Ring Base
description: An essential accessory for your impact sprinkler, the Orbit® 1/2" Metal Ring Base creates a stable base for an impact sprinkler. Its lightweight functional design makes your sprinkler easy to move around the lawn.

name: 1/2" Plastic Impact Sprinkler Head - Green
description: Orbit's 1/2" plastic impact sprinkler head is ideal for watering flower beds, vegetable gardens, and lawns. It has a fully adjustable spray pattern and spray distance is 20 to 40 feet.

name: 1/2" Zinc Impact Head Sprinkler
description: This Orbit® 1/2" Zinc Impact Head Sprinkler is designed to water lawn areas of up to 80' in diameter. The easily adjustable spray nozzle can be modified from a partial to full circle. This impulse sprinkler head also features a deflector shield and anti-backsplash arm to keep the water directed where you want it and minimize puddles around the sprinkler head.

name: 1/2" Zinc Impact Sprinkler on Step Spike - 2 Pack
description: The Orbit® 1/2" Zinc Impact Sprinkler Heads are ideal for using singly or stringing into a series over a large area. Simply step down on the zinc step spike to mount the sprinkler in the ground.The above-ground impulse sprinkler head is made of durable zinc and will cover up to 80' in diameter. The easily adjustable spray nozzle can be modified from a partial to full circle. The Orbit® 1/2" Impact Sprinkler on a Step Spike also features a deflector shield and anti-backsplash arm to aid in spray pattern and area coverage.

name: 1/2" Zinc Spike Base
description: The Orbit® 1/2" Zinc Spike Base metal spike inserts easily into the ground and anchors sprinklers securely when watering. An economical and durable replacement spike for broken spikes on your existing sprinkler head, the unique flow-through construction allows multiple sprinklers to be connected together for a larger watering area. Works with 1/2" sprinkler heads.

name: 1/2" Zinc Step Spike Base
description: Durably constructed to last for years, this Orbit® 1/2"' Zinc Step Spike Base is a great option for replacing broken aluminum spikes while hanging onto your existing sprinkler head. The easy-to-use step digs securely into the ground, and may be used as a single sprinkler base or in a series over a larger area.

name: 1-Outlet B-Hyve XD Bluetooth Smart Hose Timer
description: Elevate your watering game with the 2nd Generation Orbit B-hyve Smart 1-Outlet Hose Faucet Watering Timer. No more worries about forgotten plants or overwatered lawns – this smart timer puts you in charge. This timer is part of the B-hyve Smart water management device ecosystem which includes smart landscape controllers, hose faucet timers, flow meters, and leak detectors.

name: 2-Outlet B-Hyve XD Bluetooth Smart Hose Timer
description: The Brilliance of B-hyve Science comes to life in ourfirsthybrid hose tap water management device! You have the flexibility to program remotely from the B-hyve mobile app, and the confidence to program on-device in a pinch.

name: 3/4" Brass Impact Sprinkler Head (S261-Dst)
description: A top-notch sprinkler head for your large home lawn or commercial irrigation needs, the Orbit® 3/4" Brass Impact Sprinkler Head (S261-Dst) is durably constructed of brass and stainless steel and will provide years of reliable irrigation. Equipped with double brass 3/16" and 3/32" nozzles, the versatile impulse head adjusts from a partial to full circle, providing 25' to 48' radius coverage. Requires a 3/4" MNPT connection.

name: 3/4" Brass Impact Sprinkler on Ring Base
description: Designed for heavy-duty lawn and commercial irrigation use, this Orbit® 3/4" Brass Impact Sprinkler on Ring Base is durably constructed of brass and stainless steel and will provide years of reliable use. The wide, no-tip base is equipped with an ergo hose connection, and the brass impulse head will cover a radius of 25' to 45'. Ideal for heavy-duty sprinkler systems.

name: 3/4" Brass Impact Sprinkler Tripod
description: The Orbit Brass Impact Sprinkler on Adjustable Tripod is ideal for watering large areas. Designed for dependability, impact heads have an uninterrupted water flow that are clog-resistant, even when used with dirty or reclaimed water from ponds and canals. Attached to an adjustable tripod, this sprinkler sprays up to a 90-foot diameter. Features a deflector shield for distance adjustment and an anti-backsplash arm to aid in spray pattern and area coverage. A simple twist of the diffuser screw breaks up the water stream, creating larger or smaller water droplets. The tripod base adjusts from 27.5 to 68.5 inches in height and retracts to a small size for easy storage. The base connects easily to a 3/4-inch standard garden hose by a gooseneck attachment. The all-metal construction means it will hold up against the typical wear and tear that most impact sprinklers experience, giving you years of dependable use.

name: 3400 Square Feet Oscillator Sprinkler
description: This Orbit® 3400 Square Feet Oscillator will provide thorough and even sprinkling coverage of your lawn with minimal puddles. Built of impact-resistant plastic, it is equipped with 19 jet nozzles that produce a rectangular spray covering up to 3,400 sq ft. This oscillator's wide base is designed to reduce tip over, and the heavy-duty gear train and cam and ball drive make for smooth and reliable watering movement, with the option for full, partial, left or right coverage. Make lawn irrigation an easier and more efficient task.

name: 3600 Square Feet Oscillator Sprinkler
description: Irrigate your lawn thoroughly and evenly with this Orbit® 3600 Square Feet Oscillator while minimizing puddles. Constructed of heavy-duty metal and plastic, this sprinkler comes equipped with 21 jet nozzles that produce a rectangular spray covering up to 3,600 sq ft. The wide base is designed to reduce tipover, and the heavy-duty gear train and cam and ball drive make for smooth and reliable watering movement, with the option for full, partial, left or right coverage. Make lawn irrigation an easier and more efficient task.

name: 3800 Sq Ft Plastic Oscillator
description: The pro-series 3800 sq ft oscillator is ideal for watering small to extra-large areas with the easy to slide tabs which adjust the spray distance from full to a partial coverage.

name: 3-Arm Plastic Revolving Sprinkler
description: Stay out of the heat and let the Orbit® 3-Arm Revolving Sprinkler take care of irrigating your lawn or garden. Constructed of durable plastic and ideal for watering medium- to large-sized lawns. Designed to water areas of up to 50' in diameter, this revolving sprinkler has three arms adjustable for angle, pattern, and speed so that your lawn gets just the kind of watering it needs to stay healthy and green all summer.

name: 3-Arm Rotating Sprinkler on Telescoping Base
description: Orbit's 3-Arm Rotating Sprinkler on Telescoping Base provides you with the perfect sprinkler for your medium-sized areas. Water up to 50 feet in diameter from the twirling action of the three arms. The sprinkler adjusts from 21 to 33 inches tall, perfect for watering over growing gardens. This gentle and consistent water spray provides a healthy amount of water to your lawn, garden, shrubs, or flowers without causing any harm. To use, simply choose your desired location, step on the spike to insert the stake into the ground. Attach your garden hose using the easy-swivel connection.

name: 8 Pattern Turret Sprinkler - Assorted Colors
description:
This metal 8 pattern Sprinkler has multiple spray patterns ideal for unique yard shapes and puts water exactly where you need it. Choose from quarter, half, three-quarter, full, square, center strip, end strip or center full spinner.

This product is available in assorted styles/colors. Please visit your nearest Murdoch's Ranch & Home Supply store location for available styles.

name: 8-Pattern Turret Sprinkler
description: Designed for watering uniquely contoured planted areas or garden rows, this Orbit® 8-Pattern Turret Sprinkler is constructed of a high-impact plastic and is compatible with most standard garden hoses. The 8 spray patterns provide more versatility than a circle or square sprinkler: center, ring, half wedge, wedge, square, full moon, half moon, and rectangle.

name: Brass Impact Sprinkler on Ring Base
description: Designed to be used singly or in a sprinkling system, this Orbit® Brass Impact Sprinkler on a metal ring base is a stable and durable choice for all your irrigation needs. The impulse head is adjustable from a full to partial circle for custom coverage, and will sprinkle an area of up to 85' in diameter. This impact head sprinkler is also equipped with an anti-backsplash arm to keep water directed where you want it.

name: Brass Impact Sprinkler on Step Spike
description: Adjustable for up to 90' in diameter, this Orbit® Brass Impact Sprinkler on a step spike may be used either singly or as part of a sprinkler system. The brass impulse head ensures durable and smooth operation, and is equipped with an anti-backsplash arm for maximum coverage control. The heavy-duty zinc deep spike sinks easily into moist ground.

name: Brass Impact Sprinkler on Wheeled Base
description: This Orbit® Brass Impact Sprinkler on a wheeled base is a durable and portable option for irrigating large lawn areas. The durable all-metal base will not tip over, and the large wheels make it easy to move in the most uneven areas of your lawn. Constructed of heavy-duty brass, the impact head will cover up to 90' in diameter, and is equipped with a flow-through outlet to hook up to a system.

name: Brass Impulse Sprinkler on Zinc Spike
description: Orbit's Brass Impulse Sprinkler on Zinc Spike is a classic sprinkler for any yard. This sprinkler has a brass head that will provide years of dependable water coverage and features durable high-impact construction with a metal step spike that is designed to stay anchored in the gound. Covers up to 7800 square feet / 100 ft in diameter and features a flow-through outlet allowing for multiple sprinklers to be connected in series to expand your watering areas. Adjustable from partial to full circle to maximize coverage while giving you the flexibility to tailor what you want to be watered.

name: ColorStorm 4 Pattern Gear Sprinkler
description: Keep your lawn watered with Dramm's ColorStorm 4 pattern gear sprinkler. This gear drive sprinkler is a great mobile, flexible sprinkler for multiple watering applications. Each pattern can be selected by twisting the dial.

name: ColorStorm Turret Sprinkler
description: The ColorStorm Turret Sprinkler from Dramm features nine water patterns to supply maximum functionality. With a heavy duty metal base, this sprinkler also features a molded hook for convenient storage.

name: Compact Gear Drive Sprinkler
description: This Orbit® Compact Gear Drive Sprinkler covers covers from 26' to 80' in diameter, ideal for medium- and large-sized lawns. The sturdy plastic impulse head is adjustable up to 360 degrees, and can be set for 6 rotating patterns: small stream, medium stream, large stream, vertical fan, flat fan and stationary misting pattern. With a metal flow-through spike, it is easy to position and you can connect multiple sprinklers in a series for larger watering areas.

name: Cyclone II Tandem Base Sprinkler
description: The Orbit® Cyclone II Tandem Base Sprinkler produces an upward spray up to 40' in diameter, ideal for plants and spot watering. Fashioned of a lightweight all-metal base, the swivel connection makes it easy to use either individually or in a sprinkler series.

name: Dad's Reliable Sprinkler
description: A durable and time-tested solution for sprinkling small areas of lawn, Dad's Reliable Sprinkler will spray water over areas up to 30' in diameter. Non-puddling and even coverage.

name: Digital 2-Outlet Timer
description: Turn any hose faucet into a programmed sprinkler system within minutes. With water frequency settings from every 6 hours up to every 7th day, The Orbit® Digital 2-Outlet Hose Faucet Timer has a large digital display, oversized dial, and a water-resistant construction for reliable and efficient set-up and use. No power outlet required, as it runs off 2 AA batteries (not included).

name: Digital Watering Timer - 1 Outlet
description: The Orbit Single Outlet Electronic Watering Timer will turn your hose faucet into a programmed sprinkler system in minutes. No more dead plants because you forgot to water them. No more soggy lawns because you forgot to turn the water off. Just set the timer and go. With a large digital display, easy programming, and simple controls, scheduling is fast and easy. Built with high quality materials and water-resistant construction you can count on many years of dependable service.

name: Flex Cobra Flexible Three-Nozzle Mist Stand
description:
The Orbit Flex Cobra Flexible Three-Nozzle Mist Stand has a flexible design that allows for customized direction and uncountable applications for your mist cooling. The Flex Cobra has all of the features to make mist cooling easy - it's freestanding, portable and flexible. Included with each item is an interchangeable flower misting head for a quick decorative look. The versatility of the Flex Cobra allows for watering or misting in virtually any position or situation. The Flex Cobra is designed with ALL of your misting needs in mind.

Available in assorted colors. Please visit your nearest Murdoch's store location for available color choices.

name: H2O-6 Gear Drive Sprinkler on Spike
description: A versatile and uniquely designed irrigation option, the whisper-quiet Orbit® H2O-6 Gear Drive Sprinkler on a spike is an above ground sprinkler ideal for shrubs and flower beds. The gear-drive sprinkler has 6 rotating patterns: small stream, medium stream, large stream, vertical fan, flat fan and stationary misting pattern. Easy-adjust tabs provide 360 degree coverage, and the flow-through spike base allows you to hook this sprinkler into a series.

name: H2O-6 Gear Drive Sprinkler on Tripod
description: Ideal for shrubs and flower beds, the Orbit® H2O-6 Gear Drive Sprinkler on a tripod is a whisper-quiet, above ground watering solution for areas that do not necessarily require heavy-duty irrigation. The gear-drive sprinkler has 6 rotating patterns: small stream, medium stream, large stream, vertical fan, flat fan and stationary misting pattern. The height-adjustable metal tripod has weighted legs for added stability, and the adjustable heavy-duty impulse head will throw water over a 15' to 30' radius, or 30' to 60' in a complete circle.

name: Max Coverage Tri-Pod Sprinkler
description: Keep your lawn and garden watered with Farm & Ranch's Max Coverage Tri-Pod Sprinkler. The fully adjustable sprinkler head has a spray distance of up to 9700 sq. ft.

name: Maxi-Paw Impact Rotor Sprinkler, 1/2 In, 25 To 50 Psi, Plastic
description: This heavy-duty Rain Bird pop-up impact sprinkler is noted for its long-lasting, trouble-free performance with hard water and heavy mineral content that can clog and corrode other sprinklers. It is easy to adjust and comes with 5 extra nozzles to customize watering rate.

name: Mechanical Hose Faucet Timer
description: Requiring neither power nor batteries, this Orbit® Mechanical Hose Faucet Timer works justlike a windup timer. Twist the oversized comfort grip dial to the desired watering duration between 15 and 120 minutes, and it will automatically shut off at the end. Manual watering is also an option with the manual water override. The ergonomic swivel and high-impact construction make this an easy-to-use and durable sprinkler timer.

name: Plastic Impact Sprinkler on Zinc Spike - 2 Pack
description: Ideal for stringing together in a series to cover large areas of lawn, the Orbit® Plastic Impact Sprinkler on Zinc Spike works equally well under both high- and low-pressure water systems. The durable plastic head is adjustable for either a full or partial circle cycle, and will throw water over an area up to 80' in diameter.

name: Plastic Ring Sprinkler
description: This Orbit® Ring Base Sprinkler showers a soft spray over an area up to 30' in diameter. Ideal for newly-seeded lawns and gardens.

name: Port-A-Rain Sprinkler Head
description: This portable Orbit® Port-A-Rain® Sprinkler head will send a fine shower of water over areas of up to 24' in diameter. The adjustable flow nozzle is ideal for use in garden rows or small areas of lawn.

name: Port-A-Rain Tandem System
description: The Orbit® Port-A-Rain® Tandem System is a flexible watering system that attaches to your existing standard garden hose and is ideal for watering large lawns. The two 15 ft reinforced garden hoses will conform to the shape of any lawn, saving you time and money. Includes 5 interchangeable nozzles and 3 Port-A-Rain sprinkler heads for the ultimate in versatile lawn care. Your summer will be a breeze with the Orbit® Port-A-Rain!

name: Pro Flo Metal Mechanical Timer
description: The Pro Flo Mechanical Timer is one of the most simple and user friendly timers. Simply twist the dial to the desired watering duration and the water will automatically shut off. Timer watering can be set from 15to 120 minutes.

name: Pro Series Oscillator
description: The Orbit Irrigation Pro Series oscillating sprinkler is ideal for watering large to extra-large rectangular areas. Easily slide the two tabs to adjust the spray distance from partial to full coverage, as needed, so the sprinkler can conform to the specific needs of your lawn. The wide metal base has been designed to make it easy to reposition your sprinkler and to keep your sprinkler from tipping during watering. Designed with precision nozzles, water is distributed evenly over the entire area. The plug at the end of the spray tube can easily unscrew to reveal a clean-out tool that will keep your nozzles from getting clogged by grit or debris.

name: Sprinkler System Winterization Kit
description: Orbit’s Sprinkler System Winterization Kit is a simple, effective solution for blowing water out of your sprinkler system to help prevent costly freeze damage during cold weather. Designed for reliability and long-term use, the kit features durable brass construction that stands up to repeated seasonal use while providing a secure connection for efficient system clearing. Ideal for protecting irrigation systems before winter sets in, this kit offers dependable performance and peace of mind year after year.

name: T-Post Sprinkler
description: Zinc Impact Sprinkler on Fence T-Post base with flow through. the flow through base allows multiple sprinklers to be connected together creating a larger watering area. The angled hose connector allows for easy attachment to a standard garden hose.

name: T-Post Sprinkler
description: Easy to use and with a coverage area of 85 feet, this Farm & Ranch T-Post Sprinkler saves you valuable time and energy. Simply attach to the top of your T-post, turn on the faucet, and let the sprinkler do the work for you. It's just that easy.

name: Traveling Sprinkler
description: Orbit's Traveling Sprinkler is a self-propelled sprinkler with 3-position speed control (High, Low and Neutral). It will follow a 5/8 inch garden hose in any pattern you create back toward the hose faucet. The shut-off ramp may be placed at any point along the hose to stop the sprinkler. The spray arms are adjustable and great for any diameter from 15 feet to 50 feet. Orbits traveling sprinkler covers up to 13,500 square feet traveling along 200 feet of hose (hose not included). In high gear the sprinkler travels approximately 37 feet per hour applying about ¼ inch of water. In low gear the sprinkler travels approximately 21 feet per hour applying about ½ inch of water. The rust-proof cast iron body and powder-coat paint allow for maximum stability and durability.

name: Traveling Sprinkler Arms and Tee
description: Orbit's Traveling Sprinkler Arms and Tee are replacement sprinkler tubes and tee for the Orbit's Traveling Sprinkler.

name: Traveling Sprinkler Motor Assembly
description: Orbit's Traveling Sprinkler Motor Assembly and wheel replacement is a replacement part for Orbit's Traveling Sprinkler. The motor replacement is easy to install and maintain. For use with Orbit's Traveling Sprinkler.

name: Tripod Sprinkler
description: The heavy-duty brass impact head easily adjusts from 25°-360° with a spray distance of up to 100' in diameter. It is attached to a tripod base that raises from 25" to 48" in height. The base connects easily to a 3/4" standard garden hose by a goose neck attachment.

name: Whirling Yard Sprinkler
description: The Whirling Sprinkler is great for use in a small yard. The circular pattern helps maximize covers.

name: Yard Watering System
description: Fully automatic yard watering kit turns your hose faucet into a 4-station sprinkler system. No digging is required to easily install this watering system. Connects to standard hose faucet to provide 4 hose outlets with 4 independent controls.

name: Zinc Circular Spray Sprinkler
description: This Orbit® Zinc Circular Spray Sprinkler works well for spot watering or newly seeded lawns under both high- and low-pressure water systems. It covers an area of up to 30 sq ft with its fixed circular spray pattern.

name: Zinc Impact Sprinkler on Zinc Flow-Thru Spike
description: Ideal for large lawns, the Orbit® Zinc Impact Head Sprinkler on a zinc flow-thru spike may be used as either a single sprinkler or hooked up to a system. Constructed of heavy-duty metal, it covers up to 85' in diameter and may be adjusted for a full or partial circle cycle. This Orbit® impact head sprinkler is also equipped with a deflector shield and anti-blacksplash arm to keep the spray directed where you need it.

name: Zinc Rectangular Spray Sprinkler
description: Adapted for use with water systems of any pressure, this Orbit® Zinc Rectangular Spray Sprinkler works well for spot watering or newly seeded lawns. The fixed rectangular spray pattern covers an area of up to 30 sq ft.

name: Zinc Square Spray Sprinkler
description: Designed for both high- and low-pressure water systems, this Orbit® Zinc Square Spray Sprinkler works well for spot watering or newly seeded lawns. It covers an area of up to 30 sq. ft, with a fixed square spray pattern.

name: Zinc Twin Circle Spray Sprinkler
description: Ideal for watering small and newly-seeded areas of lawn, the durable Orbit® Zinc Twin Circle Spray Sprinkler will water areas of up to 30' in diameter. The two circle spray nozzles cover a uniform area, and operate equally well under high- or low-pressure water systems.

name: 1/2" and 3/4" Nipple Extractor
description: Orbit's 3 Piece Nipple Extractor Combo includes 2 interchangeable heads for 1/2-inch and 3/4-inch risers and a steel handle. The set extracts broken 1/2-inch and 3/4-inch risers from PVC fittings.

name: 1/2" x  12" Cut-Off Riser
description: Constructed of durable polyethylene for years of reliable use, this molded Orbit® 1/2" x 12" Cut-Off Riser can be cut to the desired length. Connects underground pipe to sprinkler heads. Not for use under continuous pressure.

name: 2" Hard Top with 15' Adjustable Nozzle Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Hard top professional series spray head with 15' adjustable nozzle. Ideal for both residential and commercial landscape areas. metal cap is ideal for yards bordering sidewalks and driveways.

name: 2" Pres Reg Hard Top with 15' Adjustable Nozzle Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Hard top professional series pressure regulated spray head with 15' adjustable nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water, and saving money.

name: 2" Pressure Reg SLPU Full Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with full pattern nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water and saving money.

name: 2" Pressure Reg SLUP Half Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with half pattern nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water and saving money.

name: 2" Pressure Reg SLUP Quarter Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with quarter pattern nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water, and saving money.

name: 2" Pro Hard Top PR Spray Head with Check Valve
description: Orbit’s 2" Pro Hard Top PR Spray Head with Check Valve is a professional-grade solution designed for reliable, precise irrigation performance. Featuring a durable hard top and a 15-foot adjustable nozzle, this spray head allows for accurate coverage and easy pattern control to suit a variety of landscape needs. The integrated Hydro Seal check valve helps eliminate leaks and prevents low-elevation drainage, ensuring consistent water pressure and reducing water waste. Built for dependable operation, this spray head delivers efficient watering with long-lasting durability.

name: 2" SLPU Full Pattern Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Professional series spray head with full pattern nozzle making it ideal for both residential and commercial landscapes.

name: 2" SLPU Half Pattern Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Professional series spray head with half pattern nozzle making it ideal for both residential and commercial landscapes.

name: 2" SLPU Quarter Pattern Sprinkler Head
description: 2" Professional series spray head with quarter pattern nozzle making it ideal for both residential and commercial landscapes.

name: 30" Steel Sprinkler Valve Key
description: The Sprinkler Valve Key opens and closes sprinkler control valves. It is made of heavy-duty steel and is 30" in length.

name: 4" Hard Top SLPU with 15' Adjustable Nozzle Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Hard top professional series spray head with 15' adjustable nozzle. Ideal for both residential and commercial landscape areas. Metal cap is ideal for yards bordering sidewalks and driveways.

name: 4" Pres Reg Hard Top with 15' Adjustable Nozzle Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Hard top professional series pressure regulated spray head with 15' adjustable nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water and saving money.

name: 4" Pres Reg SLUP with 15'  Adjustable Nozzle Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with 15' adjustable nozzle providing uniform coverage. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water and saving money.

name: 4" Pressure Reg SLPU Full Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with full pattern nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water and saving money.

name: 4" Pressure Reg SLUP Half Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with half pattern nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water and saving money.

name: 4" Pressure Reg SLUP Quarter Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Professional series pressure regulated spray head with quarter pattern nozzle. The pre-installed pressure regulator delivers a constant 30 PSI for optimal performance increasing efficiency, conserving water, and saving money.

name: 4" Pro Hard Top PR Spray Head with Check Valve
description: Orbit’s 4" Pro Hard Top PR Spray Head with Check Valve is a professional-grade irrigation solution built for consistent performance and long-term reliability. Designed with a durable hard top and a 15-foot adjustable nozzle, it delivers precise, customizable spray coverage for a wide range of landscape applications. The integrated Hydro Seal check valve eliminates leaks and prevents low-elevation drainage, helping maintain steady water pressure while reducing waste. Engineered for dependable operation, this spray head ensures efficient, uniform watering season after season.

name: 4" Pro PR Spray Head with Check Valve 15' Adjustable Nozzle
description: Orbit’s 4" Pro PR Spray Head with Check Valve and 15' Adjustable Nozzle is a professional-grade irrigation solution designed for dependable, efficient watering. Featuring a 15-foot adjustable nozzle, it allows for precise spray pattern and distance control to meet a variety of landscape needs. The built-in Hydro Seal check valve helps eliminate leaks and prevents low-elevation drainage, ensuring consistent water pressure while reducing waste. Built for reliable performance, this spray head delivers uniform coverage and long-lasting durability in residential and commercial irrigation systems.

name: 4" SLPU Full Pattern Sprinkler Head

name: 4" SLPU Quarter Pattern Sprinkler Head
description: 4" Professional series spray head with quarter pattern nozzle making it ideal for both residential and commercial landscapes.

name: 4" SLPU with 15' Adjustable Nozzle Sprinkler Head
