name: Saturn III Pop-Up Gear Drive Sprinkler
description: The Orbit® Saturn III® Pop-Up Gear Drive Sprinkler is a convenient and cost-efficient underground gear drive head for watering medium-sized lawns. The head throws water over a radius of 15' to 30', and can be adjusted for half or full circle spray distribution. The gear drive rotor is compatible with most major brands of rotors, and emits a quiet and even spray.

name: Voyager II Pop-Up Gear Drive Sprinkler
description: An improvement on the traditional pop-up sprinkler head, the Orbit® Voyager II® Pop-Up Gear Drive Sprinkler does not make the clicking sound of conventional impact heads, making this a whisper-quiet option for your home sprinkling system. Ideal for medium- to large-sized lawns, the spray diameter of 40-80 ft. can be adjusted to anywhere between 40 and 360 degrees, offering flexible options for varied areas of your garden. The precipitation rate is lower for reduced runoff in sloped areas or clay soil.

name: 144 oz Aqua Rite Watering Cans - Assorted
description: Make plant care effortless and stylish with the Bloem® Aqua Rite Watering Can, 144 oz—offered in a range of trendy colors to brighten up your indoor gardening routine. With a generous 144 oz capacity, this watering can is perfect for larger houseplants or multiple containers, reducing the need for frequent refills. Its comfortable handle and precision spout ensure easy, controlled pouring, while the modern design adds a pop of personality to any space. Both functional and fashionable, the Aqua Rite is a must-have for any plant enthusiast.

name: 2 Gallon Steel Watering Can
description: Behren's 2 gallon watering can is perfect for your home outdoor watering needs. Weighing under 20 lbs when filled, this watering can is ideal for smaller watering needs or something requiring a lighter can.

name: 2-Gallon Watering Can
description: Introducing the Iceberg NEW WaterPro™ Watering Cans - where ergonomics meets elegance. These American-made watering cans are designed to enhance your gardening experience with a perfect blend of functionality and style.

name: 4-Pack Never-Dry Plant Pal Ceramic Stake
description: Keep your plants hydrated effortlessly with the Syndicate Never-Dry Plant Pal™ 4-Pack—durable ceramic stakes designed to slowly infuse water directly into the soil. Perfect for busy schedules or vacation getaways, simply pair each stake with your own empty bottle for a hassle-free, self-watering solution. These easy-to-use ceramic spikes provide consistent moisture to your plants’ roots, helping them thrive even when you're away. Ideal for houseplants and container gardens, the Plant Pal takes the guesswork out of watering.

name: 500mL Plant Water/Squirt Bottle
description: The Mossify® squirtr 500mL in Clear is the perfect solution for precision watering in hard-to-reach spaces. Designed with a slim, flexible nozzle, this handy squirt bottle lets you easily hydrate the roots of your plants without disturbing foliage or soil. Ideal for tight spots and delicate greenery, it holds up to 500mL (16.9 oz) of water or any liquid with similar properties. Whether you're caring for houseplants, terrariums, or seedlings, the Mossify squirtr offers controlled, mess-free watering in a compact, easy-to-use design.

name: 56 oz Aqua Rite Watering Cans - Assorted
description: Keep your plants happy and hydrated with the Bloem® Aqua Rite Watering Can, 56 oz—now available in a variety of trendy colors to match your personal style. Designed for easy indoor use, this lightweight watering can features a comfortable handle and precise spout for controlled, mess-free watering. Its compact size and stylish design make it both a functional tool and a cheerful accent for any plant lover’s home. Perfect for houseplants, herbs, and small containers, the Aqua Rite brings a splash of color and convenience to your plant care routine.

name: 6.5” Vintage Plant Mister
description: Elevate your plant care routine with the Syndicate Home & Garden® 6.5" Vintage Plant Mister in Clear. Designed to provide a gentle mist of humidity, this compact glass mister is perfect for keeping your houseplants healthy and hydrated. Its elegant vintage design adds a touch of charm to any plant shelf, while the easy-to-use pump ensures quick and effortless misting. Stylish, functional, and ideal for tropical plants, this classic mister is a must-have accessory for any indoor gardener.

name: Mistr Battery Powered Electric Plant Mister
description: Experience effortless plant care with the Mossify® mistr™ in White—a sleek, battery-powered electric mister designed to keep your houseplants thriving. Featuring a long-lasting rechargeable battery, the mistr delivers a fine, even mist at the touch of a button, making it easier than ever to maintain the humidity your plants love. With its modern design and unmatched functionality, it's perfect not only for misting plants but also for disinfecting and applying water-soluble solutions. Stylish and versatile, the Mossify mistr™ is a must-have tool for plant lovers and home care alike.

name: Single Watering Stake with Vintage Bottle Never-Dry Plant Pal Kit - Assorted
description: Keep your plants thriving while you’re away with the Syndicate Never-Dry Plant Pal™ Kit, featuring a single ceramic watering stake paired with a charming vintage-style bottle. This easy-to-use self-watering system slowly releases moisture directly to your plant’s roots, ensuring consistent hydration whether you're home or on vacation. Simply fill the included bottle, insert it into the ceramic stake, and let your plant enjoy worry-free care. Stylish and practical, the Never-Dry Plant Pal Kit is the perfect blend of function and vintage flair for any plant lover.

name: Watering Can
description: Gardener Select’s Watering Can blends practical performance with eye-catching style, featuring a durable metal construction designed for everyday use. Finished in a vibrant color that brightens any garden space, it also includes a protective coating that helps guard against rust, ensuring long-lasting reliability while making watering your plants both efficient and enjoyable.

name: 100' X-Flex Kink Proof Hose
description: For the upmost in kink-resistance, Swan's X-Flex garden hose features the new X-Flex Continuous Flow Filament, a flexible, plastic, X-shaped filament that runs through the center of the hose. The "X" shape of the filament, with its four open V-shaped areas, allows for continuous flow of water throughout the hose to prevent kinks. The technology is so powerful that even if you fold the XFlex garden hose over itself multiple times, the open pathways provided by the filament allow the water to keep running, pushing through even the most severe kinks.

name: 15' 5/8" Leader Hose
description: An Essential Component to Your Garden Equipment: The 6 ft. leader garden hose is the perfect piece of equipment for serious gardeners to have around. You can use it to attach a hose reel to your water supply or to help your favorite hose reach an out-of-the-way spigot. Fits Most Standard Reels: The flexible PVC construction of this short garden hose allows it to easily roll around most reels and its length is just enough for it to stay put. A Great Supply Hose for a Number of Applications: A handy tool to have around the house, this short water hose can reliably connect accessories, help with maintenance jobs or reach hanging house plants. Robust Construction in a Compact Format: This small hose is made of nylon-reinforced PVC, complete with sturdy crush proof couplings. When not in use, it is small and light enough to easily roll up and store.

name: 3/4" Industrial Farming Hose
description: The John Deere Industrial Farming Hose is a premium rubber garden hose that’s powerful and strong yet easy to handle. It has a 500 PSI burst strength and an exclusive rubber formula which makes it 2X stronger and 40% lighter than standard rubber hoses.

name: 5/8" Garden Heavy Duty Hose
description: The swan heavy-duty garden hose has a 400 PSI burst strength to give you a powerful water flow, as well as a thicker construction than average garden hoses for strength and reinforcement. It also has a soft and supple abrasion-resistant exterior, making it comfortable to the touch and effortless to unwind and unravel.

name: 5/8" Garden Medium Duty Hose
description: The weather flex hose is built tough for medium duty use in all temperatures. Solid brass couplings along with a knit reinforcement, make this hose very popular with the" Weekend warrior" Gardener. Added reinforcement for kink resistance. From America. 1 hose manufacturer- Chlorite. 5/8" Diameter by 50" Length.

name: 50' 3/8" Soaker Specialty Hose
description: For an efficient, economical and eco-friendly way to water your plants, look no further than the element soaker pro® soaker hose by swan. Featuring tiny holes or “pores” along its length, the soaker pro® soaker hose weeps water directly to plants’ root systems at a rate of 0.5 gallon–1 gallon per foot per hour on ground level. This not only reduces evaporation, but also uses up to 70 percent less water than a conventional sprinkler. To further reduce water consumption, we’be added a patented blue water restrict or in the female coupling to control water pressure and flow. The soaker pro® soaker hose is very lightweight, which makes it easy to wind around plants and set under soil or mulch. Once established, you no longer have to carry or drag a cumbersome garden hose to water your garden. In addition, your delicate flowers, foliage and vegetables are protected from the intense water pressure that comes from a traditional water hose and/or nozzle. The soaker pro® soaker hose is made from 65 percent recycled rubber and backed by a 7-year warranty. It’s also lead-free and compliant with California’s strict phthalate-content standards, so no harmful chemicals or odors are added to your water supply

name: 50' 5/8" Rubber Hose
description: Built Tough and Light: This Goodyear hose is made of an innovative material that's designed to be 40% lighter than ordinary rubber hoses. Its special patented compound ensures that it's equipped for the most crucial commercial applications, boasting a high side pressure of over 400 plus psi. Ready for Extreme Conditions: The heavy-duty water hose will stay flexible and easy to handle. It can withstand temperatures all the way down to -40°F and is hot-water rated all the way up to 165°F so it can be used in the most demanding of conditions. Designed to Last: This light rubber hose is equipped on both ends with robust crush-proof couplings for on-the-job dependability and patented hose armor that prevents kinking at the spigot. Safe For Your Family: You can safely use this rubber hose at the farm, at home in the garden or in an industrial kitchen. It's lead-free and drinking water safe and meets the lead free standard under the Federal Safe Drinking Water Act.

name: 50' PolyFusion Hose
description: The DEWALT Professional Water Hose is designed to withstand the abuse of your job site. Constructed from a unique blend of polymers that deliver heavy duty performance with maximum flexibility.

name: AG-Lite Heavy-Duty Rubber Water Hose
description: The BluBird AG-Lite Heavy-Duty Premium Rubber Water Hose is a high-quality hose that is 40% lighter than standard rubber hoses, making it easy to handle and maneuver. Crafted from premium EPDM rubber with reinforced polyester braiding, it's built to last and can handle hot water up to 212F. It maintains flexibility in extreme conditions, ranging from -50F to plus 190F. Whether you're watering your garden or tackling tough outdoor tasks, this hose is a dependable choice for your watering needs.

name: Contractor Farm Hose
description: For those who need to supply a high volume of water over a large area such as a farm, construction site or stretch of landscape, the Element Contractor FARM water hose has several features that make it the ideal contractor farm hose for both construction and agricultural needs, from cleaning debris off a worksite to watering trees. This Element contractor hose features an excellent 500+ PSI burst strength, powerful enough to handle the high-water pressure necessary for extreme work conditions. Heavyweight reinforcements at key areas provide maximum durability and prevent the industrial hose from bursting and the octagonal shape makes it highly kink resistant. Our patented Hose Armour at the female coupling also prevents kinking at the water source. To make this heavy-duty garden hose even more resilient, we've added extra-large aluminum couplings that are damage-resistant if run over by heavy equipment, as well as an oversized female coupling that connects to the water source without a wrench or other tools. This extra-large 3/4-inch 50ft water hose moves 20% more water than standard 5/8-inch heavy duty hoses, giving you the power and water capacity needed to get your jobs done quickly. the 100' hose is 5/8-inch.

name: Expandable Burst Proof Garden Hose
description: Enjoy reliable performance and optimal water flow thanks to HydroTech's Patented Force Control Technology that protects from bursting and breaking. Weighing significantly less than a traditional garden hose, this hose is lightweight, tangle free, and easy to manage. No more dealing with a knotted-up hose before and after you work! When not in use, the expandable hose shrinks down to a compact size for hassle-free storage, making it perfect for saving space in your garage or shed. HydroTech is built to be the only hose you'll ever need — durable, flexible, and engineered for consistent, optimal water pressure. Water Anything, Anywhere with HydroTech.

name: Farm & Ranch Hose
description: Teknor Apex's Farm & Ranch 5/8" x 100' Hose is an all-purpose durable hose that is great for the ranch. It features a power coil that stops kinking at the faucet and a leak-proof, SealFast lead-free coupling for watertight connections. Now leaky faucets will finally be at an end! Coupled with a heavy duty radial braid reinforcement for high burst strength and a thick abrasion-resistant outer layer, this hose will stand up to just about anything.

name: Farm and Ranch 100' Hose
description: This all-purpose durability Farm & Ranch heavy duty hose features power coil which prevents kinking at the faucet, brass couplings ensure a leak proof, water tight connection.

name: GHT Fittings Garden Hose
description: Flexzilla Garden Hose is engineered with a Flexible Hybrid Polymer that is both lightweight and durable. This premium hose redefines flexibility and is easy to maneuver around your yard. Flexzilla Garden Hose has zero memory which allows the hose to lay flat and ensures that sprinklers stay put without twisting. Its durable outer cover is abrasion-resistant, and the reinforced mid-layering provides extra strength. Plus, with our superior O-ring, you get a long-term, leak-free connection at the spigot. The Flexible Hybrid Polymer inner tube material is drinking water safe.

name: Heavy Duty Fabric Garden Hose
description: Get back to enjoying your watering tasks with the innovative Orbit Heavy-Duty Fabric Hose. This lightweight, professional-grade hose features AntiKink® technology to supply the best watering experience yet. The unique Exojacket® construction serves as an external barrier that will uphold its integrity throughout a lifetime of watering. These combined technologies supply a robust water flow providing 600 PSI burst strength. Wrench-free, crush-resistant anodized aluminum couplings with a heavy-duty, easy-to-grip collar at both ends makes installation a breeze. The Orbit Heavy-Duty Fabric Hose combines the most valued features in watering functionality to date. Lightweight yet sturdy, flexible, kink resistant, and portable; this hose is ideal for all your professional, garden, automotive, agricultural, and irrigation needs.

description: Enjoy reliable performance and optimal water flow thanks to HydroTech's Patented Force Control Technology that protects from bursting and breaking. The swivel connector makes this 4-port manifold easy to install, and the solid shut off control keeps the water flow as heavy or light as you need it. name: Brass Hose Y with Shut-Off
description: The Orbit® Brass Hose Y with Shut-Off lets you hook up two hoses to one faucet, helping you to avoid dragging hoses around the lawn to get water where you need it. name: Easy Clean Filter

name: GHT Fittings SwivelGrip Garden Hose GHT Fittings
description: Premium Flexzilla® SwivelGrip® Garden Hose makes it easier to work around your home and lawn. SwivelGrip action eliminates twists that occur when uncoiling a hose. Conventional garden hose can trap coils that tighten into kinks as you move across the yard. SwivelGrip allows the hose and grip to rotate independently, releasing coils naturally, easily and effortlessly. The large, comfortable gripping surface on both ends of the hose lets you use the power of your entire hand to make tight connections easy. Flexzilla SwivelGrip Garden Hoses are engineered with a lightweight Flexible Hybrid Polymer which lays flat, eliminates kinking under pressure and is drinking water safe.

name: Hose Coupling with Coil Hose Protect
description: The Pro Flo Hose Coupling with Flexible Outlet prevents your hose from bending and kinking at the connection point. Convenient valve control lets you adjust the flow of water or shut off.

name: Hose Washer Combo Pack
description: The O-ring design of these washers in the Orbit® Hose Washers Combo Pack provides a superior water-tight seal on hose connectors. The soft and resilient material resists hardening and cracking. 12-pack.

name: HydroSeal Hose Washer Set - 8 Piece
description: The HydroSeal Hose Washer expanding seal technology, creates a watertight leak-free connection. As water flows through the HydroSeal hose washer, the neck of the washer expands to fit snugly against the inside of the hose, stopping leaks, and keeping your arms and legs dry when using your hose. Washers are soft and resilient for a water-tight seal. They resist hardening and cracking. Includes normal hose washers to use on the faucet end, and for use on coiled and specialty hoses.

name: Male Brass Quick Connect
description: The Orbit® Male Brass Quick Connect is an essential component of the Brass Quick Connect Set, which allows you to quickly swap out hose-ends without wrenching the hose connection. This male product adapter threads into any standard nozzle, sprinkler or other watering tool and works with the female coupling connection (sold separately).

name: Metal Gooseneck with Shut-off
description: Orbit's Metal Gooseneck with Shut-off operates as a shut-off valve for hose faucets. Use at the faucet connection, or even at the end of a sprinkler, to adjust flow control. Our leak-free ball valve allows you to adjust the flow, whether you want it off, just a trickle, or full flow. A swivel hose connection ensures easy installation while durable brass construction provides years of use.

name: Metal Hose Y with Shut-offs
description: Orbit's Metal Hose Y with Shut-offs converts one faucet into two, allowing you to use two hoses from the same faucet. Convenient valve controls let you adjust the flow or shut-off of each connection. The 3/4" male-threaded connection has a swivel head for easy installation. Heavy-duty metal construction with leak-free ball valve ensures quality performance. For outdoor cold water use only.

name: Metal Manifold with Shut-offs
description: Orbit's Metal Manifold with Shut-offs converts your faucet into a 4-faucet hose connection. Convenient valve controls let you adjust the flow, or shut-off each connection individually. The 3/4" male-threaded connection has a brass swivel head with comfort grip for easy installation. Heavy-duty construction with leak-free ball valves ensures quality performance. For outdoor cold water use only.

name: Plastic Hose Caps
description: Built of durable plastic, these Orbit® Plastic Hose Caps are designed to cap off all standard-sized hose and sprinklers. Sold individually.

name: Plastic Hose Y with Shut-Off
description: Your days of dragging garden hoses around the yard are over. This Orbit® Plastic Hose Y with Shut-Off is constructed of durable non-corrosive plastic. Use the Hose Y with Shut-Off to hook up two hoses to one faucet and create a convenient multi-hose solution to lawn care and gardening. The leak-proof ball valves minimize water waste.

name: Plastic Quick Connect Set
description: When swapping out hose heads, it isn't easy to twist and wrench the hose connection; with the Orbit® Plastic Quick Connect Set, you will minimize wrenching and keep your hose connection lasting longer. This quick connect set includes the female coupling connection for the garden hose and the male product adapter for the hose-end watering tool.

name: Plastic Shut-Off Coupling
description: The Orbit® Plastic Coupling with Shut-Off is a durable and simple-to-use shut-off valve for your sprinkler hoses. Compatible with all standard faucet and garden hoses, and equipped with fingertip flow control.

name: Pro Flo Coupling
description: The Pro FLo Hose Faucet connector provides convenient valve controls that let you adjust the flow of water highlighted by its larger valve control handle.

name: Pro Flo™ Hose Y with a Flexible Outlet
description: The Orbit® Pro Flo™ Overmolded Brass Outlet Metal Hose Y with a Flexible Outlet converts one faucet into two for a convenient multi-hose hookup, making lawn and garden care much easier. The flexible outlets work to prevent hose kinks and help your hoses last longer. The valve controls allow you to adjust the separate flows or shut-off each connection, maximizing efficiency and minimizing water waste.

name: Push Fit Menders Female
description: The push fit 5/8" female hose mender is designed to repair breaks and leaks in standard 5/8" garden hose.

name: Push Fit Menders Male
description: The push fit 5/8" male hose mender is designed to repair breaks and leaks in standard 5/8" garden hose.

name: Push Fit Repair Mender
description: The push fit 5/8" repair hose mender is designed to repair breaks and leaks in standard 5/8" garden hose.

name: Shut-off Valve
description: Control fresh water flow on your RV with Camco quarter-turn pressure seated shut-off valve. This Y-style valve converts a single-line hose to two directions. Each side is valve controlled to easily adjust flow and pressure.

name: Steel Hose Hanger
description: This traditional style metal hose hanger is designed to hold 50' to 100' long of garden hose and will provide years of performance.

name: Ultimate 5/8" Female Mender
description: The Orbit® Ultimate 5/8" Female Mender is designed to replace the female attachment end of most 5/8" hoses. Its sleek, heavy-duty brass construction guarantees top-notch performance for years on ribbed, kink-free hoses. The sleek, tight-fitting mender will keep your hose attachment in top condition for years.

name: Ultimate 5/8" Repair Mender
description: Keep your hose rip- and leak-free with this Orbit® Ultimate 5/8" Repair Mender, designed for ribbed, kink-free hose. Its sleek and heavy-duty brass construction can be depended on for years of irrigation and lawn care.

name: Vinyl Hose Washers

name: Yard Watering Kit Valve

name: Y-Valve
description: Fimco dual hose y-valve shutoff

name: 5" Brass Sweeper Nozzle
description: A heavy duty hose end nozzle with ergo grip great for cleaning up driveways and street gutters

name: 8-Pattern Q-series Nozzle
description: The Q-series nozzle with rear trigger control is made with a solid metal interior and a rubber over mold to provide both durability and comfort. Eight spray options ensure every watering need is covered, from a gentle shower spray for plants, to a jet spray to clean debris from gardening tools, and many others in between. The convenient rear trigger allows you to control water pressure at the nozzle, avoiding bothersome trips back to the faucet. The handgrip is insulated, not only to protect the hand from extreme water temperatures, but also to provide a comfortable grip.

name: 9-Pattern Fireman Grip Wand
description: Equipped with a ratcheting head for snaking into hanging plants and cramped corners of your garden, the Orbit® 36" 9-Pattern Fireman Grip Wand with a ratcheting head offers 9 spray patterns for various watering tasks. The control lever grip makes for easy on-the-spot flow adjustment.

name: 9-Pattern Revolver
description: Dramm's 9-Pattern Revolver is easy to use with an ergonomic insulated grip and quick-click pattern changing. Available in a variety of colors, you'll find a revolver that fits your style.

name: 9-Pattern Turret Wand
description: The Orbit® 9-Pattern Turret Wand has an extended cushioned grip for comfortable and efficient watering of hanging baskets, shrubs and hard-to-reach places in your garden. The flow control knob with shut-off lever allows for convenient flow adjustment.

name: Brass Adjustable Nozzle
description: This Orbit® 5" Adjustable Brass Nozzle shifts between fine mist and jet stream sprays for versatile use in your yard or garden. The mist is suitable for delicate plants, and the jet stream for scrubbing your patio, driveway, or siding. The durable brass construction is rust-resistant, and the comfort grip makes it easy to install.

name: Brass Sweeper Nozzle
description: Powerful enough for washing walkways and driveways, this Orbit® Brass Sweeper Nozzle delivers a high-impact broom-shaped spray that can tackle any outdoor job, including rinsing gutters and siding. The brass construction is rust-resistant, and the comfort grip makes it easy to attach.

name: Compact 7-Pattern Turret Pistol
description: The rear trigger on this Orbit® Compact 7-Pattern Zinc Turret Pistol locks in place to provide a continuous spray without causing hand fatigue. Set up for 7 varied spray patterns, this pistol nozzle is a conveniently-sized hose attachment for all your watering needs.

name: D-Grip 7-Pattern Thumb Control Turret Pistol
description: The Pro Flo thumb control D-Grip Turret Nozzle features a unique flow-through design that maximizes water pressure. The easy thumb control modifies water pressure, allowing a quick adjustment to the flow of water without going back to the faucet.

name: Fire Hose Nozzle
description: The Fire hose Nozzle provides a powerful water output, with spray options that range from a tight forceful stream to a power away dirt and debris, to a wide spray perfect for tackling larger areas.

name: Front Trigger 10-Pattern Turret Wand - Assorted
description:
Outfitted with a turret head with 10 pattern options for various watering projects, the Orbit® Front Trigger Turret Wand with a ratcheting head is a lightweight and durable hose attachment designed to reach hanging baskets and cramped corners of your garden. The locking front trigger provides continuous flow, with a control lever for convenient flow control.

This product is available in assorted styles/colors. Please visit your nearest Murdoch's Ranch & Home Supply store location for available styles.

name: Front Trigger 7-Pattern Turret Nozzle
description: The locking front trigger on this Orbit® Front Trigger 7-Pattern Turret Nozzle provides a continuous spray without inducing hand fatigue. The 7 spray patterns make this a handy tool for various watering tasks, and the insulated comfort grip makes it a pleasure to use.

name: Front Trigger Adjustable Nozzle
description: Attach this attractive Orbit® front trigger adjustable nozzle to your garden hose for versatile and easy lawn and garden care. The flow control lever allows you to adjust between a fan spray and jet stream for both delicate and hardy plantings. The brass finish on this nozzle is a refreshing alternative to conventional nozzle designs.

name: Hot Water Contractor Nozzle
description: This contractor grade nozzle has an insulated rubber grip for spraying hot or cold water up to 140° F. Adjust the spray from a powerful jet spray perfect for clearing away debris to a wide fan ideal for rinsing. To modify water pressure, a rear trigger flow control allows a quick adjustment to the flow of water without going back to the faucet.

name: Hot Water Rear-Trigger Nozzle
description: This contractor grade nozzle has an insulated rubber grip for spraying hot or cold water up to 140° F. This nozzle offers a choice in spray patterns; find the right one for every task in the home and garden, including a powerful jet spray perfect for clearing away debris. The soft touch dial guard makes it easy to select patterns even when wet. To modify water pressure, a rear trigger flow control allows a quick adjustment to the flow of water without going back to the faucet.

name: Hydro Cannon
description: Don’t let water pressure limit you. Multiple patterns allow you to select patterns to optimize to get the most performance from this nozzle. Rugged construction and superior ergonomics make this ideal for a wide variety of watering applications.

name: Industrial Hot Water Spray Pistol
description: Designed to withstand hot water temperatures up to 160 degrees at 100 PSI, this Dramm Industrial Hot Water Spray Pistol is ideal for commercial and industrial spraying needs. Features a fully adjustable spray pattern. The front is threaded, allowing the option to attach additional cleaning nozzles with ease. The heavy-duty construction and thermal insulating rubber grip provides easy control and comfort.

name: Metal Fan Sprayer with Shut-Off
description: Equipped with a convenient flow control lever and insulated hand grip, this Orbit® Metal Fan Spray with Shut-Off is a durable watering nozzle that emits a gentle spray ideal for flowers and newly-seeded areas. The durable aluminum construction will take you from planting season to harvest.

name: One Touch Revolution Spray Gun
description: Enjoy the comfort, style, and precision under your thumb with Dramm's One Touch Revolution Spray Gun with 9-spray pattern options. Easily switch between water flow selections with the quick-change features. The revolution 9-pattern spray gun is equipped with the one touch valve allowing complete and total water flow control with just one touch of your thumb. The revolution comes with a lifetime guarantee and is available in six vibrant colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and berry. The ergonomic design, heavy-duty metal construction and eye-catching color will revolutionize the way you look at hand watering.

name: Pattern Turret Torch
description: The 10 pattern nozzle with Turret Torch design features a shut off lever that is easy to use and provides flow control.

name: Pro Flo 7-Pattern Turret 14" Thumb Control D-Grip Wand
description: The Pro Flo 7-Pattern Wand offers a heavy-duty metal construction as well as increased flow with a unique flow design. The thumb control lever offers a convenient flow control to modify water pressure without going back to the faucet.

name: Pro Flo Adjustable Nozzle D-Grip Thumb
description: The Pro Flo thumb control D-Grip Adjustable Nozzle features a unique flow-through design that maximizes water pressure. The easy thumb control modifies water pressure, allowing a quick adjustment to the flow of water without going back to the faucet.

name: Q Series Adjustable Nozzle
description: This rear trigger adjustable nozzle is made with solid metal interior and a rubber overmold to provide both durability and comfort. Adjustable spray feature allows you to spray from a fine mist to a targeted jet stream.

name: Q-Series 14" 8 Pattern Wand
description: The Orbit 14" thumb control 8-pattern wand offers a choice in spray options; find the right one for every task in the yard and garden. They are constructed with high quality materials that will last season after season. The convenient thumb control knob allows you to easily adjust the water flow without hand fatigue. It also allows you to shut off the water without going back to the faucet, which helps conserve water. The handgrip is over molded, not only to protect your hand from extreme water temperatures, but also to provide a comfortable grip.

name: Reaper X-Stream Nozzle
description: The X-Stream Reaper Water Multi Pattern Nozzle offers a choice in spray selections; find the right fit for every task in the home and garden, from quickly filling a bucket to a powerful jet spray perfect for clearing debris.

name: Shower Wand with Zinc Head
description: The extra-long comfort grip handle on this lightweight Orbit® 33" Shower Wand makes it easy to reach hanging baskets and cramped corners in your garden or yard. The gentle rain-like shower is ideal for delicate plants and flowers, and the shut-off lever provides convenient flow adjustment on the spot. This wand features a durable, corrosion-resistant zinc head.

name: Super Nozzle
description:
Little Big Shot is Made in the USA and assembled by disabled US Veterans.

The Little Big Shot Super Nozzle is pound for pound the most effective, water-efficient nozzle you can buy. Fits any standard hose and adjusts from powerful sweeper to spray for watering plants, to even a pin point stream!

Manufactured from solid brass, the Little Big Shot weighs only a fraction of other adjustable nozzles, requiring far less material from our environment to make. The Little Big Shot Super Nozzle is a simply superior and EARTH-FRIENDLY hose nozzle!

name: Tech Plastic Nozzle - Dual Pack
description: These Orbit® Tech Plastic Nozzles provide a variable flow rate for your diverse watering needs. Equipped with an insulated comfort grip and a locking metal clip for easy continuous watering, these hose heads feature a Turret Nozzle with 7 spray patterns, as well as an adjustable flow rate that builds from a fan spray to a jet stream.

name: Touch-N-Flow Pistol Nozzle
description: This variable spray gun is a great tool for cleaning decks, sidewalks, cars, and more. Simply squeeze lever for a variety of spray patterns. Constructed of heavy-duty metal and designed with an ergonomic insulated grip for comfort and durability.

name: Zinc Pistol with Rubber Grip - Assorted
description:
A contractor-grade watering pistol, the Orbit® Zinc Pistol with a rubber grip emits a light spray for watering flowerbeds and new growth, and a powerful jet spray for scrubbing siding, walkways, and gutters. The removable cap covers a threaded tip that easily connects to other watering accessories. This zinc watering pistol can be used with water up to 160° F.

Please visit your nearest Murdoch's Ranch & Home Supply for available colors.

name: A-List Low-Input Grass Seed Mixture
description: X-Seed’s A-List Low-Input Grass Seed Mixture is a premium solution for repairing, over-seeding, and thickening lawns while keeping maintenance to a minimum. Certified for low input by A-List, the Alliance for Low Input and Sustainable Turf, this advanced blend features drought-tolerant and high-traffic grass varieties that deliver strong, resilient growth while reducing water demands. Designed for sun to light shade, the all-in-one mixture helps improve soil quality, combat common lawn diseases, and stand up to everyday wear, making it ideal for busy, hard-working lawns. With visible progress in just days, X-Seed’s A-List Mixture makes it easy to achieve a healthier, greener lawn with less effort and fewer inputs.

name: Bermudagrass Coated Grass Seed
description: X-Seed Unhulled Coated Bermuda grass coated seed grows in full sun in southern states. Durable and long lasting.

name: Bluegrass Lawn Seed Blend
description: X-Seed’s Ultra Premium Bluegrass blend lawn seed mixture will help you develop a lush, sod-like lawn that thrives in full sun. It’s durable and long lasting, and it will germinate in around 21 days after planting. There’s enough in this bag to cover 800 square feet.

name: ChickenMax Layer Chicken Forage Seed Mixture
description: DLF Chicken Max is an economical and highly nutritious way to supplement your chicken feed

name: Complete Lawn Seed Fix
description: X-Seed’s Complete Lawn Fix is a tall fescue seed mixture that will have your lawn’s bald or thinning spots looking good in no time. The seeds germinate in seven to ten days, so you won’t have to wait long to see results. The bag comes loaded with nutrients and moisture boosting crystals in addition to seeds, making it easy to use. All you have to do is add water!

name: Cover Max Seed Mix
description: Cover Max is a mix of cereal grains and legumes to provide cover and nitrogen production as well as many other cover cropping benefits such as weed suppression, erosion control, and reducing soil compaction.

name: Dog Spot Treatment
description: Organic-based treatment to repair dog spots. It is safe for kids and pets. Has enough to repair 120 damage spots on your lawn.

name: EZ Seed Patch & Repair Bermudagrass
description: Scotts® EZ Seed® Patch & Repair Bermudagrass is a revolutionary seeding product designed to grow in tough conditions! The unique combination of Scotts® high performance seed, premium continuous release lawn food, and super-absorbent growing material, make it possible for grass to grow in tough conditions, guaranteed!* Plus, Scotts® EZ Seed® now has a tackifier to reduce seed wash-away on sloped areas of your lawn. *Subject to proper care.

name: EZ Seed Patch & Repair Sun and Shade
description: Scotts EZ Seed Patch & Repair Sun and Shade is a revolutionary seeding mix that guarantees seeding success. The unique combination of Scotts high performance seed, premium continuous release lawn food, and super-absorbent growing material makes it possible for grass to grow anywhere. Scotts EZ Seed now has a tackifier to reduce seed wash-away on sloped areas of your lawn. 3.75 lb Container will cover up to 85 sq ft.

name: EZ Seed Patch & Repair Tall Fescue Lawns
description: Scotts® EZ Seed® Patch & Repair Tall Fescue Lawns is a revolutionary seeding mix that guarantees seeding success! The unique combination of Scotts® high performance seed, premium continuous release lawn food, and Scotts® super-absorbent growing material, make it possible for grass to grow anywhere, guaranteed!* Scotts® EZ Seed® now has a tackifier to reduce seed wash away on sloped areas of your lawn! Scotts best high performance grass seed. Mulch absorbs 6X its weight in water and expands to surround the seed in a moist protective layer. Exclusive controlled fertilizer release technology feeds seedlings to jumpstart growth. *Subject to proper care.

name: Fast Lawn Seed Mix
description: X-Seed Fast Lawn seed mixture is designed to beef up your lawn and help fill in balding spots. It’s a mix of annual and perennial ryegrass, allowing it to blend well with existing grass. It grows quickly, so you can get your lawn looking thicker in no time.

name: Food Plot Forage Seed Mixture
description: Fill the field of your choice with plant life that game animals love with Hunter’s Paradise Annual Attraction. Formulated to thrive in Northern climates, these seeds produce plants that are high in protein and minerals that promote good antler growth. This 25-pound bag has enough seed to cover one acre of ground.

name: Hardy Lawn Ultra Premium Lawn Seed Mixture
description: X-Seed Ultra Premium Hardy Lawn 7 lb. Lawn Seed Mixture is premium seed mixture guaranteed to grow and is 99.9 percent weed free. Comparable to national brands with greater value.

name: Knee-High Meadow Mix
description: X-Seed’s Knee-High Meadow Mix is a thoughtfully curated blend of 26 beautiful wildflower species, featuring approximately 70% annuals and 30% perennials to deliver both quick color and lasting blooms year after year. Selected for their natural charm, extended flowering periods, and low-growing habits, these flowers create a lush, meadow-style display without overwhelming the landscape. Under normal growing conditions, the mix reaches an attractive height of 18–24 inches, making it perfect for adding texture and color while maintaining a tidy, manageable look. With approximately 39,000 seeds per mix, X-Seed’s Knee-High Meadow Mix can cover up to 450 square feet, transforming open spaces into vibrant, pollinator-friendly meadows with ease.

name: Landscaper Select Lawn Seed Mixture
description: X-Seed Landscaper Mix is formulated to grow quick cover and fill in thin areas. Grows in full sun and light shade. Contains 70-percent annual ryegrass, 15-percent fine fescue, 5-percent perennial ryegrass, 10-percent kentucky bluegrass

name: Lawn Seed Mixture Bluegrass Blend
description: X-Seed Ultra Premium Bluegrass Blend 3 lb. Lawn Seed Mixture is premium seed mixture guaranteed to grow and is 99.9-percent weed free. Comparable to national brands with greater value.

description: X-Seed Moisture Boost Plus Sun to Shade Lawn Seed Mixture is premium polymer coated seed mixture guaranteed to grow and is 99.9-percent weed free. Comparable to national brands with greater value.

description: Revolutionary micro-clovers blended with low input tall fescue and 4N perennial ryegrass for a lawn that never needs fertilizer or herbicides.

name: Moisture Boost Plus Bermudagrass
description: X-Seed Moisture Boost Plus Bermuda grass, 3 lb. Lawn Seed Mixture is premium polymer coated seed mixture to grow and is 99. 9-percent weed free.

description: Annual Ryegrass is suited for over-seeding winter dormant turf or forage pasture.

name: PatchMaster Lawn Repair Mix
description: Scotts PatchMaster Lawn Repair Mix Sun + Shade Mix has everything you need to repair bare spots or thin areas in your lawn. It includes seed, 100% recycled mulch to keep the seeds moist during establishment, and fertilizer to help feed seedlings for up to 6 weeks for fast growth and thick results. Backed by Scotts No-Quibble Money Back Guarantee.

name: PatchMaster Lawn Repair Mix Tall Fescue Mix
description: Improved Scotts® PatchMaster® Lawn Repair Mix Tall Fescue Mix has everything you need to repair bare spots in your lawn. It includes seed, 100% recycled mulch to keep the seed moist during establishment, and fertilizer to help feed seedlings for up to 6 weeks for fast growth and thick results. Backed by Scotts® No-Quibble Money Back Guarantee™.

name: Perennial Lawn Seed Blend
description: This Perennial lawn seed blend from X-Seed is specially formulated to thrive in the Pacific Northwest and Mountain West states. It’s a blend of perennial rye and fine fescue that should be able to survive the harsh conditions that our region occasionally produces. This bag can cover 2,500 square feet.

name: Pet Proof Grass Seed Mixture
description: X-Seed’s Pet Proof Grass Seed Mixture is specially engineered for dog-friendly lawns that need to stand up to both pet activity and everyday wear. Designed to resist pet urine damage and heavy foot traffic, this durable perennial blend creates a lush, dense, emerald-green lawn that stays attractive year-round. Featuring deep-rooted tall fescue for strength and drought tolerance alongside fast-germinating perennial ryegrass for quick coverage, the mix establishes rapidly and adapts easily to both sunny and shaded areas. Ideal for cool and sunny climates, X-Seed’s Pet Proof Grass Seed delivers a resilient, pet-ready lawn that looks great even under the toughest conditions.

name: Quick & Thick Dog Spot Repair Lawn Seed
description: X-Seed’s Quick and Thick dog spot repair can fix you dog’s unsightly yellow spots in your yard in as little as seven days. The mix contains seed, expanding growth medium, fertilizer, and gypsum. It’s easy to use; all you need to do is add water and apply to the spots you want to patch up. There’s enough in this bag to cover up to 200 spots, and it works equally well in sun and shade.

name: Quick and Thick Grass Seed
description: The X-Seed Quick & Thick lawn seed mixture contains 100% perennial grass seed. This mixture is perfect for yards because it grows great in both sun and shade. Quick to establish itself, this is the perfect grass seed for lawns or filling in bare spots.

name: Quick and Thick Renew Lawn Rejuvenator Sun and Shade Formula
description: X-Seed’s Quick & Thick Renew Lawn Rejuvenator Sun and Shade Formula is an all-in-one solution designed to bring tired lawns back to life fast by combining premium grass seed, fertilizer, and a soil revitalizer in one powerful mix. Engineered for swift germination and thick growth, this advanced blend nourishes your lawn, boosts root development, and improves soil health to create a lush, green lawn that thrives in a wide range of conditions. With added moisture and micro boost benefits, it helps defend against drought while rapidly filling bare or thinning areas with dense, healthy grass. Ideal for both sun and shade, this resilient formula revitalizes dead grass and stands up to high-traffic use, making it a reliable choice for long-lasting lawn renewal.

name: Quick and Thick Renew Southern Blend
description: X-Seed’s Quick & Thick Renew Southern Blend is a powerful all-in-one lawn solution специально formulated for the demanding conditions of high-heat southern climates. This advanced mix combines premium grass seed, fertilizer, and a soil revitalizer with moisture and micro boost technology to nourish your lawn, strengthen root growth, and improve soil health for long-lasting results. Engineered for swift germination, it quickly fills bare and thinning areas with thick, vibrant green grass while delivering reliable drought defense. Designed to thrive in full sun, X-Seed’s Quick & Thick Renew Southern Blend helps create a dense, resilient lawn that stands up to intense heat and challenging growing conditions.

name: Shady Lawn Ultra Premium Grass Seed
description: X-Seed Shady Lawn Ultra Premium Grass Seed is the perfect seed mixture for shady lawns. It grows in thick and does well in poor soils. Made up of 100% perennial grass seed. You will love how easy it is to get your grass to grow.

name: Sun and Shade Mix Classic Grass Seed
description: Looking for a reliable, all-purpose grass seed Scotts Classic Grass Seed Sun & Shade Mix is Scotts most versatile mix. It stays green even in extreme conditions of dense shade or scorching sun, plus it's great for repairing bare spots, reseeding existing lawns or seeding new lawns.

name: Texas Deep Green Wildlife Mix Forage Seed Mixture
description: X-Seed’s Texas Deep Green Wildlife Mix Forage Seed Mixture is a highly palatable blend of annual clovers and brassicas designed to attract and nourish deer throughout the season. Carefully selected for strong growth and exceptional taste, this mix delivers lush, deep-green forage that wildlife love and return to repeatedly. It can be planted on its own for dependable attraction or blended with X-Seed Annual Attraction to create an even more robust grazing plot. When used as a standalone planting, a 5 lb. bag covers up to half an acre, making it an efficient and effective choice for land managers and hunters looking to support healthy wildlife activity.

name: Turf Builder Thick'R Lawn Bermudagrass
description: Get up to a 50% thicker lawn* with Scotts® Turf Builder® Thick'R Lawn® Bermudagrass. The 3-in-1 solution contains seeds to fill gaps in the current lawn; fertilizer for a thicker, greener turf; and a soil improver for enhanced root development. Apply to a Bermudagrass lawn in late spring or early summer using a Scotts broadcast, rotary, drop, Elite, hand-held, or Wizz spreader. Water in and keep the soil moist until the seeds germinate. Scotts® Turf Builder® Thick'R Lawn® Bermudagrass is uniquely formulated to help turn weak, thin Bermudagrass into a thicker, greener lawn with stronger roots in one easy application. *Subject to proper care; results may vary based on current condition of lawn.

name: Turf Builder Thick'R Lawn Tall Fescue Mix
description: Scotts® Turf Builder® Thick'R Lawn® Tall Fescue Mix has everything you need to help turn weak, thin grass into a thicker, greener lawn. With this 3-in-1 solution get up to a 50% thicker lawn with just one application (subject to proper care - results may vary based on current condition of lawn)! Thick'R Lawn® contains soil improvers for enhanced root development, seed to fill gaps with new grass, and fertilizer to feed new grass and thicken and green existing turf. This product is intended for use on an entire lawn and can be applied easily with a Scotts spreader.

name: White and Red Clover Seed Mix
description: Pasture Booster adds nitrogen to soils of existing pastures with white and red clovers fixation.

name: White Dutch Clover Lawn Seed
description: White Dutch clover seed is an excellent ground cover because of its fast, dependable growth. It’s a great option to help get a new lawn started, and it also works well when used for cover cropping, ground cover, erosion control, and pasture mixes. It matures to between four and eight inches, and it helps attract bees and all the benefits they bring. This one pound package has enough seed to cover 2500 square feet.

Simply attach the bottle to your hose, and you're ready to spray; for best results, spray when weeds are actively growing.

name: Liquid Weed & Feed 15-0-0
description: Make multitasking easy with Gordon’s Liquid Weed and Feed² 15-0-0, a combination weed killer and liquid fertilizer that treats up to 50,000 square feet. Ideal for pull-behind or ATV sprayers, this concentrated formula is an economical and convenient choice for stomping out a variety of broadleaf weeds, while beautifying your lawn at the same time.

name: Pasture Pro Plus One Step Weed & Feed
description: Strong, green pastures start with Gordon's 7171122 Pasture Pro Plus One-Step Weed & Feed 15-0-0 Concentrate. This weed and feed lawn fertilizer eliminates weeds while it nourishes grass. The 2,4-D-based grass fertilizer weed killer includes 15% nitrogen fertilizer for effective performance. A concentrated liquid weed and feed formulation ensures this product can treat up to 15,000 sq. ft. of pasture or up to 20,000 sq. ft. of lawn. To use the lawn fertilizer and weed control, simply mix with water.

name: Southern Weed and Feed with Penoxsulam
description: Landscapers Select’s Southern Weed and Feed with Penoxsulam delivers powerful, targeted lawn care designed specifically for Southern turf, combining highly effective weed control with long-lasting nutrition in one easy application. Its advanced formula wipes out tough weeds like dollarweed, dandelion, and clover while feeding your grass for extended, sustained growth. With just one treatment, your lawn becomes healthier, greener, and more resilient—free from invasive weeds and supported by the nutrients it needs to thrive in warm Southern conditions.

name: St. Augustine Weed and Feed 15-0-4
description: Ferti-lome St. Augustine Weed and Feed 15-0-4 should be applied in early spring to prevent crabgrass, paspalum, spotted spurge, and sedge; and then again in the fall to avoid winter weeds like evening primrose, rabbit tobacco, henbit, and chickweed. Check the label for a number of other weeds thatFerti-Lome St. Augustine Weed and Feed 15-0-4 will control. Remember to water inthis granular lawn fertilizer after application.

name: Turf Builder Bonus S Southern Weed & Feed 10m
description: Scotts® Turf Builder® Bonus® S Southern Weed & Feed2 will not only kill weeds, but also thicken your lawn to help crowd out future weeds. Available in TX, FL (except Panhandle region), LA, AL, GA, MS, NC, and SC.

description: Scotts® Turf Builder® Bonus® S Southern Weed & Feed2 will not only kill weeds, but also thicken your lawn to help crowd out future weeds. description: Scotts Turf Builder Weed & Feed now has an improved formula that offers twice the dandelion and clover control than before.
