The most powerful weed and feed in the Scotts line-up, this formula also thickens lawns to help crowd out weeds. The 11.32 lb bag covers up to 4,000 square feet, while the 33.95 lb bag covers up to 12,000 square feet.

name: Turf Builder Weed and Feed for Texas Lawns
description: Kills existing listed weeds, greens in 72 hours, and promotes thick, green growth. Controls over 80 listed weed types, including clover, dandelion, poison ivy, and dollarweed.

name: Weed and Feed with Trimec 15-0-10
description: Have your yard being the talk of the town with Hi-Yield's Weed & Feed 15-0-10 fertilizer with weed control. This weed and feed is made to control weeds including dandelion, chickweed, knotweed, plantain, henbit, and spurge. This 18 lb bag will cover up to 5,000 square feet.

name: 130 lbs Push Seed Spreader
description: The Agri-Fab, 130 lbs Push Spreader will help you grow the beautiful lawn that you’ve always wanted. The best time to use a spreader is in the spring. For best results, spread grass seed over bare areas when needed. In the summer, fertilize and feed when necessary to enhance growth. Depending on material and speed of application, the 130 lb. push broadcast spreader can cover up to 25,000 square feet.

name: 85 lb Push Seed Spreader
description: From fertilizer, to seed, to ice melt, Agri-Fab's 85 lb Push Spreader can handle it all. This push spreader features a durable plastic hopper and closure plate that resists corrosion for long-lasting use. The positive flow adjustment design ensures accurate spread patterns up to 10 feet wide.

name: Handheld Spreader
description: Uniformly spreads lawn fertilizer, grass seeds and ice melt.

name: Turf Builder EdgeGuard DLX Broadcast Seed Spreader
description: Scotts' Turf Builder EdgeGuard DLX broadcast spreader holds up to 15,000 square feet of lawn product and is designed to ensure superior results when used with Scotts lawn food. EdgeGuard technology reduces waste by blocking off the right side of the spreader to prevent product spilling onto non-lawn areas. With its precision rate settings, the control panel ensures more accurate coverage.

name: Turf Builder EdgeGuard Mini Push Seed Spreader
description: Use the Scotts Turf Builder EdgeGuard Mini Broadcast Spreader to apply fertilizer, grass seed, and other lawn care products. This lawn spreader comes pre-calibrated and ready-to-use, and holds up to 5,000 sq. ft. of Scotts product. When EdgeGuard is engaged, it will block off the right-side of the spreader pattern to prevent product from spreading onto non-lawn areas. Using the Scotts Turf Builder EdgeGuard Mini Broadcast Spreader is simple. To begin, turn rate control dial to the correct setting listed on the back of each Scotts product, pour the product in the hopper, then start spreading. The lawn spreader's design enhancements feature a curved hopper and dual-bladed agitator for smooth product funneling and consistent coverage. Not to mention, it is compact and features a fold-down handle for easy storage. Spreaders provide uniform coverage of granular products; without one, you may end up with uneven coverage of fertilizer or control products that can result in uneven feeding, weed, disease, or insect control. Scotts spreaders can also be used to distribute salt on walkways and driveways.

name: 2-Pack Pro Tech Mosquito Killer
description: Spartan Mosquito Pro Tech kills mosquitoes for up to 30 days so you can enjoy the outdoors. Doesn’t require batteries or electricity, just add warm water and shake.

name: Backyard Bug Control Spray Concentrate
description: Water-based, low odor formula for spraying before picnics, parties and other outdoor gatherings for a bug-free backyard. Hooks to garden hose for dispensing. Repels and kills mosquitoes and other annoying insects up to 4 weeks, even after it rains. Treats up to 4000 sq-ft.

name: Big Bag Fly Trap
description: When you have a big fly problem, RESCUE! has a big solution; the Big Bag Fly Trap. This bag attracts and traps up to 40,000 flies. Just add water, hang the trap and watch it go to work.

name: Citronella Wax Candle With Handle, Citronella, 17 Oz
description: This casual citronella candle in a galvanized bucket signals it's party time. The flame and the fun last a long time, making it a fantastic value.

name: Disposable Fly Trap
description: With warmer temperatures come the annoying and dirty flies. Luckily, RESCUE!'s Disposable Fly Trap attracts and traps many varieties of flies, keeping them away from your food, family, and friends. Just add water and hang the bag anywhere you have a fly problem; the house, patio, barn, or shop. The attractant will draw them in, never to return.

name: Disposable Yellow Jacket Trap
description: Designed for use from summer through fall, the RESCUE! disposable yellow jacket trap is an effective and low-maintenance way of controlling yellow jacket infestations on your property, or on camping and picnic trips. The exclusive attractant is formulated to lure dozens of species. Simply add water to the powdered attractant, and hang at least 20 feet away from outdoor activity areas. Attractant lasts for weeks, with no rebaiting necessary.

name: Fly Ribbon - 10 Pack
description: Pic fly ribbon catches flies indoors or outdoors. Easy-to-use warm tube in hands to facilitate removal of the ribbon. Remove the thumbtack and carefully set aside. Hold the red loop and pull down the tube slowly with a twirling motion until the ribbon is fully exposed. Hang the ribbon by placing the thumbtack through the red loop and place anywhere flies are a nuisance.

name: Fly Ribbon - 4 Pack
description: The PIC Fly Ribbon is a non-toxic, odorless and poison-free solution for catching unwanted flying insects. As an alternative to aerosols, fly ribbon does not use insecticides, poisons, vapors or sprays to kill flies and flying insects. The ribbon contains an adhesive that attracts and traps flies and other flying insects. The adhesive attracts flying insects and holds them in place. It is versatile and can be used indoors and outdoors. Easy to use and simple to place. Effectively attracts, traps and holds flies, gnats, moths and other flying insects. If the adhesive touches your hands, please wash with warm water and soap to remove.

name: Fly Stick
description: Pic fly stick is an effective way to control common houseflies, moths, horse flies and other flying insects indoors and out. Pic fly stick can be used in any room of the house, including food preparation areas because it gives off no vapors. For maximum results, place 1 teaspoon of a food attractant such as honey or chocolate syrup into the bottom bait cup.

name: Fly Swatter
description: The Only Swatter that Finishes the Job, with Built-in Scoop to easily remove anything that flies or crawls.

name: Fly Swatter, Plastic Mesh, Green/Orange/Pink/Purple Mesh
description: Plastic blade 4-5-1/2 in. Rust-resistant galvanized wire handle. Assorted colors are orange, green, pink and purple.

name: Fly Swatter, Screen Cloth Mesh
description: Screen cloth blade size 4-1/4 in x 6-1/4 in. Rust-resistant galvanized wire handle.

name: Fly TrapStik
description: RESCUE!'s TrapStik for flies brings a new, fresh look to the ugly brown fly tape. This attractive stick uses VisiLure technology to lure flies with color and patter. The flies are attracted to the stick and then get stuck to the adhesive surface, never to bother again. The fly TrapStick is great in the house, shop, garage, or the barn.

name: Fruit Fly Trap 2-Pack
description:
A familiar problem for most homeowners, fruit flies are commonly spotting swarming around fruit bowls or near garbage storage areas. Don't let these annoying pests get the best of you - get ride of them with Terro's fast-acting, Fruit Fly Traps.

Includes: 2 Fruit fly traps and 1 container of liquid lure.

name: Home Defense Backyard Mosquito and Bug Killer Ready-to-Spray
description: Protect your lawn and landscape from mosquitoes with Ortho Home Defense Backyard Mosquito and Bug Killer Ready-To-Spray. Just hook it up to your hose and spray following label directions.

name: Indoor Fly Trap
description: Safer Home’s Indoor Fly Trap is a safe, effective solution for keeping your home free of flies, fruit flies, moths, gnats, and other flying insects—without the use of chemical insecticides, making it ideal for households with children and pets. This plug-in trap works instantly, using a UV LED light to naturally attract insects and trap them 24/7 for continuous protection. Its discreet design keeps insects out of sight and rotates to fit any indoor outlet, blending seamlessly into your space. Winner of the Parent Tested Parent Approved Seal of Approval, it’s a reliable, hassle-free way to maintain a cleaner, pest-free home.

name: Indoor Fly Trap Refills
description: Keep your Safer Home Indoor Fly Trap working at peak performance with the Safer Home Indoor Fly Trap Refills, a convenient 3-pack of StickyTech glue cards designed for the SH502 plug-in trap. These refills effectively trap and hold flies, fruit flies, moths, gnats, and other flying insects without the use of chemical insecticides, making them a safe choice for homes with children and pets. Each glue card securely captures insects until disposal, ensuring a clean, hassle-free solution for maintaining a pest-free indoor environment.

name: Mosquito and Flying Insect Zapper
description: The Pic pest-free living mosquito and flying insect bug zapper is a handheld, easy to use racket that kills bugs on contact.

name: Mosquito Killer
description: Kills Mosquitoes before they're old enough to Bite!� The Mosquito Dunks� are America's excellent selling home owner mosquito control product. The only product with BTI, a bacteria toxic only to mosquito larvae, that lasts 30 days and treats 100 sq-ft of surface water.

name: Mosquito Pro Ready-to-Use Mosquito Killer Spray
description: Fast and long-lasting solution for mosquitoes and many other pests including ants, fleas, and ticks. Controls mosquitoes for 60 days. Covers up to 8,000 sq ft of lawn. Actives are lambda cyhalothrin, novaluron, and pyriproxyfen.

name: Mosquito Repelling Coil
description: Pic Mosquito repelling coils helps to repel mosquitoes in confined areas outdoors. It is useful in places where there is little or no breeze such as patios and porches. Do not use indoors.

name: No-Pest Strip2
description: The Hot Shot No-Pest Strip2 utilizes controlled release technology to slowly diffuse a deep-penetrating vapor in enclosed spaces for up to 4 months. The clean, odorless vapor is evenly distributed throughout the enclosed treatment area, killing visible and hidden insects on contact and preventing new insect infestations while you’re away.

name: Reusable Yellow Jacket Trap
description: Designed for use from spring through fall, the RESCUE! reusable yellow jacket trap is an effective and low-maintenance way of controlling yellow jacket infestations on your property. The exclusive attractant is formulated to lure dozens of species. Insects get trapped in the double-chambered tube and eventually die of dehydration. The durable plastic holds up to season after season of use, and the attractant lasts for weeks without requiring daily maintenance. Hang your trap at least 20 feet away from outdoor activity areas.

name: Stay Away Moths Repellent
description:
Moths seek quiet, undisturbed areas to lay their eggs. Place these pouches in those ares to protect your garments. Pouches emit a scent pleasant to humans, but offensive to moths. Toxic chemicals are not necessary to control moths. You can get rid of moths without killing them, and it is safer for your family and the environment to do so. Mothballs should be avoided altogether as they are made from chemicals that are poisonous to people and animals, and they are just terribly stinky. Using a natural repellent like Stay Away Moths is a risk free way to solve your moth problem.

Follow the 3-step plan to prevent pest problems and get rid of moths: Clean up - Make sure clothing, linens and fabrics are laundered or dry cleaned before storing. Consider storing items in plastic totes or storage bags for added protection. Seal up - Make sure doors and windows are properly fitted and screens are intact to prevent moths from coming inside. Pouch up - Place Stay Away Moths pouches anywhere you want to prevent moths from entering, particularly in closets, dresser drawers, storage chests or wardrobes. Use one pouch per closet or container. Use two pouches if treating a small room.

name: Sticky Fly Traps for Houseplants
description: Keep your indoor plants healthy and pest-free with Summit Sticky Traps for Houseplants, an effective and easy-to-use solution for controlling fungus gnats, aphids, whiteflies, and other small flying insect pests. The bright yellow color naturally attracts insects without the need for chemical pesticides, making it a safer choice for use around your home. Once pests land, the specially formulated adhesive holds them securely in place—yet easily releases from your fingers with no sticky residue. Simply insert the traps into your potted plants to enjoy cleaner, stronger, and more vibrant houseplants.

name: W·H·Y Attractant Kit
description: Free your favorite outdoor spot from those pesky stinging insects with the RESCUE!® W·H·Y attractant kit. It includes a two week supply of attractants that lure insects like wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets into Rescue's two-chambered trap (sold separately) that prevents them from leaving. The attractants don't lure honeybees, though, leaving them to freely pollinate your garden and flowerbeds.

name: W·H·Y Trap for Wasps, Hornets, & Yellow Jackets
description: The Rescue! W·H·Y® Trap is a reusable device that can clear an outdoor area of hornets, wasps, and yellow jackets. It works with the attractants in the W-H-Y® Attractant Kit to lure stinging insects into its two-chambered design and leave them with no means of escape. This model comes with a two week starter supply of attractants.

name: Wasp & Hornet Killer
description: No-Pest Wasp and Hornet Killer is designed to kill wasps, hornets, yellow jackets and eliminate the nests where they live and breed. This product also kills mud daubers, tent caterpillars and scorpions.

name: Wasp TrapStick
description: RESCUE's TrapStick catches wasps, mud daubers, and carpenter bees with its exclusive VisiLure technology. The appealing colors and multi-dimensional pattern lures them in and they get stuck on the adhesive surface. Simply place the trap as near to the nest as you can to keep your outdoor spaces free from these stinging pests.

name: Yellowjacket Attractant Cartridges - 10 Week Supply
description: RESCUE!'s Yellowjacket Attractant cartridges work inside of RESCUE!'s Yellowjacket Trap which lures and traps all major species of yellowjackets.

name: Yellowjacket Attractant Cartridges - 4 Week Supply
description: RESCUE!'s Yellowjacket Attractant cartridges work inside of RESCUE!'s Yellowjacket Trap which lures and traps all major species of yellowjackets.

name: Bed Bug Killer
description: Harris Diatomaceous bed bug killer kills bed bug adults, nymphs and hatchlings. This product is effective and long lasting when kept dry. Unlike our trigger spray and aerosol egg kill, this powder remains effective as long as it is kept dry, helping to prevent any future infestations. Diatomaceous earth is a naturally occurring powder comprised of crumbled siliceous sedimentary rock that acts like tiny razor blades that cut open the exoskeleton of the bed bug, leading to dehydration. Our 8 oz comes ready-to-use in a puffer bottle, allowing for quick and efficient application in cracks and crevices. We recommend using this product in combination with our bed bug killer trigger sprays and aerosol egg kill on mattresses and box springs.

name: Bed Bug Killer Home Pest Control
description: Harris Bedbug Killer 32 oz kills bedbugs and lice and comes with a trigger spray for easy application. We recommend using this product in combination with our bed bug aerosol egg kill on mattresses, box springs, walls, floors and carpets and following up with diatomaceous earth bed bug powder behind electrical outlets around switches where bed bugs tend to congregate. The odorless, non-staining formula kills bed bugs after the spray dries.

name: Concentrate Bifen 7.9 Home and Yard Insecticide
description: Keep your hooved friends safe and protected all year round with CSI Bifen IT 7.9% Bifenthrin Insecticide Concentrate for Cattle! This long-lasting insecticide provides effective control of over 75 insects and pests. It leaves a long-lasting residual that’s odorless and non-staining and dries clear. It’s safe for use around children and pets when used as directed. It contains 7.9% bifenthrin and can be used in homes, commercial and industrial buildings, recreational areas, athletic fields, lawns and ornamentals, and livestock and poultry houses. This insecticide may be applied with low-volume application equipment for general surface, spot, crack and crevice, and deep harborage treatments!

name: Fogger6 with Odor Neutralizer
description: Hot Shot Fogger6 with Odor Neutralizer creates a ﬁne, penetrating mist that reaches deep into cracks and crevices to ﬂush out and kill hidden bugs on contact. When used as directed, the clear, non-staining formula will not harm drapes, upholstery, fabrics, carpeting, bedspreads, ﬂoor tiles, wood ﬂoors, linens, furniture, walls, clothing, ceilings, shades or blinds. Kills both ﬂying and crawling insects on contact.

name: Home Defense Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter2 with Comfort Wand
description: Ortho's Home Defense Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter2 doesn't just kill bugs, it creates a bug barrier. Whether you have ants, spiders, roaches, or other home-invading insects, you can count on Ortho to keep them out. Simply spray Ortho Home Defense around the perimeter of your home foundation to protect your home for up to 12 months.

name: Home Defense Insect Killer for Indoor and Perimeter Refill
description: Ortho® Home Defense® Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter Refill2 kills common household bugs such as ants, bees, beetles, centipedes, cockroaches, crickets, fleas, flies, millipedes, mosquitoes, moths, spiders, stink bugs, ticks, termites, periodical cicadas, and more (as listed). This insect killer creates a bug barrier of up to 12 months protection (against ants, roaches and spiders indoors on non-porous surfaces) to provide long-lasting results. In addition, the Invisi-Shield Technology formula gives off no fumes, dries clear, and dries fast. Use Ortho® Home Defense® Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter Refill2 anytime as a preventative treatment or after you see evidence of insect activity for long lasting-control. Apply with confidence indoors (kitchens, bathrooms, doors and windows) and outdoors (perimeter of foundations, patios and decks, garages) wherever insects are a recurring problem. For indoor surfaces, hold sprayer 12 inches from surface being sprayed and apply a 4 inch wide band along the interior of the home in areas where insects are a recurring problem. Area should be sprayed until slightly wet without soaking. For perimeter treatment, also hold sprayer 12 inches from surface being sprayed and apply a 12 inch wide band along the exterior of the home.

name: Home Defense Insect Killer with Trigger Sprayer
description: Ortho® Home Defense® Insect Killer for Indoor & Perimeter2 kills common household bugs such as ants, beetles, centipedes, cockroaches, crickets, fleas, flies, millipedes, mosquitoes, moths, spiders, stink bugs, ticks, termites, periodical cicadas and more (as listed). This insect killer creates a bug barrier for up to 12 months protection against ants, roaches and spiders indoors on non-porous surfaces. In addition, the Invisi-Shield Technology formula gives off no fumes, dries clear and dries fast. Use this pest control product anytime as a preventative treatment or after you see evidence of insect activity for long lasting-control. Apply indoors in kitchens and bathrooms or around doors and windows, and outdoors to the foundation perimeters, patios, decks, garages and wherever insects are a recurring problem. For indoor surfaces, hold sprayer 12 inches from surface being sprayed and apply a 4-inch wide band, or use a 12-inch wide band when applying to a home perimeter. Area should be sprayed until slightly wet without soaking. People and pets may re-enter the treated area once sprays have dried. Trust Ortho® to keep bugs out of your home.

name: Home Defense Max Ant, Roach and Spider Aerosol Insect Spray
description: Start to kill ants, roaches, and spiders fast with Ortho Home Defense Max Ant, Roach & Spider1 spray. The spray produces no fumes, just results. The sprayer works when used at any angle, even upside down. This insect spray kills and prevents ants, roaches, and spiders indoors on nonporous surfaces for up to 365 days. It also kills beetles. With Ortho Home Defense Max Ant, Roach & Spider1 spray, you'll have long-lasting indoor bug control.

name: Home Defense Max Insect Killer
description: Designed for use as a ready-to-use granular insecticide to control listed surface feeding insects. Aids In controlling imported fire ants and many other home invading pests.

name: Home Pest Plus Germ Killer
description: The cure-all for common household pests, Bayer Advanced Home Pest Plus germ killer is effective on over 60 listed species, and kills common pest insects in seconds. This formula is appropriate as an outdoor barrier treatment, as well. Not for primary use as a sanitizer.

name: Insect Repellent Spray
description: Most recent creation of PARA’KITO® research & development, this new water & sweat-resistant insect repellent spray is our skin’s best friend, especially during summer or tropical evenings. Not only does it provide an effective protection for up to 8 hours against mosquitoes and ticks, the spray’s formula brings moisturizing and comfort to the skin. Non-greasy, non-sticky, it also has a lovely light fragrance.

name: Lime Organic Pest Control
description: From keeping insects out of your home to refreshing chicken coops and gardens, First Saturday Lime is the easy way to repel insects and kill odor-causing bacteria with peace of mind. First Saturday Lime is completely safe for people, pets, plants, and the planet when used as directed. We even offer a 100% money back, satisfaction guarantee!

name: Propane Insect Fogger
description: Take back your backyard with the Burgess 1443 Propane Insecti Fogger: completely portable and lightweight, this propane-powered fogger is the most economical way to kill mosquitos and biting flies. The secret to its effectiveness lies in the microscopic particles it produces - up to seven times faster than mist. When applied before dusk or dawn, the fog drifts and penetrates deep into landscaped areas where mosquitos hide, killing on contact and creating a mosquito-free zone that lasts up to 6 hours. In about 5 minutes the fog dissipates, allowing you to enjoy the outdoors again. One treatment takes an average of 10 minutes to voer a 5,000-square-foot yard, making it perfect use before backyard picnics, barbecues, outdoor parties, and special events. This is the same proven system used by professionals to kill mosquitos that may carry the Zika virus or West Nile Virus. The Burgess 1443 Propane Fogger features a 44oz reservoir and requires a standard propane cylinder (not included). A trigger lock helps prevent accidental dispensing of insecticide. For best results, use only with Black Flag, Cutter, or Repel branded Fogging Insecticides. For outdoor residential use only.

name: ProZap PROMIST'R Kit
description: Prozap’s ProMist’r II Dispenser combined with Prozap LD-44T Kit for use against flying and crawling insects such as flies, mosquitoes, gnats and moths in restaurants, food warehouses, kennels, dairies, barns and other locations. Provides approximately 30 days protection covering 6,000 cubic feet.

name: Ready-to-Use Cyonara Home and Garden Insect Control
description: Cyonara Home & Garden RTS (Ready-to-Spray), previously Cyonara Lawn & Garden RTS, is an excellent professional-grade insect control spray that treats a wide variety of the most common insect pests around home perimeters, vegetable gardens, roses, flowers, trees and shrubs. One quart of Cyonara Home & Garden Spray will treat up to 16,000 sq. ft. of lawn. Cyonara is fast acting on insects with a quick-knockdown and offers 8 weeks of residual protection.

name: Ready-to-Use Eight Insect Control Home and Garden
description: BONIDE Eight® Houseplant Insect Spray kills insects and controls disease. Kills over 60 different listed insects. Provides both contact and residual control.

name: Ready-to-Use House Guard Foaming Insect Killer Aerosol Spray
description: Kills roaches, ants, bedbugs, fleas, spiders and ticks.

name: Spider Trap - 3 Pack
description: RESCUES!'s Spider Trap catches a variety of biting and poisonous spiders that linger in your home. From black widows to brown recluse to sacs, hobos, jumping, and wolf spiders, this trap lures spiders in where they get stuck. With four entrances and hundreds of glue dots, it catches more spiders than other traps. There are also two sides of glue so when one side is full, you can simply flip it over.

name: Bug Stop Home Barrier Insect Spray
description: Protect your home inside and out with Spectracide’s Bug Stop Home Barrier Insect Spray! This powerful formula kills insects on contact and provides up to 12 months of control against cockroaches, helping to keep your living spaces pest-free year-round. Designed for both indoor use and as a home barrier treatment, it goes to work fast without staining surfaces or leaving behind a lingering odor. Easy to use and highly effective, Spectracide Bug Stop gives you lasting protection and peace of mind from unwanted pests.

name: 12 Month Tree & Shrub Protect & Feed Granule
description: Protect your plants from infestations with Bayer Advanced 12 Months Tree & Shrub Protect & Feed granular formula. This dual-action product kills insects and prevents new infestations for up to 12 months; at the same time, it provides a slow-release fertilizer for optimal plant health and growth. Ideal for use against adelgids, borers, leafminers, and adult Japanese beetles.

name: 8-12-4 Rose Shield Systemic Rose and Flower Care
description: Protect and feed roses for up to 8 weeks with Rose Shield Systemic Rose & Flower Care Granules from Bonide. The granular treatment promotes strong roots and beautiful blooms while protecting the plants against insect damage. Controlled listed insects include aphids, whiteflies, thrips and many more. 8-12-4 formula contains 8% nitrogen, 12% phosphate and 4% potash. Systemic insect control granules are taken up by the roots and travel through the entire plant for protection against insects. Because the product works inside the plant, rain and water will not wash the protection away. This product arrives conveniently ready-to-use. To use, apply the appropriate amount of granules on top of soil, incorporate thoroughly into the top layer of soil, and water in thoroughly. For best results, please see full use instructions on product label.

name: All Seasons Horticultural and Dormant Spray Oil
description: For organic gardening. A superior type of paraffinic oil that may be used as a growing season spray, dormant spray (no leaves) or delayed dormant (green tip) spray to control overwintering eggs of red spiders, scale insects, aphids, bud moths, leaf roller, red bug, codling moth, blister mites, galls, whitefly, mealy bugs and other insects and diseases. Highly recommended for use on fruit trees, shade trees, shrubs, ornamentals, roses, and vegetables.

name: Annual Tree and Shrub Insect Control
description: Bonide Annual Tree and Shrub kills borers and other listed insect pests for up to 1-year. Mix and pour at the base of trees and shrubs (no spraying needed). Kills emerald ash borers.

name: Ant Baits
description: With a 1% low-dose formula for optimal control of large or multiple colonies, Revenge ant baits are pre-filled liquid bait stations that help eliminate sweet, grease, Argentine, and carpenter ants. Also effective on roaches, these ant baits may be placed both indoors and out to tackle invasions everywhere on your property.

name: Ant Baits, Kills Ants without the Mess
description: Ant colonies need both sugar and protein to thrive.We created our owndual-bait formula that includes a separate protein and carbohydrate, in a gel that's easy to spread to other ants in the colony. Simply open and place where you see ants, and they will find it no matter which food they seek - protein or sugar.Sugar is fed to the other workers, while protein is fed to the larvae for a more complete ant kill.

name: Ant Dust
description: Take control of those pesky ants inside and out with Terro's Ant Dust. This waterproof powder kills on contact and lasts up to 8 months. Killing fire ants, carpenter ants, cockroaches, spiders and much more makes this a staple for any household. To help prevent and control invasions, apply Terro Ant Dust thoroughly and uniformly to foundations and crawl spaces where pests are active and may find entrance to your home. name: BugClear Insect Killer
description: Kill outdoor insects with Ortho BugClear Insect Killer for Lawns & Landscapes Ready-to-Spray bottle. description: Protect your backyard and enjoy your lawn with Ortho® BugClear™ Lawn Insect Killer1 Granules. For best results, apply with a Scotts® spreader and then immediately water in granules. Each 10-lb. bag treats up to 16,500 sq. ft.

name: Captain Jack’s Ready-to-Use Neem Oil
description: Control pests, diseases and more in your garden with Captain Jack’s 4-in-1 Neem Max. Pure, cold pressed Neem Oil works against insects, fungus, and disease in your home and garden. This product arrives conveniently ready-to-use! To use, shake well and apply as a foliar spray or a soil drench. Please see product label for full use instructions.

name: Captain Jack's Deadbug

name: Carbaryl 4L Insecticide
description: Carbaryl® 4L is an effective water-dispersible insecticide, and eliminates grubworms, cucumber beetles, Japanese beetles, June bugs, and other pests.

name: Concentrate Termite and Carpenter Ant Killer
description: Formula eliminates termites, carpenter ants, fire ants, carpenter bees, and wood infesting beetles. For subterranean termites, one treatment should last up to 5 years if the treated soil is left undisturbed.

name: Cyonara Lawn and Garden Insect Control Ready-To-Spray

name: Deadbug Brew Concentrate Garden Insect Control
description: Captain Jack's dead bug brew kills bagworms, borers, beetles, caterpillars, thrips, codling moth, gypsy moth, loopers, leaf miners, spider mites, tent caterpillars and more. description: Demon WP Insecticide Contains: 40% Cypermethrin. Demon WP is a professional insecticide for use in/on and around buildings and structures. name: Dust Ready to Use Insect Killer
description: Safeguard your lawn, garden, and flowerbeds with Sevin’s Dust Ready-to-Use Insect Killer, a convenient and effective powder formula designed to protect your plants from a wide range of damaging pests without harming delicate foliage or blooms. name: Eight Garden Dust 3lb
description: An outstanding vegetable garden insecticide that kills and repels most insect pests common to home gardens. Provides contact and residual control of over 55 hard to kill insects. Designed for use on vegetables, roses and flowers. Easy to use and one application can last up to 4 weeks.

name: Eight Insect Control Vegetable, Fruit, and Flower
description: User and environmentally friendly, contact, and residual insect control for up to 4 weeks. Pleasantly scented and water-based, next generation pyrethroid formula will not stain. Kills hundreds of insects which destroy lawns, trees, shrubs, roses, flowers, vegetables, fruits, nuts. May be applied to homes and outdoor areas to stop infestations of flies, ticks, fleas, mosquitoes, ants, and other flying, crawling and hopping insects. Main active ingredient is 2.5% permethrin.

name: Fire Ant Killer Mound Treatment
description: Ortho® Fire Ant Killer Mound Treatment1is a fast-acting formula that kills fire ant queens and their mounds. It also keeps new colonies from forming. For use in residential lawns, Ortho® Fire Ant Killer Mound Treatment will give you results - guaranteed or your money back.

name: Fruit Tree Spray Concentrate
description: A complete liquid fruit tree spray. Contains 12% captan, 6% malathion, 0.3% carbaryl and a spreader sticker. Simple to use. No plugged nozzles. Excellent for the home orchardist. Available in powder formula.

name: Grub Beater Annual Insect Control
description: Bonide Annual Grub Beater protects your lawn from grubs (Japanese beetle larvae) with just one simple application - all season long.

name: Insect Grub Control 5M
description: Controls turf damaging insects above and below the ground with one product. Kills grubs and over 40 additional insects including earwigs, ants, fleas, ticks, pill bugs, and more. This allows Insect and Grub to kill insects in 24 hours while providing soil and surface protection for up to 3 months. Makes a great perimeter treatment around premises.

name: Ladybug House
description: ladybug house - habitat used to attract ladybugs and other beneficial insects. comes with mounting hardware

name: Ladybugs & Lacewings Cup
description: Contains 1000 Lacewing Eggs and 500 Ladybugs in one cup, for use in controlling soft bodied insect pests on plants.

name: Liquid Ant Baits 6-Pack
description:
Ants can be a problem anywhere - at home, work, and everywhere in between. To kill common household ants, place Terro's Liquid Ant Baits in areas where they attract foraging ants that take the bait back to the nest. As the bait circulates through the colony, it kills the ants you see and the ones you don't. The new and improved snap-off tab makes the stations easy to use. Plus, the closed bait stations prevent the bait from drying out to provide ants with a continuous supply of liquid day and night.

Note: Complete control may take up to two weeks.

Includes: 6 Bait stations per pack.

name: Liquid Ant Killer
description: When you have an ant problem, you want to ensure your efforts are as simple and effective as possible. Terro's Liquid Ant Killer uses borax to kill the ants you see, as well as the ants you don't see. It works by allowing the forager ants to consume the product and survive long enough to carry the liquid back to the nest and deliver a dose to the rest of the colony. Complete control may take up to two weeks.

name: Live Ladybugs
description: 500 Live Ladybugs per container, easy release instructions.

name: Neem
description:
Neemfrom Fertilome is a 3-in-1 multi-purpose product combining a fungicide, insecticide, and miticide and is good for organic gardening. Use on fruits, nuts, vegetables, herbs, spices, roses, houseplants, flowers, trees and shrubs. Neem will stop powdery mildew in 24 hours. It will also help defend your beautiful roses against insects, disease and mites. The RTU is ready to use straight out of the bottle. Just point and spray.

Neem is an effective fungicide for the prevention and control of various fungal diseases including Powdery Mildew, Black Spot, Downy Mildew, Anthracnose, Rust, Leaf Spot, Botrytis, Needle Rust, Scab and others listed on label. You should apply it at the first sign of insects/mites. It is also great for the control of Aphids, Spider Mites, Scale, Whiteflies, Beetles, Leafrollers and others listed on label.

Application: Spray all plant surfaces including the under sides of leaves until completely wet.

name: Neem - Concentrate
description:
Neem Concentrate from Fertilome is a 3-in-1 multi-purpose product combining a fungicide, insecticide, and miticide and is good for organic gardening. Use on fruits, nuts, vegetables, herbs, spices, roses, houseplants, flowers, trees and shrubs. Neem will stop powdery mildew in 24 hours. It will also help defend your beautiful roses against insects, disease and mites.

Neem is an effective fungicide for the prevention and control of various fungal diseases including Powdery Mildew, Black Spot, Downy Mildew, Anthracnose, Rust, Leaf Spot, Botrytis, Needle Rust, Scab and others listed on label. name: NeemMAX 4-In-1 Insecticide, Fungicide, Miticide, Nematicide
description: Use the power of Neem. NeemMax is an organic plant-based, botanical product that contains the full spectrum of bioactive compounds that stops the insect lifecycle. This 4-in-1 product is a Fungicide, Insecticide, Miticide & Nematicide. Apply as a spray or as a drench to protect your plants from insects and diseases.

name: Orthene Fire Ant Killer
description: Don't let fire ants keep you from enjoying your lawn. Stop the takeover by killing the queen and destroying the mound with Ortho®Orthene®Fire Ant Killer. This powerful, easy-to-apply solution destroys the mound and kills the queen to keep the colony from repopulating. It begins killing in 60 minutes, so you can get your yard back fast. One bottle can treat up to 162 mounds. Simply sprinkle powder over the mound and let it work its magic — no need to water-in. Use it as a mound treatment for home lawns and around ornamental plants (including flowers, shrubs, and trees). Follow label instructions to determine how much product is needed based on mound size. For best results, apply product while ants are active. To keep fire ants at bay, use as part of the Ortho®2-Step System - use Ortho®Fire Ant Killer Broadcast Granules (sold separately) as a second step to prevent new mounds from forming for up to 6 months.

name: Permethrin 13.3% Multi-Purpose Insecticide
description: Multi-Purpose insecticide for indoor and outdoor use, that controls insects for up to 4 weeks. One quart of concentrate makes 48 gallons for contact and residual sprays, and up to 266 gallons for large animal spray. Can be used for pantries, bedding, kitchens, buildings, and carpets. Can be used in handheld foggers and automatic misting systems. Safe to use on horses, swine, cattle, cows, beef, dairy, sheep, goats, pigs, poultry, chickens, and dogs. description: Prozap LD-44T Metered Insecticide refill is dually synergized and contains 1% Pyrethrin, 2% PBO and 3% MGK 264. Compatible with most metered insecticide dispensers. For use against flying and crawling insects such as flies, mosquitoes, gnats and moths in restaurants, food warehouses, kennels, dairies, barns and other locations.

name: Qt Systemic Insect RTS
description: BONIDE Systemic Insect Control protects plants from chewing insects from the inside out and provides long lasting protection that won't wash off. Use on roses, flowers, trees, shrubs and ornamentals.

name: Ready-to-Use Captain Jack's Tomato and Vegetable Spray for Insect and Disease Control

This product controls Japanese beetles, borers, aphids, black spot, powdery mildew and many other listed insects and diseases.

name: Revenge Fire Ant Killer Dust
description: Odorless and fast-acting. Kills all ants, including fire ant, termite and carpenter ants. name: Surrender Fire Ant Killer

description: You know how irritating and potentially dangerous it can be to have a bug infestation in your house or elsewhere on your property. name: Temprid FX Insecticide Monodose

name: Total Pest Control

name: 12-Pack All-Natural Mouse Repellent Pouches

name: 12-Pack Botanical Fresh Cab Rodent Repellent
description: Same Great Product, now in a larger pack! Fresh Cab® Botanical Rodent Repellent 12pk Box is a fast-acting pest control product made to repel mice and keep them from coming back. Fresh Cab is a no-kill rodent control option. Use in uninhabited, enclosed spaces such as RV’s, tractors, sheds, attics, and detached storage areas where activity or droppings have been noticed. Lab-proven to repel rodents swiftly and efficiently.

name: 2-Pack Power Kill Mouse Trap
description: The Victor Power-Kill Mouse Trap provides a simple solution for your rodent infestations, no matter the size. The large bait trough makes baiting easy and contained while also helping to lure rodents onto the trap. Once the mouse triggers the trip pedal, the high-impact kill bar immediately snaps shut, causing a quick, humane kill. The easy-release mechanism allows you to dispose of the rodent without fear of snapping your fingers. The Power-Kill traps were designed for both single and multiple uses. After discarding of your previous catch, simply reset and reuse.

name: 3-Pack All-Natural Mouse Repellent Pouches
description: Keep unwanted rodents away with Grandpa Gus’s 3-Pack All-Natural Mouse Repellent Pouches, the simple, safe, and effective way to repel mice naturally. Easy to use with no mess, no traps, and no cleanup—just place them where needed and let the refreshing scent do the work. name: 4-Pack Botanical Fresh Cab Rodent Repellent
description:
Perfect for the average home, garage or storage unit, these four 2-1/2 ounce handy packs contains enough Fresh Cab to effectively protect several rodent-prone areas.

Fresh Cab keeps mice out of homes, cabins, basements, attics, garages, sheds, and storage units. It protects stored vehicles, boats, RVs, ATVs, campers, snowmobiles, farm equipment, and key storage areas for businesses. It repels mice from pet food, bird seed, and livestock feed… just about anywhere mice like to get into.

Fresh Cab is the ONLY botanical rodent repellent effective enough to be registered by the Federal EPA and trusted by licensed pest control experts for BOTH effectiveness and safety. No Mice Guaranteed!

Fresh Cab keeps mice out! For preventative use in non-infested areas, simply place one pouch for every 125 sq. feet. The scent lasts up to 90 days. For use in currently infested areas, increase use to 1 pouch per 8 sq. feet of floor space, and replace every 30 days.

name: 4-Pack Prowler Rat Size Glue Boards
description: Motomco’s 4-Pack Prowler Rat Size Glue Boards Value Pack delivers professional-strength performance for serious rodent challenges. Featuring our powerful glue formula designed to securely capture rats and mice on contact, these boards provide fast, chemical-free control you can trust. The hypoallergenic formula makes them suitable for use in homes, businesses, and other sensitive environments, while the trusted Prowler Performance is built to handle even the toughest rodent problems. Easy to use with no setup required, simply place the boards where rodent activity is present for dependable, hassle-free results.

name: 5-Pack All-Natural Mouse Repellent Sticks
description: Keep mice away the natural way with Grandpa Gus’s 5-Pack All-Natural Mouse Repellent Sticks, featuring an innovative, patented fragrance delivery system that steadily releases concentrated peppermint oil proven to repel mice. name: 6-Pack Prowler Mouse Size Glue Boards

Featuring our trusted Prowler Performance, these boards are built to tackle even tough rodent problems with a professional-strength glue formula designed to securely capture mice on contact. The hypoallergenic formula provides fast, chemical-free control, making it an ideal solution for homes, businesses, and sensitive environments. name: All-Natural Rodent Repellent Spray
description: Protect your home and property the natural way with Grandpa Gus’s All-Natural Rodent Repellent Spray. This 15oz spray uses a powerful blend of peppermint and cinnamon essential oils to effectively repel rodents without harsh chemicals. Safe to use both indoors and outdoors, it’s perfect for keeping mice and rats away from your home, garage, shed, RV, or garden. Environmentally friendly and safe to use around kids and pets when used as directed, this all-natural spray offers a clean, simple, and effective solution to keep rodents from making themselves at home.

name: Catch & Hold Mice Trap
description: Victor's Catch & Hold Mice Trap can handle your mouse-catching needs. Designed for indoor or outdoor use, each trap can lure and contain up to four mice before it needs to be emptied for further use. These live traps contain no poisons or snapping parts, making them ideal for use at your home or business where they may be set near water, food, children or pets.

name: Combo Bait Mini Blocks for Rodents
description: Bait Mini Blocks Combo Bait Mini Blocks deliver the first rodenticide that also eliminates fleas for an all-around approach to pest control. The bait is effective against Norway and Roof rats; house mice, deer mice, and white-footed mice; voles; and the fleas that reside on these rodents and may be carriers of infectious diseases.

name: Combo Bait Pellets
description: Kaput Combo Bait is a unique rodenticide that not only controls labelled rodents, but will also treat the fleas they carry. This bait is effective against Norway rats, roof rats, house mice, and voles. 4 pound pail comes with 32 two ounce packs and the box comes with 250 place packs.

name: Easy Set Gopher Trap
description:
When you see gopher holes popping up in your yard, you'll want to have one of these on hand. Victor's Easy Set Gopher Trap effectively kills gophers without the use of chemicals or poisons. The trap features galvanized steel construction for superior strength and durability. The trap’s narrow design with short base allows for easy insertion into gopher tunnels and keeps moving parts completely below the surface, safely away from children and pets.

Victor Easy Set Gopher Traps are easy to use and come fully assembled and with illustrated operating instructions on setting and placement. As the most reliable gopher trap on the market, you can rest assured that your yard is safe from the damaging effects of gophers.

name: Easy Set Mouse Trap - 2-Pack
description: Victor's Easy Set Mouse Trap takes our original #1 selling wooden wire snap trap and adds a large, pre-baited plastic cheese pedal for even more effective mouse control. This trap delivers instant rodent control and is safe for household use. Its superior quality and effectiveness are why more than a billion snap traps have been sold since we invented them in 1898. And why they’re the pest control professionals trap of choice.

name: Electronic Rat Trap
description:
Quickly eliminate rats around your property with the humane, high-voltage killing power of the Victor Electronic Rat Trap. Featuring a new and improved industrial design, this trap has a built-in bait cup and removable kill chamber to allow for easy setup and disposal.

To use, simply place a high protein bait in the provided bait cup, place in a location with high rodent activity and power on. This powerful device is capable of killing up to 50 rats per set of batteries, making it the perfect addition to your pest control routine.

name: Flip-n-Slide Bucket Lid Mouse Trap
description: Introducing the Flip N’ Slide, the original American-made multi-catch mouse trap that lets you bait, set, and forget. No need to reset after every catch—this innovative trap works automatically, holding up to 40 mice or 10 medium-sized rats without requiring any additional effort.

name: Giant Destroyer Smoke Bombs Rodent Killer
description:
Quicker and more effective than pesticides, Giant Destroyer smoke bombs emit a poisonous sulfur gas when ignited, rapidly killing off the inhabitants of burrows in your lawn.

Once you have located burrows and nests, seal all but one entrance with soil or another physical barrier to prevent rodents and gas from escaping. Prepare Giant Destroyer by inserting the fuse into the cartridge, leaving 2" of fuse exposed. Insert the primed cartridge into the tunnel fuse-end first, and cover the hole with soil to keep smoke inside. Read the product label for safety precautions before using.

name: Gopher Bait 50
description: 1 lb strychnine treated gopher bait for control of pocket gophers. Use in Subsoil application only. Insert 1 tablespoon of bait into gopher burrow system.

name: Gopher Killer
description: Motomco Gopher Killer pellets are specially formulated to kill gophers. This gopher killer is made with zinc phosphide, an ultra-efficient rodenticide that has been effective for years. Available in 1# and 5# sizes.

name: Hawk Bait Chunx Rodent Bait
description:
Attack rodent infestations with full force with Motomco's Hawk mouse and rat bait chunx. Ideal for rural environments where rats and mice quickly populate out of control, this single-feed anticoagulant rodenticide kills rats and mice in 4-5 days after consumption, sometimes even in a single day. The chunk-style bait is highly palatable and cut to satisfy rodents' desire to gnaw.


Hawk is a commercial-grade rodenticide to be used only by certified pest control operators, farmers, and persons authorized in government-approved pest control programs.

name: Jaguar Pelleted Rodent Bait & Place Pacs
description:
With a killer combination of potency and palatability, Jaguar pelleted rodent bait comes in convenient place pacs that both protect the bait and fit into tight spaces. An excellent choice for burrow baiting, this powerful rodenticide consistently controls rat and mice infestations, even where resistance is suspected. This product includes 73 place pacs, each containing 50 grams of bait.

Hawk is a commercial-grade rodenticide to be used only by certified pest control operators, farmers, and persons authorized in government-approved pest control programs.

name: Just one Bite Ex Bait Station
description: This Just One Bite Ex Bait Station kills house mice usually in one feeding. It may take two or more days from the time of consumption for the mouse to die.

name: Just One Bite II Bait Chunks
description: Just One Bite II Bait Chunkskills Norway rats, roof rats, house mice, and warfarin resistant Norway rats. It was designed to be used in and around agricultural buildings only. Bait chunksfit into burrows and hard to reach areas. The hole allows the bait to be mounted in bait stations too.

name: Just One Bite II Bar 16 oz Bars
description: This package comes with 8 -16 oz Just One Bite II Bar baits, and kills roof rats, house mice, and warfarin resistant Norway rats. It was designed to be used in and around agricultural buildings only. Bar pieces fit into burrows and hard to reach areas. The hole allows the bait to be mounted in bait stations, too.

name: Long-Life Peanut Butter and Jelly Donut Mouse Trap Bait
description: Goodnature Peanut Butter & Jelly (PB&J) Donut - These long-life Peanut Butter & Jelly Donuts are 100% toxin-free, and are made in New Zealand from Forty Thieves Peanut Butter. Put a fresh one in every three months to keep your Mouse Trap smelling irresistible to mice.

name: Metal Pedal Mouse Trap - 2-Pack
description: The original wooden snap trap, Victor's Metal Pedal Mouse Trap is also the world’s #1 selling mouse trap. Its superior quality and effectiveness are the reason Victor has sold more than 1 billion snap traps around the world. And why professional pest control companies have made them their trap of choice. Trusted to control mice for more than 115 years, this trap delivers clean, instant rodent control.

name: MoleMax Granules
description: Mole and vole repellent granules and bulb protector. Repels moles, voles, gophers, rabbits, armadillos, and skunks. Use on lawns, gardens and planting beds. The clean, dustless, biodegradable granules are safe for use around children, plants and pets.

name: MoleMax Mole & Vole Repellent Granules
description: Bonide MoleMax mole and vole repellent granules and bulb protector repels moles, voles, gophers, rabbits, armadillos, and skunks for up to 3 months in lawns, flowerbeds, and gardens. This product is safe to use around children, plants and pets.

name: Mouse Blocks
description: Kaput Mouse Bait Blocks is an easy to use rodenticide that eliminates mice, rats, and voles, with weather resistant bait. At low concentrations this bait product can successfully control current and future rodent infestations within a short time frame.

name: No-View No-Touch Mouse Trap 2-Pack
description: One of d-CON's Most Effective Mouse Trap! With the unique and easy to use d-CON No View, No Touch mouse traps, you’ll never see or touch a dead mouse. Covered traps hide the dead rodents from sight and protect you while throwing them away.

name: Omega Gopher Grain Bait
description: For unparalleled control of pocket gophers, turn to RCO Omega gopher grain bait, a single feed strychnine bait ideal for ranchers and homeowners alike. The groated oat incorporates several flavorings and agents onto and inside the naked oat kernel for a long-lasting, attractive, and highly palatable underground bait.

name: Pocket Gopher Bait
description: Kaput-D Pocket Gopher Bait controls gophers with the active ingredient Dopaquinone. It consists of tiny red grains that will kill gophers on golf courses, lawns, rangeland and other areas without crops. This will eliminate gophers within a week. Kaput-D also has an antidote.

name: Prowler Bait Chunx
description: Prowler rodenticides, exclusively from Motomco, are formulated to control even the toughest infestations on farms and agricultural operations.Prowler baits fuse the proven, acute active Bromethalin with proprietary ingredients to create formulas designed to maximize palatability and bait acceptance.Using Motomco's newest method for active ingredient synthesis, Prowler uses Bromethalin to achieve results with less bait compared to anticoagulants. Prowler 15gm Bait Chunx are smaller than Tomcat Chunx, for more blocks and placements per pail. Prowler Chunx are mold and moisture resistant and use Motomco's extrusion process for a multi-edge shape that rodents love to gnaw.

name: Ramik Bar Rodent Bait
description: Ramik all-weather bar baits are manufactured utilizing a special proprietary extrusion process, where all the bait ingredients are fully blended, bonded and then shaped into weather-proof bait bars. A small amount of edible wax is added to allow uniform sized bars to be formed. Each 16 oz bar can be used whole, or easily broken into 4 oz pieces or 16 1 oz pieces.

name: Ramik Green Mini Rodent Bait Packs
description: Formulated to attract rats and mice, Ramik Green Rodenticide has a high protein, fish-flavored aroma. These ready-to-use bait packs come in individual packets for no-mess, easy placement. Rodents are naturally drawn to the packets and will gnaw them open on their own.Suitable for use in wet or damp areas, including river banks, gullies, irrigation ditches, railroad tracks, loading areas, under grainaries, along fences, garbage dumps and landfills. ContainsDiphacinone, an extremely effective anticoagulant rodenticide. Target rodents include Norway Rats, Roof Rats and House Mice.

name: Ramik Green Nugget Pouch
description:
Diphacinone, the active ingredient in Ramik®, is a first generation anticoagulant, suitable for any use: from rat infestations encountered in livestock and poultry production facilities to the occasional mouse in the house.

Store in original container in a cool, dry place inaccessible to children and pets. Keep containers closed and away from other chemicals.

name: Ramik Mini Bars All-Weather Rat and Mouse Killer
description: Ramik Mini Bars are ready-to-use 1 oz. portions that are perfect for making multiple bait placements by hanging on wire, pegging or securing in bait station boxes. They are just the right size for small openings where rodents live and travel.

name: Ramik Mini-Bar Rodent Bait
description: Formulated to attract rats and mice, Ramik Rodenticide has a high protein, fish-flavored aroma. Mold, moisture and weather-resistant, the bait comes in ready-to-use mini bars for no-mess, easy placement. ContainsDiphacinone, an extremely effective anticoagulant rodenticide.

name: Rat and Mouse Bait
description: Kaput Rat & Mouse Bait imitates the natural food source for rodents like rats, mice, and voles by being manufactured as a loose grain. Easy to use the place packs can be placed as a whole unopened package in areas where rodents feed. Rodents can smellKaput Rat & Mouse Bait through the packaging material which they can then gnaw into and enjoy. The packs can also be opened and the grains portioned out if smaller portions are called for in the job.

name: Ready-to-Use Mice Bait Station
description: New from d-CON our new formula is 10X tastier to mice because it is made with 99% food-grade ingredients. It is so delicious that mice will risk their lives for it.

description: d-CON Bait Station Refill, Solid, Odor/Scent: Sweetish Faint, Gray/Green, Composition: Proprietary Filler, Cholecalciferol, Includes: (12) Refill Baits

description: d-CON Bait Station Refill, Solid, Odor/Scent: Sweetish Faint, Gray/Green, Composition: Proprietary Filler, Cholecalciferol, Includes: (6) Refills

name: Rodentex
description: Rodentex kills Norway rats, roof rats, and house mice. Use only inside.

name: Stick-EM 4 Mouse Glue Traps
description: The STICK-EM rat glue trap is ideal for individuals who want to trap rodents with no risk for children or pets.

name: The Better Mouse Trap 2-Pack
description: Little Giant’s The Better Mouse Trap is the easiest mouse trap you’ll ever set. The simple, no-touch design means you never have to touch the front of the trap or the carcass, and an extra-large bait pan means pests trigger the trap more easily. Ideal for mice, voles, shrews, and other very small animals.

name: The Clever Killer Mouse Trap
description:
Meet the world's first clever mouse killer. Made to outsmart and outlast every mouse it meets, this trap will keep a home or office pest-free for years.

Phone pictured in image is not included.

name: Tin Cat Mouse Trap
description: Great for catching and releasing mice, Victor's Tin Cat Mouse Trap will catch up to 30 mice per setting and can be used indoors or outdoors.

name: Tomcat Bait Chunx
description:
Rid your farm, ranch, or home of rats and mice with Tomcat Bait Chunx, a powerful multiple-feed rodenticide. Designed with multiple edges to encourage gnawing, this bait comes in both an all-weather block and one ounce chunks that may be placed in a bait station. This rodenticide is available in Chunx form in 4 lb and 9 lb pails. Also available in 1 lb all-weather blocks (4 blocks total, part number 32465).

name: Tomcat Glue Trap - 4 Pack
description: Tomcat glue traps are a versatile, effective, and non-poisonous method of capturing mice, roaches, and insects. These traps are ready-to-use out of the box and are pre-baited with attractant, so no additional bait is necessary. Clever mice may try to jump a trap, so place two traps side by side for extra effectiveness! Place at 5-8 feet intervals within 10-30 feet of the nest, ideally flush along the walls, cupboards, or other vertical surfaces.

name: Tomcat Liquid Concentrate 8-Pack
description: Tomcat Liquid Concentrate contains sodium salt of the multiple feed active ingredient Diphacinone.

name: Tomcat Mouse Attractant
description: Make your mechanical rodent traps even more effective with Tomcat mouse attractant. With an attractive gel-like consistency and a taste that's irresistible to rats and mice, this attractant is a great alternative to cheese and peanut butter. What's more, this attractant is non-toxic and safe for children and pets.

name: Tomcat Mouse Glue Board - 4 Pack
description: These Tomcat mouse glue boards are ready-to-use, and are a non-poisonous option for managing the occasional mouse or roach problem. These disposable traps have a powerful adhesive that holds rodents in place, and are ideally sized for mice. Clever mice may try to jump a trap, so place two traps side by side for extra effectiveness! Place at 5-8 feet intervals within 10-30 feet of the nest, ideally flush along the walls, cupboards, or other vertical surfaces.

description: This Tomcat Mouse Killer I bait station is a tamper resistant trap that is safe to place in areas frequented by children and dogs, and comes with 16 bait blocks. description:

name: Tomcat Mouse Killer II Bait Station - 4 Pack
Tomcat Mouse Killer III Bait Station
description: This Tomcat Mouse Killer III bait station is tamper resistant and safe to place in areas frequented by children and dogs. name: Tomcat Outpost Rodent Bait Station
description: Motomco’s Tomcat Outpost Rodent Bait Station is a durable, tamper-resistant solution designed to deliver secure and effective rodent control in residential, commercial, and agricultural settings. Built with heavy-duty, weather-resistant construction, the Outpost station protects bait from the elements while helping prevent access by children, pets, and non-target animals. Its versatile design accommodates a variety of bait types, including blocks and soft bait, and features a lockable lid for added security and peace of mind. Easy to service and strategically place along rodent travel paths, the Tomcat Outpost Rodent Bait Station provides reliable, professional-grade performance for managing tough rodent infestations.

name: Tomcat Pelleted Bait
description:
A farmer favorite for years, Tomcat pelleted bait is a palatable, quick-acting rodenticide that will nip infestations in the bud. An economical bait choice for recurring rodent problems, the pelleted form is ideal for burrow baiting.

description:
A farmer favorite for years, these Tomcat pelleted bait place pacs are a palatable, quick-acting option that will nip infestations in the bud. An economical bait choice for recurring rodent problems, the place pacs are ideal for tight areas. Contains 22 place pacs, 3 oz each.

name: Tomcat Rat Bait Station
description: This Tomcat rat bait station is tamper resistant to protect children and pets from bait or trap exposure. The durable, easy-to-use design makes it ideal for use both indoors and out.

name: Tomcat Rat Glue Board 2-Pack
description: Tomcat Glue Boards are one of the most widely used ways to control rats, mice, insects or other household pests without the use of pesticides or toxins.

name: Tomcat Rat Killer Refillable Bait Station
description: Tomcat Rat Killer II Refillable Bait Station contains one Tier 1 Refillable Rat Sized Bait Station with 15 x 30 gm Bait Block Refills.

name: Tomcat Rat Snap Trap Reusable
description: The Tomcat Reusable Rat Snap trap is a non-poisonous, pesticide free way to capture and remove rats or other rodent pests.

name: Tomcat Rodent Block - 4 Pack
description:
Rid your farm, ranch, or home of rats and mice with Tomcat rodent blocks, a powerful multiple-feed rodenticide. Designed with multiple edges to encourage gnawing, each 1 lb all-weather block is designed for rugged outdoor and indoor use. Rodents will die within 4-6 days after consuming a lethal dose. This rodenticide is also available in Chunx form in 4 lb and 9 lb pails (part numbers 32444 and 32446).

Warning: Diphacinone is unsafe for pets and wildlife.

name: Tomcat Tunnel Trapping System
description: The Tomcat Tunnel Trapping System is an innovative way to eliminate chipmunks, rats, squirrels or other unwanted pests from around yards, landscaping and farms. Excellent to use when conventional rodent baits aren't allowed or available. Complete Trapping System includes 2 heavy duty reusable snap traps and 1 protective tunnel station. Chipmunks or other pests enter the station and are quickly and humanely killed by the powerful snap traps. Always check state and local regulations regarding animal trapping.

name: Tomcat With Bromethalin Bait Chunx
description: Get a knockdown kill when you use Tomcat with Bromethalin Bait Chunx. This highly palatable bait contains bromethalin, an acute acting rodenticide that is lethal to anticoagulant resistant rats and mice. Bromethalin will kill rats in as little as two days, compared to the four to five days needed with anticoagulants. Ideal for use with Tomcat bait stations.

name: Tomcat with Bromethalin Meal Bait
description: Motomco's Tomcat with Bromethalin Meal Bait is a great way to take care of your pest problem. This meal bait is a highly palatable seed and grain formula that can kill in one to two days after consumption of a toxic dose. This bait has been formulated for a proven combination of palatability, effectiveness, and speed of kill.

name: Tomcat With Bromethalin Pelleted Bait
description: Tomcat with Bromethalin pellets consistently deliver a proven blend of palatability and speed of kill, the key characteristics of an effective knockdown bait. This formula contains the active ingredient bromethalin, an acute acting rodenticide that is effective even against anticoagulant resistant rats and mice. Bromethalin can kill rats and mice in as little as two days after consuming a lethal dose, compared to anticoagulants that can take as long as four to five days or more for the first dead rodents to appear.

name: Tomcat With Bromethalin Pelleted Bait & Place Pacs
description:
Tomcat with bromethalin pellets and place pacs consistently deliver a proven blend of palatability and speed of kill, the key characteristics of an effective knockdown bait. Ideal for placing in tight areas, this rodent killer contains the active ingredient bromethalin, an acute acting rodenticide that is effective even against anticoagulant resistant rats and mice. Bromethalin can kill rats and mice in as little as 2 days after consuming a lethal dose, compared to anticoagulants that can take as long as 4 to 5 days or more for the first dead rodents to appear.

Contains 22 pacs, 3 oz each.

name: Top Loader Bait Station
description: JT Eaton’s Top Loader bait station is the most versatile and tamper-resistant bait station on the market. It holds a generous amount of rodenticide bait blocks. You can mount it vertically, sideways, or upside down making it easy to place in many different environments. Attracts rodents by allowing light and air within trap.

name: Wide Pedal Rat Trap
description: The original wood-based wire snap trap, the Victor Wide Pedal Rat Trap, provides immediate rodent control and is safe for household or business use. For effective rat control, each rat trap comes with a wide, expanded professional trip pedal.

name: 18" x 6" x 6" Single Door Live Animal Trap
description: Rid your property of unwanted animals in a humane way with this 18" x 6" x 6" Little Giant single door live animal trap. The spring-loaded door is easy to bait and set and quick to release, and the heavy wire mesh is reinforced with steel for extra security. The 18” x 6” x 6” size works well for rats, weasels, red and flying squirrels, chipmunks, and similar-sized animals.

name: 18.75" x 7" x 6.5" Double Door Entry Live Animal Trap
description: This Double Door Entry Trap from Little Giant catches animals without injury so that you can either relocate them or humanely put them down. Made out of heavy galvanized wire mesh with steel reinforcement, is has two open entry ways to make animals more likely to enter it. This model has an 18.75” size that’s perfect for animals like rats, weasels, squirrels, chipmunks, and other similarly sized animals.

name: 24" x 7" x 7" Double Door Entry Live Animal Trap
description: With its two open entry ways, this Double Door Entry Trap from Little Giant coaxes animals to enter with more confidence than a trap with only one entrance. Measuring 24” long, it’s a good size for trapping animals like chipmunks, rabbits, muskrats, mink, and other similarly-sized animals. It catches them without injury so that you can either humanely dispose of them or relocate them, and it features heavy galvanized wire mesh with steel reinforcement to deliver plenty of security.

name: 24" x 7" x 7" Single Door Live Animal Trap
description: Rid your property of unwanted animals in a humane way with this 24" x 7" x 7" Little Giant single door live animal trap. The spring-loaded door is easy to bait and set and quick to release, and the heavy wire mesh is reinforced with steel for extra security. The 24” x 7” x 7” size works well for squirrels, chipmunks, rabbits, muskrats, and mink.

name: 25' Bird Repellent Ribbon
description: Deter pesky birds from your property with the Bird-X Tape-25 Holographic Irri-Tape visual deterrent! This 2" x 25' tape is designed to reflect light and create a visual deterrent that scares birds away. The holographic surface reflects sunlight, creating a dazzling display that birds find disorienting and intimidating. With this tape, you can effectively protect your crops, gardens, and outdoor spaces from unwanted bird activity.

name: 32" x 10" x 12"  Single Door Live Animal Trap
description: Rid your property of unwanted animals in a humane way with this 32" x 10" x 12" Little Giant single door live animal trap. The spring-loaded door is easy to bait and set and quick to release, and the heavy wire mesh is reinforced with steel for extra security. The 32” x 10” x 12” size works well for raccoons, porcupines, turtles, foxes, and other similar-size animals.

name: 36.5" x 10.25" x 12.75" Double Door Entry Live Animal Trap
description: Little Giant’s Double Door Entry Live Animal Trap features heavy galvanized wire mesh construction with steel reinforcement to ensure plenty of security. Measuring 36.5” x 10.25” x 12.75” it’s a great size for raccoons, woodchucks, skunks, opossums, and other similarly-sized animals.

name: 42" x 16" x 16" Single Door Live Animal Trap
description: Rid your property of unwanted animals in a humane way with this 42" x 16" x 16" Little Giant single door live animal trap. The spring-loaded door is easy to bait and set and quick to release, and the heavy wire mesh is reinforced with steel for extra security. The 42” x 16” x 16” size works well for raccoons, foxes, cats, dogs, and other medium-sized animals.

name: DeerOff Repellent
description: Safer Brand Deer Off Weatherproof Deer Repelling Stations work to protect your yard from deer destruction. The smell mimics that of a dead or decaying animal, which triggers the deer’s flight response and trains them to stay away. The intense scent deterrent is easily detectable by the heightened senses of deer, but is odorless to humans. The stations are ready to use and come with 6 stations and 6 stakes to conveniently stake your repellent into the ground. You can also hang stations from fencing or low-lying shrub or place them in a flowerpot or flowerbed. For best results, places stations no higher than 2 feet above ground level and no more than 4-6 feet apart. One 6 pack covers up to 192 sq ft for up to 90 days.

name: Economy Live Trap Combo Pack
description: Little Giant's Economy Live Trap combo pack features two traps in the most popular sizes. Both are single-door entry live traps that catch unwanted animals without injury so they can be humanely disposed of or relocated. Features a spring-loaded door that is easy to bait and set and quick to release. Beneath the convenient carrying handle is a steel plate to protect hands from contact with the animal. Larger size measures 32.5 inches long by 11 inches wide by 12.5 inches high, and works great for raccoons, porcupines, turtles, foxes, and other similar-size animals. Smaller size measures 24 inches long by 7 inches wide by 7 inches high, and is best for squirrels, chipmunks, rabbits, muskrats, mink, and other similar-size animals.

name: Falcon Decoy
description: A popular visual scare decoy, this Bird-X Falcon is ideal for protecting outdoor spaces such as backyards and gardens.

name: Garden Defense Action Owl
description: Easy Gardener’s Action Owl offers a chemical-free method of protection your garden from hungry birds. Its detailed appearance mimics the look of a predator, and has a bobbling head that moves when the wind blows to add to its lifelike qualities. It offers plenty of flexibility when it comes to placement as it includes a molded-in pilot hole on the base for mounting on a pole, or you can fill the base with sand and place it just about anywhere on the ground.

name: Go Away Rabbit, Dog & Cat Repellent
description: Keep animals away with Go Away! Rabbit, Dog & Cat Repellent Granules! This product is intended for outdoor use – great for lawn & garden, flower beds, trees, shrubs and other areas. Natural ingredients cinnamon oil and thyme oil act as a natural deterrent to keep animals away. When used as directed, this product is safe for use around people and pets. Go Away! Granules work as a training aid for your pets and stray critters in your yard. This product arrives conveniently packaged and ready to use! To use, lightly ad evenly sprinkle a band of 4 feet wide around the area you wish to protect. Reapply product after heavy precipitation or every two weeks for best results. This product is intended as an animal behavior modification tool. For best results, supplement with other behavior modification techniques when training domestic animals to break them of existing bad habits.

name: Hot Pepper Wax Animal Repellent
description: A natural repellant for use on fruits, vegetables, and ornamentals. Even stops animals from chewing wood structures and fences. One application can last up to 4 weeks. Made from hot cayenne peppers.

name: Liquid Fence Deer & Rabbit CON Repellent
description: That gorgeous garden you’ve worked so hard on is easy pickings for deer, rabbit, and other pests—protect your investment with Liquid Fence Deer & Rabbit repellent, a rain resistant, year-round concentrated formula that is plant-, kid-, and pet-friendly. Unlike many repellents that work as taste deterrents, Liquid Fence repels animals with scent, stopping pesky browsers before they even start. For intense feeding pressure, apply liberally once a week for three weeks, then once a month thereafter. During dry periods, apply once a week for two weeks, then once a month thereafter.

name: Liquid Fence Deer & Rabbit RTU Repellent
description: That gorgeous garden you’ve worked so hard on is easy pickings for deer, rabbit, and other pests—protect your investment with ready-to-use Liquid Fence Deer & Rabbit repellent, a rain resistant, year-round formula that is plant-, kid-, and pet-friendly. name: Plastic Bird Spikes with Adhesive
description: Bird-X Plastic Bird Spikes function as a 'keep-out' sign for birds. Dense bird spikes branch out from the vertical shafts to offer impenetrable coverage. The flexibility of bird spikes allow mounting on flat or curved surfaces and are easy to install.

name: Ready-to-Use Repels-All Animal Repellent Granules
description: Keep animals away with Bonide Repels-All Animal Repellent Granules. This long-lasting and easy-to-use product protects your yard, garden, flower beds and more from a variety of pesky critters. Repels-All acts as a natural deterrent to squirrels, deer, rabbits, chipmunks, mice, skunks, rats, beavers, raccoons, porcupines, birds, groundhogs and even more listed pests. Repels-All Granules arrive conveniently ready to use. Use the included shaker bottle to apply pellets as a barrier around the areas you wish to protect, and lightly water. For full use instructions, please see product label.

name: Repels-All Animal Repellent Concentrate

Repels moles, voles, skunks, rabbits, gophers, armadillos, and other vermin. Lasts up to 2 months per application. Can be exposed to water after 6 hrs.

name: Repels-All Animal Repellent Granules
description: Repel nuisance animals including skunks, raccoons, squirrels, chipmunks, and many more from ornamental gardens and planting areas. description: Snake Stopper Snake Repellent Granules by Bonide help to naturally deter snakes, iguanas and lizards from your yard and garden! When used as directed, this product is safe for use around people and pets. Snake Stopper arrives conveniently ready to spray so you can control pests right away. To use, simply spread the pellets in the affected areas you wish to treat.

name: Snake-A-Way Snake Repellent
description: Snake-A-Way snake repellent works by temporarily disrupting a snake's sensory reception and causing disorientation, encouraging the snake to slither away in search of fresh air. The environmentally responsible, university-tested formula has a 91% effectiveness rate against both poisonous and non-poisonous snakes. This patented formula will not harm snakes, and the granules withstand normal rainfall to last 2-3 months.

name: Stainless Steel Bird Spikes

name: Heirloom Butterfly Zinnia Mix State Fair Gold Medal Seed Package
description: The improved heirloom selection offers fully double, big blossoms on long-stemmed plants. State Fair Gold Medal zinnias are both free flowering and long-blooming in coordinating shades that add glowing color and beauty to summer beds and borders. You can cut armfuls of these pretty flowers for bouquets all season long; the more you pick, the more flowers will develop. Butterflies and many other pollinators flock to zinnias all summer long.

name: Hummingbird and Butterfly Wildflower Combination Mix
description: This one-pound bag of X-Seed’s X-Pand Hummingbird and Butterfly mix contains 100,000 seeds that will grow into plants that produce nectars that will attract hummingbirds and butterflies. The plants will grow to a height of 30-40 square inches, and there’s enough seed in this bag to cover 1,000 square feet. The mix also contains fertilizer, starter nutrients, and soil that helps hold moisture.
