Each slated chair glides independently of each other, with ball-bearings in the gliding mechanisms and features a powder-coated star motif. The connecting table features a pre-cut hole to accommodate an umbrella. The beautfiul, natural wood and metal bases are perfect for any home in any season.

name: .70 CF Pine Firewood Bundle
description: This .70 cubic foot pine bundle of firewood is great for camping, backyard events and fireplaces. Perfectly seasoned and guaranteed to have less than a 15% moisture content.

name: 100% Clean Wood Log for Burning
description: The premium logs are specifically chosen to offer the best logs for wood stoves for efficient and eco-friendly heating. With an impressive 42,000 BTU per log, our wood delivers the highest BTU out of any log for consistent, powerful heat. Enjoy long-lasting warmth with our longest-burning logs, up to 12 hours, which burns steadily and cleanly, producing next to no ash. Once you have your fire going, be sure to use minimum 2 logs at a time, or cut our logs into pucks for a smaller faster burning fire. Our logs do not smoke or spark, ensuring a safe and enjoyable fire. Trust Home Fire Logs for an optimal burning experience, making it the perfect choice for your wood stove. Experience superior quality, performance, and peace of mind with every fire. Only Home Fire Prest Logs produce heat for up to 12 hours. That is because of our patented technology compresses wood waste so densely that the logs will burn red hot throughout producing the most efficient burn available in manufactured fire logs today. The logs stay together without falling apart and have an extremely low moisture content of 2%. Produces little to no creosote.

name: 15lb Firewood Bundle
description: Enjoy cozy fires anytime with AR Firewood’s 15lb Firewood Bundle, a convenient and reliable source of premium, kiln-dried hardwood that’s perfect for fireplaces, fire pits, wood stoves, and camping trips. Each bundle is carefully packaged to ensure clean, easy handling and consistent burning, providing a steady flame with minimal smoke. Whether you’re gathering around for warmth, cooking over an open flame, or creating an inviting outdoor atmosphere, this ready-to-use firewood delivers the perfect blend of quality, convenience, and natural comfort.

name: 23" Smokeless Fire Pit
description: Relax around the fire with your loved ones without worrying about having to get out of the way of the smoke – this smokeless fire pit from Old Country BBQ Pits is perfect for your outdoor space. No smoke emissions make the Smokeless Fire Pit the most eco-friendly way to have a cozy summer or fall night.

name: 30" Steel Fire Pit
description: Crafted from robust steel construction with a rust-resistant, high-heat coating, the Livingscape Round Steel Fire Pit ensures longevity even in various weather conditions. It's lattice design, adorned with a bronze finish, adds an elegant touch to any outdoor setting. This fire pit is easy to setup and features a removable burning grate, facilitating easy cleaning and maintenance. A poker tool is also included for safe and convenient flame adjustment, while the spark screen adds an extra layer of safety, preventing embers from escaping. Whether for cozy gatherings or roasting marshmallows, this round steel fire pit offers a perfect blend of aesthetics and functionality for outdoor enjoyment.

name: 31.8" Ranch Fire Pit
description: This Big Horn 31.8inch Ranch Fire Pit has a 360 degree swiveling and adjustable-height cooking grate, can bring your family and friends together for a leisure outdoor barbeque, and in the meantime the fire pit can create warm memories and an inviting ambiance.

name: 32" Fire Pit
description: A 32" fire pit offers a cozy gathering spot with ample space for warmth and ambiance, ideal for outdoor evenings with friends and family. Its versatile size and design make it a stylish yet functional addition to any backyard setting.

name: 35" Round Fire Pit
description: This Big Horn 35-in Fire Pit features a sturdy steel construction with bronze finish to complement virtually any outdoor decor, and it comes with a protective screen to keep flying embers contained and a fire poker to easily maneuver the wood inside the pit safely.

name: 36" Fire Pit with Cooking Grate
description: A 36" fire pit with a cooking grate combines the warmth and charm of an outdoor fire with the functionality of a grill, allowing for open-fire cooking while enjoying a cozy atmosphere. This spacious design provides ample room for both grilling and socializing, making it a perfect centerpiece for any backyard gathering.

name: 36" Fire Pit with Swivel Cook Grate
description: Experience the durability and charm of our all-welded steel fire pit, designed for both relaxation and grilling. The fire pit combines sturdy, all-welded steel construction with functional and decorative elements. The heavy-duty removable swivel cooking grate allows you to sear and cook your favorite proteins while enjoying a cozy fire. The thick round footrest provides a comfortable place to rest your feet as you relax with your favorite beverage. Enjoy the blend of style and utility with this versatile fire pit.

name: 36" Steel Fire Ring
description: Perfect for fire containment and safety at the campsite, Hutchision's 36" diameter 1' tall fire ring features a flared bottom that allows it to rest on the ground or bricks. One-piece sidewall of 22 gauge galvanized steel formed and rolled around 1 1/8" galvanized steel tube creating the heavy top ring. There is no bottom or plug on the ring. This Fire Ring can also be used as a beautiful backyard planter.

name: 47" Rancher Fire Pit
description: The Livingscape 47" Fire Pit with Cooking Grate is a great combination fire pit providing the warmth of a fire and the ability to cook outdoors. Crafted with durable, heavy duty metal, this large fire pit is constructed with an oversized 10" deep bowl, providing ample space to create a substantial fire. The inclusion of a cooking grate transforms the fire pit into a practical outdoor kitchen, perfect for grilling and cooking meat and vegetables. The durable outer table ring not only adds a touch of style but also serves as a convenient surface for placing utensils, ingredients or drinks. It also includes an oversized footrest, allowing you and your family or guests to relax and enjoy the ambiance of the fire. Whether used for cooking, entertaining or simply unwinding by the fire, this large, heavy-duty fire pit is an impressive and functional centerpiece for all of your outdoor gatherings.

name: Clay Chimenea
description: Transform your outdoor space into a warm and inviting haven with the Clay Chimenea. Expertly crafted from traditional clay, this charming piece combines classic design with practical functionality, making it the perfect addition to your garden, patio, or backyard.

name: Colorful Fire Box
description: Colorful Fire is no ordinary flame colorant. Colorful Fire packets are environmentally friendly and produce no smoke, no odor, and no noxious fumes. It comes in a convenient package that is light, moisture, and air resistant, resulting in a tremendously long shelf life.

name: Deer Head Fire Pit
description: This Big Horn 47-in Ranch Fire Pit features heavy-duty expanded metal cooking grate, heavy-gauge leg construction, durable outer table ring and oversized footrest, it will definitely be the centerpiece of your backyard. The 360 degree swiveling and adjustable-height cooking grate has the capacity to cook for an entire family. A 29-in fire bowl with an open deep bowl design is perfect for a warm fire on a cool night. This fire pit with 2-in-1 function is great for backyard BBQ's, family gathering or staying warm.

name: Deer Head Fire Pit
description: The Deer Head Fire Pit is an excellent way to get into the grilling spirit and will be a great conversation starter. This 47” diameter fire pit has a 29" grilling grate that swivels for easy access, and a 26" x 10" over sized deep bowl. The fire pit stands on four decorative legs that provide sturdy support and stability.

name: Firelog
description: Duraflame 4.5 lbs. Firelogs provide up to 3-hours of warm ambiance, indoors or out. Duraflame firelogs provide a robust, convenient, and authentic fire experience. Enjoy year-round. These firelogs are perfect for use in indoor fireplaces and outdoor fireplaces or fire pits. Duraflame firelogs are designed to light quickly with a single match, for beautiful, bright flames in under 5-minutes. Duraflame firelogs light faster and burn more completely than firewood and because far less material is consumed when burning a firelog, significantly fewer pollutants are emitted than a comparable wood fire. A Duraflame firelog consumes 80% less material than a comparable duration wood fire and burning firelogs instead of wood results in significantly fewer trees cut down for use as firewood. Duraflame firelogs use recycled and renewable wood sawdust and agricultural fibers, saving valuable natural resources. The renewable fibers are mixed with blends of wax and other combustible, renewable materials.

name: Grill Lava Rock For Use w/ Gas Grills
description: Grillpro grill lava rock distributes heat more evenly in gas grills, resulting in fuller, more consistent BBQ flavor. A creative gift for grilling aficionados, or a summertime essential for your own cooking.

name: Lattice Fire Pit
description: If you're looking for an addition to your backyard, the Lattice Fire Pit from Red Mountain Valley is just the thing. This 47” diameter fire pit comes with a 29" grilling grate that swivels for convenience and a 26" x 10" over sized deep bowl. Standing on four decorative legs, it has more than adequate support and stability.

name: Outdoor Wood Rack
description: Old Country BBQ Pits Wood Racks are crafted from the same heavy-duty, gauge steel as our smokers and grills, guaranteeing lasting durability for outdoor use. These racks provide a convenient and organized way to store your preferred wood type!

name: Seasoned Firewood Bundle
description: The .75 Cubic Foot Premium Firewood Bundle or Bag offers reliable quality, consistently low moisture content, and is uniformly packaged for easy stacking and handling. Premium Kiln-Dried Firewood also available in .75 Cubic Foot size.

name: String Ties Firewood Bundle

Each bundle is neatly secured with durable string ties for easy carrying and handling, featuring seasoned hardwood that ignites quickly and burns cleanly for a long-lasting, steady flame. Perfect for fireplaces, wood stoves, or outdoor fire pits, this high-quality firewood offers dependable warmth and a touch of rustic charm to any gathering.

name: Tulsa 48" Wood Burning Fire Pit & Grill
description: The Tulsa 48" Wood Burning Fire Pit & Grill has two heavy duty cooking grates with adjustable height and swivel to help making cooking in your backyard easier. Two Large outer shelves are great for setting plates down to free up your hands in order to continue cooking and the side handles will help when the fire pit needs to be relocated.

name: Hickory Smoking Wood Chunks
description: Hickory wood is the most versatile, often referred to as the King of cooking woods. It offers a strong, savory smoke that is hearty and often a bit like bacon with its rich flavor profile. Mix with a light fruit wood like an orange wood or peach wood to add a slight sweetness to your cooking.

Match Light Charcoal is made with North American wood and the same quality ingredients as Kingsford Original to deliver an authentic wood-fired BBQ flavor instantly. No lighter fluid needed.100% natural ingredients

Elevate every cook with the trusted quality of Traeger and the unmistakable taste of Meat Church.

name: Mesquite BBQ Pellets

description: Welcome to Texas. This strong, flavorful wood has been a long established go-to for many in the Longhorn state and the Western U.S. Because its strong flavor is great for brisket, pork, as well as big game such as elk and deer.

name: Natural Oak Charcoal Briquets

description: Infusethedeep,sweetand smoky taste of realwhiskeystavesinto your Traeger cooks. Featuring acombinationofall-naturaloak hardwood andauthenticusedwhiskey staves, this full-bodied blendgives yourich, one-of-a-kind flavoryouwon’tfind anywhere else.

name: Oak Lump Charcoal
description: For over 50 years B&B Charcoal has been the leading producer of lump charcoal. B&B Charcoal offer a variety of types that include Oak, Mesquite, Hickory, Hardwood, and Quebracho Blanco. Through our unique process, we are able to rid our wood of the most unwanted foreign material, including resins and acids that are most commonly found in other major brands. What remains is only the natural fiber, accounting for the subtle, natural flavor that foods capture when cooked with B&B Lump Charcoal. That process has made it “The Expert’s Choice For the Outdoor Barbequer” for many many years.

description: Hickory, maple, and cherry hardwood pellet flavors combine for a Traeger blend that can take on just about anything you cook. From classic BBQ meats to fish and veggies, this versatile blend gives you full-bodied flavor you’ll go back to time and time again.

name: StayDry Pellet Storage Bin with Lid
description: Keep your hardwood pellets fresh, dry, and organized with the StayDRY Pellet Bin. It features an airtight lid with locking closures that seals out moisture to ensure optimal burn and flavor from your pellets. So grab a few and create your own personal pellet paradise.

name: Summer Steakblend Pellet

name: Sweet BBQ Wood Pellets
description: A sweet smoky blend of 100% premium, all-natural oak, maple, and cherry hardwoods. No flavorings, fillers, or additives. Low moisture for the perfect smoke. Use with all outdoor pellet, gas, charcoal or electric grills and smokers.

name: Turkey Pellets and Brine Kit Combo Set

Slather it on everything from pulled pork to ribs and chicken for a taste that’s nothing short of heavenly.

name: Red Pizza Mojo Seasoning
description: A savory concoction of spices and herbs. Just add a sprinkle to make your pizza even more magical. Will also add zip to pizza sauces, makes a perfect sausage spice blend and great mixed into meatballs. The Pizza Mojos are a fantastic alternative to the traditional parmesan and crushed red pepper shakers you normally see at a pizza table. These products sell extremely well as they are incredibly versatile, for a variety of foods.

name: 10-qt Fish Fryer
description: For over 30 years the artisans of Lourdes, El Salvador have handcrafted traditional stockpots for use as Bayou Boilers. Beginning as a flat disk of 99 percent pure aluminum spinning on lathes, fry pots and boilers are turned and manually formed into shape; then hand trimmed and polished to enduring standards not found in modern, mass-produced items. Bayou Classic is proud to support these skilled craftsmen and their communities by offering their heirloom-quality products to our customers. Use with basket to fry fish, shrimp, chicken, hushpuppies, and fries.

Built to last, The Brazos Offset Smoker features a robust ¼” thick metal plate and all-welded steel construction. This ensures unparalleled durability and longevity, allowing you to enjoy years of flavorful barbecue experiences without compromising on quality.

Versatile Cooking Area: With multiple cooking grates, including a slide-out cooking grate and heavy-duty coal grate, the Brazos offset smoker offers a generous total cooking area of over 1000 square inches. Whether you're smoking meats, grilling vegetables, or warming buns, there's plenty of room to accommodate all your culinary creations. Specifications:

Cooking chamber grill grate: 17.5 x 36 inches = 630 sq. in
Top cooling shelf cook grate: 8 x 35 inches = 280 sq. in
Firebox grill grate: 16.5 x 16.5 inches = 272 sq. in
Firebox warming plate: 8 x 15 inches = 120 sq. in

name: Charcoal Kettle Grill
description: The Omaha Charcoal Kettle Grill features a 380 sq-in cooking area, perfect for grilling burgers, steaks, and vegetables for family and friends. Designed for convenience, it includes a quick-removable ash holder for easy cleanup, wheeled legs for effortless mobility, and a bottom storage grate to keep grilling tools and accessories within reach. With its durable construction and two cooking grates, this kettle grill delivers versatile, efficient, and enjoyable outdoor cooking, making it an ideal choice for backyard barbecues and outdoor gatherings.

name: Flatrock 3-Zone Flat Top Griddle
description:
Explore new flavor frontiers with the Traeger Flatrock Grill. This flat top grill opens up a whole new world of griddling, frying, steaming, sautéing, and more, and delivers all the innovation and premium quality you’d expect from Traeger. It offers the versatility to fire up every meal, gives you superior sizzle and deeper flavor, and makes cooking fun.

TruZone™ temperature control features three distinct cooking zones separated by HeatShield insulation, allowing you to cook multiple dishes at once with total temperature control. FlameLock™ construction blocks wind and keeps heat where it should be for better fuel efficiency and more burn for your buck. Plus, innovative U-shaped burners ensure consistent heat distribution across the entire cooktop surface, so you can use every square inch. Other features make it easy to clean and customize your grill. Whether you’re ready to expand your outdoor cooking arsenal or simply discover a better way to griddle, the Flatrock is what you need.

name: Gravity Fed Smoker
description: Experience next-level smoking with the Old Country BBQ Pits Gravity Fed Smoker, designed for those who demand precision, efficiency, and authentic wood-fired flavor. Engineered with a gravity-fed charcoal system, this smoker provides consistent heat and extended burn times with minimal effort. Simply load the charcoal chute, light the fire, and let gravity do the work—delivering steady, controlled temperatures for perfect low-and-slow cooking. Fully insulated for maximum efficiency, this smoker retains heat exceptionally well, reducing fuel consumption while ensuring even cooking in any weather. Its multi-rack design offers ample cooking space, making it ideal for everything from backyard barbecues to competition smoking. With heavy-duty steel construction and welded durability, the Old Country BBQ Pits Gravity Fed Smoker is built to last, delivering the reliability and performance that pitmasters trust.

name: Ironwood 650 Pellet Grill
description: Traeger has set the bar high with the new Ironwood 650 pellet grill. Forged from commercial grade stainless steel and packed with next-gen grilling features, this WiFi pellet grill was born for those looking to elevate their craft.

name: Ironwood 885 Pellet Grill
description: The Traeger Ironwood 885 pellet grill comes loaded with top of the line technology that other grill companies wish they had, led by the Ironwood D2 Controller with WiFIRE. Working in conjunction with the Traeger App, WiFIRE allows you monitor your grill at any time, from anywhere. Keep Warm Mode ensures food is “hot off the grill” whenever you feel like eating. Advanced Grilling Logic keeps your cooking temperature within +/- 10 degrees, and the Meat Probe allows you to check temperatures without ever lifting the lid.

name: Ironwood Pellet Grill
description: Experience the evolution of Wood-Fired flavor. With the all-new Traeger Ironwood Wood Pellet Grill, you’ll discover next-level consistency in your cooks, unrivaled wood-fired flavor, and game-changing customization options that let you create the perfect grill for your cooking style.

name: Ironwood XL Pellet Grill
description: Experience the evolution of Wood-Fired flavor. With the all-new Traeger Ironwood Wood Pellet Grill, you’ll discover next-level consistency in your cooks, unrivaled wood-fired flavor, and game-changing customization options that let you create the perfect grill for your cooking style.

name: Jet Cooker with Hose Guard
description: Heats large boiling pots faster provides quicker recovery time after inserting food. Compact size enables portability from backyard parties to camping, RV's, and tailgating. Compliment with Bayou boilers and stainless stockpots for a traditional crawfish or seafood boil.

name: Original 28” Omnivore Griddle with Hard Cover Bundle
description: The 28” Omnivore Griddle with Hard Cover Bundle is a must-have for outdoor cooking made easy. The included cover and spatula set will have you prepared to cook as soon as you take your griddle out of the box. The Omnivore Griddle Plate Technology will save you on propane and heat up your griddle quicker, and the side shelf hooks and BAR System with included accessory tray provide ample storage space for your tools. Cooking is just better on a Blackstone!

name: Pecos BBQ Smoker
description:
Transform your outdoor cooking endeavors with the Old Country BBQ Pits Pecos Smoker. Built to last, its robust all-welded steel construction, fortified with heat-resistant paint, guarantees longevity and endurance. Prioritizing safety, it features stainless-steel "stay cool" handles, while the solid steel bottom shelf provides convenient storage for all your grilling essentials. Simplifying the smoking experience, it comes equipped with a drop-in steel front table, slide-out cooking grate, and heavy-duty coal grate. Effortless mobility is facilitated by its wagon wheels. Boasting ample cooking space and versatile functionalities, the Pecos Coal Smoker is an essential addition for every outdoor cooking enthusiast.

Versatile Cooking Area: With two cooking grates, including a slide-out cooking grate and heavy-duty coal grate in the fire box, the Pecos offset smoker offers a generous total cooking area of over 900 square inches. Whether you're smoking meats, grilling vegetables, or warming buns, there's plenty of room to accommodate all your culinary creations. Specifications:

Cooking chamber grill grate: 17.5 x 36 inches = 630 sq. in
Firebox grill grate: 16.5 x 16.5 inches = 272 sq. in
Firebox warming plate: 8 x 15 inches = 120 sq. in

name: Performance Series 4-Burner Gas Grill
description: The Char-Broil® Performance Series™ 4-Burner Gas Grill is versatile, reliable and equipped with everything you need to get the good times going. With 565 square-inches of total cooking space, you'll have plenty of room to grill a variety of food. The side shelves integrate with Gear Trax™ accessories for a more organized workspace. It’s easy to assemble and equipped with electronic ignition to ensure reliable starts and a sleek upgraded design for classic good looks.

name: Pro Series 34 Pellet Grill
description:
Bring your grill game to wherever it’s needed most with Traeger’s Pro Series 34 pellet grill. This brawny little beast boasts a linebacker-like sawhorse chassis for added stability when hauling your grill over gravel, pavers, and uneven ground. The Digital Pro Controller uses Advanced Grilling Logic to keep temps within a 15° range for juicy, satisfying results every time, and the double-racked 884 square inch grilling area provides ample space for feeding family, friends, and neighbors.

Unlike conventional gas grills, pellet grills use the art of convection cooking to circulate hardwood smoke throughout the cook chamber for unbelievably full flavor—you can throw your rubs and sauces out right now. Just fill the hopper to the brim, kick back with a cold one, and let the Pro do the work.

name: Ranger Pellet Grill
description: Cook a feast fit for the wilderness right on your truck bed while you spend the day at your favorite fishing hole, or bring it along for a weekend away. Featuring Traeger’s Digital Arc controller, the Ranger gives you precise temperature control with an added Keep Warm Mode to make sure your food is ready to eat whenever you are. Next time adventure calls, answer it with the Traeger Ranger.

name: RT-B380X Bullseye Deluxe Pellet Grill
description: There is nothing hotter than our newest grilling innovation- the RT-B380X Bullseye Deluxe takes our weekday workhorse into a weekday warrior. Finally, all of the latest smart grill features you have been waiting for: dual band WiFi connectivity, PID control, and, of course, extreme temperature capabilities. This new design features an integrated front-folding shelf, one probe port, and an 18 lb hopper. Convenience features like the bottom shelf, integrated ash dump, and larger hopper make this grill unbelievably simple to maintain. Finally, our completely new afterburner firepot lets you reach temps up to 1000F and gives you searing power like no other.

name: Sportsman 820 Pellet Grill
description: The Pit Boss® Sportsman Series 820SP delivers a powerful grilling experience for the true outdoorsman. It offers 8-in-1 cooking versatility, allowing you to smoke, bake, braise, roast, grill, barbecue, char-grill, and sear - all in one machine. The dial-in digital control board works hand-in-hand with Pit Boss® meat probes so you can monitor meat doneness, adjust cooking temperatures and track fuel without having to open the lid. Just set it and let the Sportsman do all of the work for you. Additional features of the Pit Boss® Sportsman Series 820SP Grill include a large hopper capacity, a hopper viewing window, a built-in spice rack, a high-temperature powder coat finish, solid legs with 2 inline-style wheels, and the Pit Boss® best-in-class 5-year warranty.

name: Table Top Portable Grill
description: The Old Country BBQ Pits tabletop grill offers a compact grilling area of over 100 square inches, featuring an easily expandable cooking grate for convenient access. Crafted from ultra-durable welded carbon steel, this unit is designed to endure the heat and demands of regular heavy usage. Equipped with a heavy-duty charcoal grate, it ensures optimal airflow for even, direct-heat cooking of delicious meats, vegetables, and more. The lid incorporates a stay-cool steel handle, allowing safe handling and easy access to the cooking chamber. Its compact design makes it highly portable, providing the versatility you require. Whether fueled by charcoal or wood, this grill includes an adjustable side damper for precise control over heat and smoke levels. Enhanced with 11-gauge steel construction and a resistant paint coating, it guarantees increased durability capable of withstanding prolonged cooking sessions. For consistently mouthwatering results, the tabletop grill is an essential addition to your barbecue arsenal.

name: Tailgater 20 Pellet Grill
description: From game days to getaways, bring wood-fired flavor everywhere with the new Tailgater 20. Featuring a compact, portable design, it’s prime for balconies, tailgating or anywhere else you want to take 6-in-1 versatility and superior taste. And now it comes armed with Traeger’s Digital Arc controller for more precise, consistent temperatures and a Keep Warm Mode that keeps food fresh until chow time.

name: Timberline XL Pellet Grill
description: Over 30 years of wood-fired innovation has led to trailblazing tech and premium construction that ensure incredible consistency you can always count on. Offering an elevated cooking experience, an intuitive touchscreen display with simple controls make the Timberline easy to use, and thoughtful design ensures it's easy to clean and maintain. Offering an industry first for North America, outdoor rated induction cooktop which allows for scorching-hot searing, sauteing, simmering, frying & more.

name: Vaquero Santa Maria Grill
description: The Old Country BBQ Pits Vaquero Grill is built for those who appreciate the art of live-fire cooking. Inspired by traditional cowboy-style grilling, this heavy-duty all-welded steel grill delivers exceptional durability, heat retention, and versatility. Designed with adjustable height grates, the Vaquero Grill allows for precise temperature control—whether you're searing steaks over high heat or slow-grilling over smoldering coals. The spacious cooking surface provides plenty of room for grilling everything from burgers and ribs to whole chickens and vegetables. Its open-fire design enhances flavor by allowing you to cook over real wood or charcoal, bringing out that rich, smoky taste only true live-fire grilling can achieve. Built to last and crafted for serious outdoor cooking, the Vaquero Grill is perfect for backyard gatherings, ranch cookouts, and anyone who loves traditional, open-flame grilling.

name: Woodridge Elite Pellet Grill
description: Achieve epic wood-fired flavor and unlock endless possibilities with the Woodridge Elite. Cook low and slow with Super Smoke™ Mode, turn up the heat for fast grilling, and finish steaks, simmer soups, or sauté veggies perfectly on the grill side burner. Set-It & Forget-It® convenience allows you to relax while your grill handles the rest, and with WiFIRE® connectivity, you can monitor and adjust the cook remotely.

name: Woodridge Pellet Grill
description: With intuitive controls, you can Set-It & Forget-It® for consistently delicious results. Personalize your setup with P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® accessories, stay connected and monitor your grill from anywhere with WiFIRE® technology, and enjoy hassle-free cleanup with the EZ-Clean Grease & Ash Keg.

name: Woodridge Pro Pellet Grill
description: Smoke brisket, pulled pork, and ribs low and slow with Super Smoke Mode, or turn up the heat to grill wings, burgers, and even bake pizza fast.

name: 12" Perforated Pizza Peel
description: The Ooni 12" Perforated Pizza Peel is a high-quality peel for easily sliding, turning and retrieving pizzas from your oven. Perforations release excess flour and let steam escape for cleaner bakes and consistently crisp pizza bases. The sleek, anodized coating protects against corrosion, while the tapered edge and smooth surface guarantee seamless pizza launches and retrievals.

name: 14" Perforated Pizza Peel
description: This Ooni 14" Perforated Pizza Peel is a high-quality, well-balanced peel for effortlessly sliding, turning and retrieving pizzas from your oven. The peel’s perforations help disperse excess flour and let steam escape for cleaner bakes and crispier, more consistent pizza bases. The sleek, anodized coating protects against corrosion, while the tapered edge and smooth surface guarantee seamless pizza launches and retrievals.

name: Digital Infrared Thermometer
description: Remove the guesswork from your pizza making with the Ooni digital infrared thermometer. This laser guided, high precision tool is calibrated to read the extreme temperatures on Ooni baking stones so you get the perfect bake every time. Designed for use during heat up and recharge periods, the Ooni digital infrared thermometer ensures you always have a clear understanding of when your pizza stone is ready to cook. Numerical and color coded temperature displays allow you to select your preferred interface and switch effortlessly between laser guided spot measurements and wider area scans. The high resolution LCD full color digital display delivers temperature information in less than 300 milliseconds, while temperature scan mode allows you to easily determine minimum, maximum, and average surface temperatures for ultimate accuracy to within 4 degree Fahrenheit. The thermometer comes calibrated specifically for the cordierite baking stones used inside Ooni ovens, but an adjustable emissivity setting lets you easily read steel and other materials and finishes and cast iron.

name: Karu 12 Carry Cover
description: Pack up your Ooni Karu 12 for your next adventure with this custom-designed carry cover. Made with premium quality, breathable polyester, this waterproof cover ensures maximum protection for your oven. The snug, elasticated edges guarantee a tight fit, effectively shielding your oven from the elements. The cover includes durable straps and a cushioned carry handle for enhanced portability, so you can comfortably transport your Karu 12 anywhere.

name: Karu 12 Gas Burner
description: Quickly and easily convert your Ooni Karu 12 or Ooni Karu 12G oven to take advantage of the convenience that gas-powered cooking offers. The easy-to-install burner will have you up and cooking with gas in minutes. Use the heat control dial for fine temperature adjustments to suit various cooking styles.

name: Karu 12 Multi-Fuel Pizza Oven
description: Create authentic, stone-baked pizza from anywhere with the Ooni Karu 12. It combines optimum, multi-fuel performance with ultimate portability. It can reach up to 950 °F (500 °C) in just 20 minutes so you can make flame-cooked, restaurant-quality pizzas in as little as 60 seconds using wood, charcoal, or gas.* At just 26.4 lbs (12 kg), the Karu 12 is highly portable. It’s just as at home on your balcony or backyard as it is on a camping trip. Whether you’re at home or on the go, the Karu 12 is a portable and powerful addition to your pizza-making setup.

name: Koda 16 Gas Powered Pizza Oven
description: The Ooni Koda 16 Gas-Powered Pizza Oven combines modern, showstopping design with the convenience of cooking with gas. The innovative L-shaped flame allows for one-turn cooking and provides supreme flexibility and control. The Koda 16 can reach 950 °F (500 °C) in just 20 minutes, so you can cook pizza in just 60 seconds. Plus, the heat control dial gives you more fine control over the temperature. Easily maintain a consistent lower temperature to precision-cook meats, vegetables and more. Its sleek, modern design also makes it an attractive addition to any outdoor kitchen. The Koda 16 uses ultra-convenient gas, so it’s ideal for entertaining and hosting backyard parties. All you need to do is fire it up and decide which toppings will please the crowd most.

name: Koda 16 Grill Cover
description: This custom-designed cover offers maximum protection for your Ooni Koda 16. Constructed from premium, breathable polyester, the cover is waterproof and durable. Its elasticated edges ensure a snug and effortless fit, effectively shielding your Ooni Koda 16 from the elements.

name: Koda 16 Natural Gas Conversion Kit
description:
This conversion kit can convert your Ooni Koda 16 from propane to a fixed natural gas line.

Along with the parts and tools included in the kit, you’ll need a 3⁄4"" (19mm) wrench, a 1⁄2"" (12mm) wrench, and a Phillips head screwdriver. Also, you’ll want to ensure your natural gas supply line termination has a 3/8"" NPT male thread and that your gas pressure is 7iwc. Depending on your local gas code, you may also need a quarter-turn valve installed on your gas line.

name: Pizza Cutter Rocker Blade
description: Slice whole pizzas in half with one quick move using the Ooni Pizza Cutter Rocker Blade. The ultra-sharp, stainless steel blade is 14 inches (35.5cm) long and finished with a comfortable easy-grip handle.

name: Pizza Turning Peel
description: Cook your pizzas faster and ensure consistently crisp crusts with the Ooni Turning Peel. This peel’s extra-long handle lets you keep your pizzas in contact with the baking stone as you rotate your pies without ever having to remove from the heat of a flaming hot Ooni oven. The durable anodized aluminum surface has a non-stick effect for sliding right under pizzas, while perforations let excess flour fall away for a perfectly cooked pizza base.

name: 18" 3-in-1 Barbecue Tool
description: Master the Grill with the BBQ Croc 18 inch 3-in-1 Barbecue Tool. This versatile all-in-one barbecue tool combines the functionality of tongs, spatulas, and a grill scraper into one convenient tool, ensuring precise control and efficient performance. Perfect for backyard cookouts, camping adventures, and beach parties. A great GIFT IDEA for your BBQ lover!

name: 36" Stainless Steel Paddle
description: 36 in. stainless steel cooking paddle with 4.75 in. stirring end. Great for giving gumbos and jambalaya a stir. Even boiled crawfish. Perfect for your camping and tailgating excursions.

name: 3-Piece Deluxe Tool Set
description: If you own a barbecue grill, you probably have the grilling tool trifecta: spatula, fork and tongs. So why not give your barbecue utensils an upgrade with this Deluxe 3-Piece Tool Set. All three stainless steel tools are designed with a sleek mirror polish finish and easy grip handles.

name: 4-Pack 17" Chrome Spiral Skewers
description: Turn out lots of perfectly bite-sized morsels for your BBQ guests with these Spiral Skewers. Perfect for turning your favorite meats, vegetables and fruits into fun kabobs, these durable metal skewers are designed to protect hands from the heat while cooking with easy to grip, cool touch handles. The flat body will hold your food in place and the push bars will easily remove the food once it's done. The 17" length means there's plenty of room to load them up with your favorite BBQ fare. Stuff a skewer, feed a crowd!

name: 5-Piece Stainless Steel Griddle Toolkit
description: The Blackstone Original 5-piece Griddle Accessory Tool Kit is an essential toolset for any outdoor chef. Each piece of Blackstone's griddle cooking toolkit is a high-quality utensil that will complete your outdoor kitchen. The various tools make it easy to cook anything. Monster size burgers or massive steaks will be easy to create with dual spatulas. Prepare mountains of stir fry or heaps of breakfast with the help of squeeze bottles and a griddle scraper. A chopper/scraper helps dice food or scrape the gunk off the griddle for quick cleanup. Two commercial-grade liquid dispensers enhance your griddle cooking experience or maintain the griddle surface. You will also cook like a professional with the custom Blackstone cookbook filled with our favorite recipes.

name: 814GW Thermometer
description: Thermometers are important for determining whether or not meat has reached a safe temperature for consumption, and this Taylor outdoor grill / smoker dial thermometer mounts right inside your grill to help you closely monitor just that! This grill thermometer has a 1 7/8" heavy-duty stainless steel stem and an oversized 2 3/4" dial with smoke and BBQ range indicators. Plus, thanks to the glow-in-the-dark background, it's easy to read the temperature in the dark. For further convenience, this thermometer can also be mounted to the wall of your smoker for even more accurate readings!

name: BBQ Blanket
description: The REST EZ BBQ Blanket™ allows for controlled heat loss and excellent moisture retention. Resting helps your BBQ reabsorb moisture for the most tender, juicy BBQ.

name: BBQ Prep Tub with locking Lid - Classic Orange
description: The new "V2" Prep Tub has a built in nylon cutting board and lid with locking hinges. It adjusts to 3 different heights and collapses for easy kitchen storage.

name: BBQ Prep Tub with locking Lid - Pit-Master Black
description: The new "V2" Prep Tub has a built in nylon cutting board and lid with locking hinges. It adjusts to 3 different heights and collapses for easy kitchen storage.

name: Bolt Action Rifle with Scope BBQ Lighter
description: Gibson's Bolt Action Rifle BBQ Lighter is "Another Gibson Original" for the outdoor barbeque. They took great pride in the detailer rifled scope and wood grain texture. A great pick for anyone that enjoys the outdoor life and an usual gift for that person that has everything.

name: Carving Knife
description: Cut easily through brisket, turkey, roast, ribs, prosciutto, and other meats with the Carving Knife. This perfectly engineered slicing knife is tapered to a razor-sharp edge for effortless carving and slicing. Designed with a comfort grip handle and a high-carbon steel blade for peak performance.

name: Chicken Throne
description: With Traeger's Chicken Throne, they have simplified Beer Can Chicken: so simple, so flavorful, and the most tender chicken preparation known to barbecue science. The Chicken Throne improves on beer can chicken by simplifying the recipe even further and eliminated any possible toxins released from heated beer cans with the Chicken Throne.

name: Double Barrel Shotgun BBQ Lighter
description: Gibson's Double Barrel Shotgun BBQ lighter is a unique gift for the outdoor barbeque. Great care was taken in every detail to make the Double Barrel Shotgun a replica of the original gun. To be called "Another Gibson Original" it's got to be unique and detailed. It's collectible and for fun the flame comes out of each barrel.

name: Egg and Omelet Ring Kit
description: Egg and Omelet Ring Kit used to cook perfect round eggs for egg sandwiches and simply to fill omelets.

name: Flat Top Grill Essentials Kit
description: A crafty cook is only as good as their tools, and the Flatrock Essential Bundle is all you need to be the master of any grill. With spatulas, squeeze bottles, and scrapers, you can flip, sauce, and clean your way to chef status is no time.

name: Flex Tube Utility Torch
description: Windproof Utility torch lighter perfect for camping, candles, grilling and more.

name: Griddle Scoop
description: The spatulas are great for many things like chopping, scraping, and flipping food, but scooping food like fried rice isn't one of them.This new griddle scoop will make serving rice, stir fry, potatoes, eggs, and pretty much everything quick, easy, and mess free. It's also dishwasher safe!

name: Grill Mitts
description: The Drip EZ BBQ Grill Mitts are the perfect tool to help you safely remove your food from the grill, oven, or stove. No need for cumbersome gloves or hard to clean hot pads. The mitt is made of silicone that is resistant to temperatures up to 450° and features a non-slip grip.

name: Heat Resistant Grill Glove
description: Keep safe from the heat with this Extra Long Heat Resistant Glove. It's heat-resistant, fire-retardant and made from thick quilted cotton. Designed to fit the full length of your arm and hand. One size fits all.

name: Induction Skillet
description: Engineered specifically for the Traeger Induction™ cooktop, this Cast-Iron Skillet is perfect for finishing steaks with a screaming-hot sear, sautéing veggies, and more. It’s designed to work seamlessly with Traeger Induction for premium performance, and it’s made with enameled cast iron so it’s ready to use right out of the box.

name: Insulated BBQ Gloves
description: Doesn't it just kill you to have to pierce a beautiful piece of meat with a fork just to get it off the grill? No more of that. These Insulated BBQ Gloves allow you to remove hot food from your grill without blemishing it with sharp utensils and releasing all of the juices. Each glove is constructed from durable, light rubber that protects you from the heat while preserving the presentation of your food.

name: Junior BBQ Prep Tub with Locking Lid - Classic Orange
description: The new "V2" Prep Tub has a built in nylon cutting board and lid with locking hinges. It adjusts to 3 different heights and collapses for easy kitchen storage.

name: Junior BBQ Prep Tub with Locking Lid - Pit-Master Black
description: The new "V2" Prep Tub has a built in nylon cutting board and lid with locking hinges. It adjusts to 3 different heights and collapses for easy kitchen storage.

name: Meater Plus
description: The upgraded version of the first truly wireless smart meat thermometer, the MEATER Plus keeps your grill free of wires and gives you detailed, real-time data on your cook to ensure you get perfect results every time. It also boasts an extended wireless range of up to 165ft to let you keep a close eye on your cook from across the yard or on your couch by using the MEATER Smart Meat Thermometer App. From the App you can monitor your cook, remove the guesswork with the Guided Cook System, and plan when dinner will be ready with the Advanced Estimator Algorithm. So clear out the clutter and get perfect results every time you cook with the MEATER Plus.

name: Meater Plus Meat Thermometer
description: Get ready for a new generation of perfect results and explore new ways to cook with the meater plus meat thermometer.

name: ModiFIRE Fish and Veggie Tray
description: Never lose another shrimp or pepper slice through the grill grates again. The ModiFIRE® Fish & Veggie Stainless Steel Grill Tray keeps chopped veggies, meatballs, and other small food items from falling into the fire.

name: Modifire Reversible Cast Iron Griddle
description: Expand the capabilities of your Traeger grill even more with the ModiFIRE® Reversible Cast Iron Griddle. Designed to fit securely on the grill grate of all ModiFIRE-compatible Traeger grills, this reversible griddle features a flat side that’s ideal for tasks like frying eggs & bacon and a ridged side for getting perfect sear marks. A recessed channel allows grease to drain directly into your grill’s EZ-Clean™ Grease & Ash Keg for ultimate convenience. It’s also crafted with cast iron for excellent heat retention and features an enamel coating so it’s ready to cook with right out of the box.

name: Non-Stick Grilling Mat
description: Stop worrying about making a mess on your grill when you use the Non-Stick Grilling Mat. Able to withstand temperatures up to 500°, this stylish copper color reversible grilling mat is ideal for smokers, grills, and even ovens to make your meal time that much easier. The best part is now you can cook eggs, French fries, and small foods that would normally slip between your grill grids. As if it couldn’t get any more convenient, when you’re done using your Non-Stick Grilling Mat, it folds neatly back into the plastic pouch for easy storing.

name: Replacement Meat Probe (2 Pack)
description: Whether your old meat probe is broken, or you just want plenty of fresh ones to throw in the rotation, this Replacement Meat Probe 2-Pack is exactly what you want.

name: Rio Grande Direct Flame Grill
description: Cook vegetables, meats, and more on the 400 square inch cooking surface of Old Country BBQ Pits’ Rio Grande BBQ Grill! This product is one of our fan favorites – and for good reason. This grill runs on wood or charcoal, and is built for usability. With a slide-out expandable grate, stay-cool stainless steel handles for safety, and wagon wheels for portability.

name: Silicone Basting Brush
description: Never find a brush bristle in your BBQ again with Traeger's Silicone Basting Brush. This brush is durable, heat-resistant, and most importantly, will never shed, so you can lay the sauce on thick without a worry.

name: Spiral Grid Grill Brush
description: This is not your ordinary brush! Remove food residue from grill grates quickly, easily, and safely. The Spiral Grid Brush boasts stainless steel coils that form to any grill grates for optimum action. Bristle-free and constructed from stainless steel, it is a go-to grill accessory.

name: 24 oz Grease Cup
description: This 24 oz grease cup is powder coated steel and is compatible with Camp Chef professional flat top grill models SG100, SG90, SG60, SG30 and SG14.

name: 36" Griddle Soft Cover
description: Make taking care of your 36” griddle a cinch with the weather-resistant cover. With durable buckles that clip on the sides, your griddle cover will stay put even in high winds year after year.

name: 5-Pack 20-Series Drip Tray Liners
description: Make grill maintenance a breeze with Traeger's Drip Tray Liners. Made of heat-proof aluminum, they're lightweight and disposable so you can clean up quick. Liners should rest fully on the grease pan, and not cover any areas outside of the grease pan, as to not affect the temperature and performance of the grill.

name: 5-Pack Large Bucket Liners
description: These 5 pack of disposable bucket liners makes cleaning your drip bucket easier than ever.

name: 5-Pack Pro 34 Drip Tray Liners

name: 5-Pack Woodridge Series Pro 34 Drip Tray Liner
8 Piece Cleaning Kit
description: Deep clean your dirty griddle top with the Blackstone 8 Piece Professional Griddle Cleaning Kit. This kit includes one 6” heavy-duty stainless-steel griddle scraper to remove debris, cooked on food, and other residue. The 8 Piece Griddle Cleaning Kit also features a handle and 3 scour pads designed to clean griddle tops wet or dry, replaceable pad resists clogging and rinses clean. Finally, another handle with 2 cleaning bricks. Designed to clean griddle or grill grates, helps remove cooking on grime. Can be used on hot or cold surfaces.

name: 8-Piece Blackstone Grill Cleaning Kit
description: Deep clean your dirty griddle top with the culinary series 8 pc. griddle cleaning kit. This kit includes one 6 in. heavy duty stainless steel griddle scraper to remove debris, cooked on food and other residue. The griddle cleaning kit also features a handle and 6 scour pads designed to clean griddle tops, wet or dry. The replaceable pads resist clogging and rinse clean. Last, but not least, this kit includes another handle with 2 cleaning bricks, which is designed to clean griddle or grill grates and help remove cooked on grime. Can be used on hot or cold surfaces.

name: All Natural Grill Cleaner
description: Keep your grill as clean and shiny as the day it was born with Traeger's All Natural Cleaner. It was specifically developed for Traeger Grills and accessories and is made of a grease-cutting formula that can take on a big mess without any harmful chemicals.

name: BBQ Cleaning Brush
description: Introducing a safer way to scrub cooled grill grates. This Traeger BBQ Cleaning Brush features nylon bristles that won’t damage your grates or wind up in your burger.

name: Bucket Liner - 5 Pack
description: Get a grip on your drip bucket maintenance with Traeger's aluminum Bucket Liners. Just drop one in before grilling and then replace it once it’s full. These easy to clean aluminum liners come in a 5 pack and fit all 20, 22, and 34 series buckets.

name: Bullseye Grill Cover
description: The premium custom fit cover is crafted with 2 ply construction from 350 gram pvc with a heavy polyester lining. The combination of these two materials means you get the best of both worlds with a cover that will resist cracking, fading and scratches while providing superior water resistant protection. Keep your RT b380 looking its best.

name: D2 Hot Rod Replacement Kit
description: The Hot Rod at the bottom of the Fire Pot ignites the Hardwood, making starting your grill as simple as flipping a switch. Keep the fire going with a replacement Hot Rod for your Traeger grill.

name: Deep Cleaning Grill Kit
description: Give your grill a fresh start with the Traeger Deep Cleaning Kit. This complete cleaning set has everything you need to help eliminate grease and grime and get your grill sparkling inside and out.Designed for use on wood pellet grills.

name: Flatrock Full-Length Grill Cover
description: When your Flatrock lives on your backyard patio, keep it protected with a Grill Cover designed to weather any season. All-weather coverage means you don’t have to worry when the sun is blazing or rain is pouring.

name: Foaming Degreaser Grill Cleaner
description: Cleanup should be easy. Just spray on Traeger’s new Foaming Degreaser and wipe away the grease and grime.

name: Folding Shelf - 34 Series
description: Traeger's Folding Shelf for the 34 Series is a fine addition to your grill. A folding front grill shelf makes a great landing pad for messy grilling utensils or a cold beverage. Prep like a pro and keep your tools of the barbecue trade on hand for every turn in the BBQ process. The front shelf folds down so that a grill cover will still fit perfectly. Give your Pro grill a little more real estate by adding a folding front shelf.

name: Full Length Gril Cover - 34 Series
description: Traeger's grill cover will keep your meat machine pristine with a full-length 34 Series, all-weather grill cover. From stem to stern, this BBQ cover will shield your trusty Traeger from sun exposure, wind, rain, and snow. Sleep well at night knowing your grill cover is on duty around the clock.

name: Full Length Grill Cover - 20 Series
description: The Traeger all weather, full-length grill cover shields your 20 Series barbeque from stem to stern. It fits like a glove and is water resistant so that you can rest easy, your Traeger will be protected through all types of weather, year-round.

name: Grease and Ash Keg Liner 5 Pack
description: The EZ-Clean™ Grease & Ash Keg catches both ash and grease in one convenient, accessible place to make grill cleaning easy. This five-pack of disposable EZ-Clean Liners makes it even easier. When one fills up, simply swap it out with a fresh liner in seconds.

name: Grease Bucket
description: When grilling up a storm, make sure to catch all the drippings with our galvanized steel bucket. Conveniently perched on your Traeger's undercarriage, and embossed with the classic Traeger logo, a shiny new bucket is a handy way to keep cleanup nice and easy. The more you grill, the more you fill it.

name: Grease Cup Liners
description: Cooking for a crowd? Make the worst part of cooking the easiest with the Blackstone Grease Cup Liners. The patented rear grease griddles make it easy to manage the grease, but the liners make disposal mess free. Place the liner in the grease cup before you start cooking and once you are done, push the excess oil and scraps of food to the back of the griddle to the rear grease opening. The liner will catch all the mess easily. Once the liner is full, simply discard it and replace it with a fresh one to make clean up a breeze.

name: Griddle Cast Iron Conditioner
description: Conditioner for pre seasoning a Blackstone griddle to protect from rust. After burning off rust inhibitor follow owner manual instructions for pre-seasoning a griddle using the Blackstone Seasoning and Griddle Conditioner to achieve a non-stick rust resistant finish. After cooking and cleaning griddle wipe a thin film of conditioner on all exposed griddle top surfaces to maintain a rust free nonstick griddle.

name: Griddle Stand for 17" and 22" Griddles
description: Blackstone 17"/22" leg stand with side shelf is made to fit either the 17" or 22" Table Top Propane Griddles. Conveniently portable and easy to break down, take it anywhere you've ever wanted to travel with your griddle. Constructed with adjustable legs to level your surface on any terrain, or any height. Side shelf can easily be removed or attached, making storage compact and convenient.

name: Grill Exterior Detailing Spray
description: Give your grill a good spray down and make your Traeger as shiny as the day you got it. This spray cleans and restores your grill to keep it looking its best.

name: Grilla Light 300 Outdoor Grill Light
description: Grilling at night can be frustrating without the right light so when those late-night cravings hit, fire up and light up your grill with NEBO’s Grilla™ Light 300. Poor lighting and shadows can affect the color of your food resulting in it being either undercooked or overcooked so to combat this, NEBO’s ChromaView™ Technology displays true and accurate color clarity to enhance and improve your grilling experience at night. Designed with a high Color Rendering Index (CRI) rating, your food will look as good as it will taste. Built with versatility in mind, you can attach it to a grill handle with the universal clamp, mount it to any metal surface with the magnetic base or detach it for handheld use. The silicone grip is heat-resistant, and the aircraft-grade aluminum housing is water-resistant so not even rain will hold you back from that midnight feast. And when you need to crack open your favorite beverage don’t go searching for a bottle opener because there is one built right into this clever design. Powered by (3) AA alkaline batteries with dual light modes and a max light output of 300 lumens, it can provide up to 16 hours of illumination.

name: Insulation Blanket-Pro34
description: Extend Grill Season through the winter for all-weather grilling, all year-round. When the weather turns frightful, slap on a Thermal Insulation Blanket to provide a buffer between the elements and your next meal. Freezing temperatures are no reason to dust off your oven. Keep strong and Traeger on all winter long.

name: Ironwood Grill Cover
description: Keep your Traeger Ironwood pellet grill looking and performing at its best with this Full-Length Grill Cover. Heavy-duty, all-weather material protects against any type of weather Mother Nature throws at you, and the sides feature adjustable cinches to accommodate all of your P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock Accessory Rail attachments.

name: Ironwood XL Grill Cover
description: Don’t let rain, storms, and snow damage your grill – cover it up with the Ironwood XL Full-Length Grill Cover. A form-fit offers maximum coverage, and a durable construction keeps your grill ready to serve up greatness for seasons on end.

name: Meater Pro Wireless Meat Thermometer
description: MEATER® 2 Plus is now MEATER Pro, and it features all the same innovative technology you’ve come to expect from your smart meat thermometer. Do more with the all-new MEATER® Pro / 2 Plus meat thermometer. Featuring new ways to cook with a waterproof design and higher temperature limits, you can grill, deep fry, and sous vide your way to perfect results every time. This wireless thermometer lets you experience freedom while grilling with MEATER App connectivity and longer range of up to 250ft. Multisensor technology finds the true lowest temperature of your meat, guiding you to unforgettable meals. Plus, a durable stainless steel and ceramic construction is made to last for countless seasons of grilling. Experience no wires and no guesswork with the MEATER Pro/2 Plus.

name: Meater Pro XL Wireless Meat Thermometer
description: Cook for a crowd and get real-time data on up to four cooks from anywhere with MEATER® Pro XL. Make brisket, steak, fish, and ribs all at once with four thermometers that have a max temperature of 1000˚F and a 100% waterproof design. Spend more time with family and friends and less time at the grill with unlimited range from built-in WiFi. Check on your cooks from the MEATER® App while Smart Temp™ Technology finds the true lowest temperature of your proteins with five internal sensors. MEATER Pro XL is sleeker and leveled-up with pin-point ±0.5˚F accuracy, a waterproof design, and two hours of cook time from a 5-minute charge. Grill, deep fry, sear, and smoke your way to perfect results with MEATER.

name: Modifire Sear Grate
description: Master the perfect sear with the ModiFIRE® Traeger Sear Grate. It’s designed to elevate your grilling game, and it’s compatible with most Traeger grills. This reversible aluminum BBQ grill grate features expertly crafted ridges for professional grade grill marks on one side, and a smooth, flat surface on the other. Flawlessly finish your meal with a sear.

name: P.A.L Pop-And-Lock Accessory Hooks 3 Pack
description: Always have the right tool for the job close at hand with P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® Accessory Hooks. You can arrange these hooks any way you’d like to keep spatulas, tongs, cleaning brushes, and more right where you need them.

name: P.A.L Pop-And-Lock Roll Rack
description: With the P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® Roll Rack, you won’t have to run inside every time you need a paper towel or a piece of aluminum foil. This adjustable roll rack holds most sizes of paper towels, butcher paper, foil, wax paper, and more so you always have what you need close at hand.

name: P.A.L Pop-And-Lock Storage Bin
description: Stop running back and forth between the grill and the kitchen in search of everyday cooking essentials. The Traeger P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® Storage Bin stores all your favorite rubs, hot sauces, salts, and whatever else you want to keep within arm’s reach at all times. Just snap it anywhere on your P.A.L. rail and you’ll always be armed with the ingredients you use most.

name: P.A.L. Cup Holder
description: Grill up, sip. Smoke meat, sip. When you’re sitting with two or three appetizers, turn it up a notch – all with your drink by your side in the P.A.L. Cup holder.

name: P.A.L. Front Shelf
description: Give yourself some space. The P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® Folding Front Shelf attaches to your P.A.L. rail to offer up extra room for prepping, plating, resting meat, and more. And when it’s not needed you can fold it down to keep it out of the way, yet still accessible at a moment’s notice.

name: P.A.L. Front Shelf XL
description: Give yourself some space. The P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® Folding Front Shelf XL attaches to your P.A.L. rail to offer up extra room for prepping, plating, resting meat, and more. And when it’s not needed you can fold it down to keep it out of the way, yet still accessible at a moment’s notice. This XL shelf size is ideal for larger grills and big feasts.

name: P.A.L. Pop and Lock Front Grill Shelf
description: When you want more space to prep, plate, and more, pop on the P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock™ FrontShelf. This accessory is designed to be there when you need it and out of the way when you don't. Great for resting meat, messy grilling utensils, or a cold beverage.

name: Replacement BBQ Brush 2 Pack
description: Replacement BBQ Cleaning Brush 2 pack. Easily swap out your dirty, used BBQ cleaning brush head for a fresh new one with this two pack replacement kit.

name: RT-800 Front Folding Grill Shelf
description: The heavy duty front folding shelf fits the backyard beast grill model. This add on is perfect for holding dishes going into or coming out of your RecTeq. It also adds a sleek touch to the look of your grill.

name: Scout/Ranger Drip Tray Liners - 5-Pack
description: Make cleaning up quick and easy wherever you go with Traeger's Scout/Ranger Drip Tray Liners. These drip liners are made of heat-proof aluminum for durability to take on the job, but are light and disposable so you can get the gunk out fast and spends more time doing everything else.

name: Timberline X-Large Grill Cover
description: Keep your Timberline XL grill in pristine shape by protecting it from the elements with a Full-Length Grill Cover. It features a rugged all-weather fabric that wards off sun, snow, and rain alike. And don’t worry an expansion panel zips open to accommodate any P.A.L. Pop-And-Lock® Accessory Rail attachments you have.

name: To-Go Carrying Bag
description: Tote wood fired flavor just about anywhere with the help of this To Go Bag for Scout and Ranger grills. This protective case features a heavy duty, weather resistant material to protect your grill from the elements, and sturdy straps allow for easy carrying.

name: Wi-Fi Controller for Woodwind
description: Calling all Camp Chef pellet grill owners. Bring your existing pellet grills up to speed by installing the new PID and WIFI enabled controller. This quick and easy Retro Fit is not only sleek, but will have you kickin' your feet up on the couch while keeping an eye on your pellet grill contents. Set temperatures and receive notifications from the Camp Chef Connect app when your food is ready to be pulled.

name: Wooden Grill Grate Scape
description: Use Traeger's Wooden Grill Grate Scape to clean your grates easily and effectively. A safer alternative to wire brushes that ruin your grates, this wooden grill scrape is specially designed to fit the grooves of your grill, making cleanup a breeze.

name: 13.25" ColorTrak Thermometer
description: Enjoy the convenience of a more personal, and accurate weatherman in the comfort of your home with Taylor's ColorTrak dial thermometer. Fun and functional, this mountable outdoor thermometer's 13.25" design features colorful silk-screened graphics and is shatterproof and weather resistant.

name: 13.25" Deer Dial Thermometer
description: This shatterproof dial thermometer from Taylor features an eye-catching deer design and has a temperature range from -60°F to 120°F.

name: 13.25" Easy-to-Read Dial Thermometer
description: This shatter proof dial thermometer from Taylor is designed to take some abuse. At 13-1/4” across and with big black text on a clean white background it’s easy to read, even at a bit of a distance, and the shatter proof frame is water resistant so that it can hold up to use outdoors. It has a temperature range from -60 to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: 19.25" Galvanized Metal Thermometer
description: The classic design of La Crosse Technology's Galvanized Metal Thermometer provides instant reading of indoor or outdoor temperature. The galvanized metal housing is fully weatherproof, and the thermometer uses a mercury-free liquid to indicate the temperature.

name: 22” Emperor Dial Thermometer
description: Monitor your backyard conditions in grand style with La Crosse Technology’s 22" Emperor Dial Thermometer. This oversized outdoor thermometer combines classic design with reliable function, making it both a decorative and practical addition to any patio, garden, or outdoor space. Its large, easy-to-read dial ensures quick temperature checks at a glance, while durable construction allows it to withstand the elements for long-lasting performance. Perfect for homeowners who value both form and function, the Emperor Dial Thermometer elevates your outdoor décor while keeping you informed of real-time temperature changes.

name: 3.5" Weather Resistant Round Dial Thermometer
description: Get a quick, easy reading of the temperature with this weather resistant round dial thermometer from Taylor. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, it has a suction cup to easily stick onto window glass. It has a 3-1/2” diameter and reads from -40 to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: 5.9'' Wireless Thermometer
description: Monitor your indoor and outdoor conditions with a La Crosse Technology Wireless Weather Station featuring extra-large, easy-to-read digits in a compact and sleek case. The LCD reads time in either 12- or 24-hour mode and detects the room temperature in Fahrenheit or Celsius. Gives you quick on-demand indoor humidity and tracks temperatures Highs and Lows. Customize your calendar view to view full weekday or abbreviated weekday with month and date. This station can receive up to 3 temperature and/or humidity sensors, plus rain sensor (sold separately) to enhance your weather station. With fast, accurate readings from 330 ft transmitting range, you can track your climate with ease and comfort inside your own home. Also, detects any low battery charge for both indoor station and outdoor sensor. Batteries required and sold separately.

name: 6" Weather Resistant Round Dial Window Thermometer
description: Get a quick, easy reading of the temperature with this weather resistant 6" round dial thermometer from Taylor. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, it includes a bracket for a secure mount. Reads from -60 to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: 7.625" x 2.375" Blue/Green Window Thermometer
description: A modern twist on a timeless classic, this Taylor window thermometer adds style and functionality to any home, backyard, or garage. The thermometer's sleek, curved design features bold, blue and green numerals to provide accurate readings from -40 to 120 degrees F to -40 to 50 degrees C. Constructed with weather-resistant and rustproof material, this wall thermometer is compatible for both the indoors and outdoors and can be used throughout all four seasons. For even easier installation, an aluminum bracket for secure wall mounting is included.

name: 7.625" x 2.375" Red/Blue Window Thermometer
description: A timeless classic with a modern twist, this Taylor window thermometer adds style and functionality to any home, backyard, or garage. The thermometer's sleek, curved design features bold, red, and blue numerals to provide accurate readings from -40 to 120 degrees F to -40 to 50 degrees C. Constructed with weather-resistant and rustproof material, this wall thermometer is compatible for both the indoors and outdoors and can be used throughout all four seasons. For ever easier installation, an aluminum bracket for secure wall mounting is included.

name: Analog Thermometer
description: This simple analog thermometer from Taylor will get the job done without giving you frills you don’t need. It’s constructed to be rust proof and weather resistant so that it’s suitable for indoor and outdoor use, and the large black numbers on a white background make for quick, easy temperature reading. It has a temperature range from -60 to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: ClearVu 5" Capacity Rain/Sprinkler Gauge
description: The grass is always greener with Taylor's ClearVu Rain and Sprinkler Gauge. For tracking local rainfall and sprinkler use.

name: EZ View Rain Gauge
description: This EZ View rain gauge mounts easily to fences, posts, or in the ground, and has a 5” accurate measurement gauge. For use in the home or on acreage.

name: Jumbo Junior Rain Gauge
description: Taylor's Jumbo Junior Rain Gauge can be read from up to 50 feet away and has a 5" capacity.

name: Professional Wind Speed Weather Station
description:
La Crosse Technology's Professional Wind Speed Weather Station will provide you accurate backyard weather monitoring from the convenience of inside your home. Easy to install instructions, mounting bracket, and hardware are included. The wireless wind/temperature sensor transmits from up to 300 feet (open air) to your indoor console so you know what the weather is doing without having to turn on the radio or tv.

Features:
  • Calendar
  • Manual set Quartz Time (hour/minute)
  • Time Accuracy: +/-1s/d
  • Indoor Temperature/Humidity
  • High/Low records for indoor temperature/humidity with time and date stamp (with button press)
  • Independent HI/LO Alerts for indoor & outdoor temperature & humidity (alerts on 3 channels if extra outdoor sensors are used).
  • Wireless Outdoor Temperature/Humidity and Outdoor temperature/humidity trend
  • C/F selectable
  • 3 channels no auto scroll
  • “Feels Like” temperature and Dew point for outdoor (calculated on all 3 channels if extra sensors are used).
  • High/Low records for outdoor temperature/humidity with time and date stamp (with button press) 3 channels.
  • Low battery icon for the THERMO-HYGRO sensor 3 channels.
  • Frost Warning when outdoor temperature is between 37 °F to 28 ° (3°C to -2 °C)
  • Storm Warning when barometric pressure drops 2.5 hPa in a 3 hour period.
  • Wireless Wind speed in mph, km/h
  • Display top wind in 1 hour.
  • Display current wind speed as top wind in the past 30 seconds.
  • Independent alerts for current wind speed
  • High history for wind records (1 hour (default) 24 Hours, 7 days, 1 Month, one year)
  • Low battery icon for WIND SPEED sensor
  • Weather forecast: Sunny, Partly sunny, Cloudy, Rainy, Stormy and Snowy

name: Temprite Easy-to-Read Weather Resistant Window/Wall Thermometer
description: This Taylor Temprite thermometer has a large, easy-to-read face with an offset bracket to give you quick, easy readings. It’s adjustable for multi-directional viewing, and the weather resistant, rust proof construction allows it to hold up to outdoor use. It has a temperature range of -40 to 120 degrees Fahrenheit, and comes with an aluminum bracket.

name: V61 Pro Wi-Fi Weather Station
description: Take your weather tracking to the next level with La Crosse Technology’s V61 Pro Wi-Fi Weather Station. Designed for serious weather enthusiasts, this professional-grade station delivers precise backyard weather monitoring, including wind speed and direction, rainfall data, and indoor home conditions. Enhanced Wi-Fi connectivity lets you access real-time data from anywhere, while its sleek, modern design keeps your home or patio looking sharp. Perfect for homeowners, hobbyists, or anyone who wants detailed, reliable weather insights, the V61 Pro combines advanced functionality with effortless connectivity for complete control over your environment.

name: Wireless Color Weather Forecast Station
description: The Wireless Color Weather Forecast Station from La Crosse features a large, easy-to-read display with comprehensive temperature, humidity, and forecast data. Easily set temperature and humidity alerts and track trends. The display also features a colorful forecast scene that changes seasonally. Monitor your indoor climate, as well as wireless outdoor environment with historical data, including hi/lo records for temperature and humidity. Displays the current barometric pressure and last 24 hour graph. Fully functional home weather station is an excellent addition to your home.

name: Wireless Forecast Station
description: Stay informed and prepared with La Crosse Technology’s Wireless Forecast Station, your all-in-one solution for home weather monitoring. This sleek and easy-to-read station provides accurate temperature and humidity readings, helping you track indoor and outdoor conditions with ease. It also features a clear display of time and date, keeping you on schedule while staying connected to the environment around you. Perfect for any home or office, the Wireless Forecast Station combines practical functionality with modern design, making weather tracking and daily planning effortless.

name: Wireless Indoor/Outdoor Thermometer
description: La Crosse Technology's Wireless Indoor/Outdoor Thermometer provides you with precise, real-time indoor & outdoor temperature in a sleek, simple case.

name: Deluxe Fun Pool
description: The Deluxe Fun Pool is mad with one-piece construction and will not rust or corrode. Wide, heavy duty rim is free of sharp edges and pool has built in slide, two seats, and two four cup holders.

name: Fast Set 10' x 26" Pool Set
description: With this quick and easy Bestway Fast Set Pool Set, you’ll be ready for a pool day in no time. The Fill & Rise set-up process is simple, just select a level surface, inflate the top ring and the pool will rise as it’s filled up with water. The sturdy DuraPlus liner is made from an ultra-durable 3-layer material that is reinforced for strength and is 85% more puncture-resistant than PVC. When the season’s over, storage is fast and simple. The water releases easily through the flow control drain valve, and then the pool can fold up for compact off-season storage. Also included with the set is a filter pump to help keep the water clean. This pool is the ideal choice for families looking for a quick and easy pool option for their backyard. Kids will enjoy spending their summer days splashing and playing in the water, and parents can enjoy a nice and relaxing dip as well. The season won’t be complete without the convenient Fast Set Pool from Bestway.

name: H20GO! Rectangular Family Pool
description: Designed to get kids (and adults) moving and out of the house, the Bestway Rectangular Family Pool is quality-tested and puts the focus back on fun. This 6.6' x 59" x 20" rectangular pool is made from sturdy pre-tested vinyl. With extra wide side walls, this pool is great for younger families to splash and play in the sun. And taking it down is a breeze with the easy to use drain valve. Splashing in the sun has never been more fun than with the H2OGO! Rectangular Family Pool.
